templates.name: Pre-Construction Site Assessment Checklist
templates.description: Structured walkthrough and documentation of existing site conditions, access, utilities, and hazards performed before mobilization to establish baseline conditions and identify risks.
prerequisites: Site visit scheduled and access confirmed
Preliminary project scope or drawings available

items.text: Confirm site access routes for construction vehicles and equipment deliveries.
items.acceptance_criteria: Route width and turning radius accommodate largest anticipated vehicle (minimum 12 ft lane width).

items.text: Verify laydown/staging area size and location relative to work zones.
items.acceptance_criteria: Staging area meets the minimum square footage identified in the project logistics plan.

items.text: Identify locations for temporary field office, sanitation facilities, and worker parking.
items.acceptance_criteria: Locations do not conflict with active work areas or emergency egress routes.

items.text: Confirm public road, sidewalk, and traffic control requirements for site entry.
items.acceptance_criteria: Traffic control plan matches municipal permit requirements for the entry point.

items.text: Assess site topography and grading for drainage and equipment mobility.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slopes exceeding 15% are documented with a mitigation plan noted.

items.text: Photograph and document existing conditions of adjacent structures, sidewalks, and landscaping.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos capture 100% of shared property lines and any pre-existing defects (cracks, settlement).

items.text: Verify existing site boundary survey and property pins are located and match the legal description.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey markers found within 0.1 ft of recorded coordinates, or discrepancy logged.

items.text: Document existing structures, foundations, or slabs to remain or be demolished.
items.acceptance_criteria: Structure inventory matches demolition/scope drawings with no unidentified structures.

items.text: Inspect existing pavement, curbs, and utility structures for pre-existing damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: All pre-existing cracks, spalling, or damage are photographed and logged prior to mobilization.

items.text: Confirm existing vegetation and trees to be protected per protection zone requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trees to remain are identified per arborist report or local ordinance with protection radius noted.

items.text: Record existing elevations/benchmarks for future grading comparison.
items.acceptance_criteria: Benchmark elevation recorded matches site survey within 0.05 ft tolerance.

items.text: Confirm public utility locate (call-before-you-dig) request is submitted and completed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility locate tickets on file, dated within 10 working days of excavation start.

items.text: Verify locations of existing water, sewer, gas, electric, and telecom lines are marked on site.
items.acceptance_criteria: All utility markings are visible and match the utility company locate map.

items.text: Identify any private or unmapped utilities via as-built drawings or ground-penetrating radar.
items.acceptance_criteria: GPR survey completed in areas without utility company markings prior to excavation.

items.text: Confirm utility company points of connection and capacity for new service.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written utility confirmation received for water, sewer, power, and gas capacity.

items.text: Document location of septic systems, wells, or abandoned underground storage tanks if present.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any suspected UST or well locations are flagged and reported to the environmental consultant.

items.text: Review Phase I Environmental Site Assessment findings for known contamination.
items.acceptance_criteria: Phase I ESA report on file; recognized environmental conditions (RECs) are identified and addressed.

items.text: Confirm presence or absence of wetlands, floodplain, or protected habitat on site.
items.acceptance_criteria: FEMA flood zone designation and wetland delineation are confirmed and documented.

items.text: Check for asbestos, lead paint, or hazardous materials in existing structures to be renovated or demolished.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hazmat survey completed by a licensed inspector prior to any demolition activity.

items.text: Assess soil erosion and sediment control needs based on site slope and adjacent waterways.
items.acceptance_criteria: SWPPP requirements identified per site disturbance area (greater than 1 acre triggers NPDES).

items.text: Verify noise, dust, and vibration constraints from local ordinance or nearby sensitive receptors.
items.acceptance_criteria: Working hours and noise limits documented match municipal code.

items.text: Confirm site is free of unexploded ordnance or prior industrial use risk indicators.
items.acceptance_criteria: Historical land-use records reviewed for industrial, military, or landfill use.

items.text: Identify adjacent property owners requiring pre-construction notification or access agreements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Notification list is complete with contact information for all abutting parcels.

items.text: Assess potential impact to adjacent structures from excavation or vibration (underpinning needs).
items.acceptance_criteria: Structural engineer review completed for excavations within the influence zone of adjacent footings.

items.text: Document existing condition of shared walls, fences, or party structures.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pre-construction survey of party structures completed and signed by both parties where applicable.

items.text: Confirm proximity to schools, hospitals, or emergency routes requiring special coordination.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sensitive receptors within 500 ft are identified and a coordination plan is established.

items.text: Assess need for temporary fencing, gates, and site security.
items.acceptance_criteria: Perimeter fencing plan covers the full site boundary consistent with local code.

items.text: Identify fall hazards, excavation hazards, and other site-specific safety concerns for the safety plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hazard inventory feeds into the site-specific safety plan prior to mobilization.

items.text: Confirm emergency vehicle access and nearest emergency services are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Emergency access route width of at least 20 ft is maintained at all times.

items.text: Verify lighting requirements for security and any planned night work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Site lighting plan meets minimum illumination levels for security patrol areas.

items.text: Confirm site-specific fire prevention measures are identified (fire watch, extinguishers, hot work controls).
items.acceptance_criteria: Fire prevention plan addresses hot work and combustible storage.

items.text: Compile the site assessment report with photographs and findings for distribution to the project team.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report distributed to PM, design team, and owner within 5 business days of the site visit.

items.text: File existing-conditions photo and video documentation in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: All photo/video documentation is uploaded to the project management system the same day as the visit.

items.text: Confirm outstanding items requiring further investigation are logged with responsible party and due date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Open-items log includes an assignee and target close date for 100% of items.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming site assessment is complete and no unresolved critical hazards remain.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off documented by the project manager before mobilization.

templates.name: Geotechnical Investigation Review Checklist
templates.description: Verification that the geotechnical investigation report is complete, technically sound, and fully coordinated into structural and civil design before foundation design proceeds.
prerequisites: Geotechnical report received from consultant
Project structural loading criteria available

items.text: Confirm the number and depth of borings/test pits match the project footprint and structural loads.
items.acceptance_criteria: Boring count meets a minimum of 1 per 2,500 sf, or per the approved geotechnical scope of work.

items.text: Verify boring logs include soil classification, blow counts (SPT-N), and groundwater observations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Each boring log contains USCS classification and N-values at intervals of 5 ft or less.

items.text: Confirm laboratory testing (grain size, Atterberg limits, moisture content) was performed on representative samples.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lab test results are included for each distinct soil stratum identified.

items.text: Verify the report includes a site plan showing boring locations tied to project coordinates.
items.acceptance_criteria: Boring location plan cross-references the structural/civil site plan grid.

items.text: Confirm the report author is a licensed professional engineer in the project jurisdiction.
items.acceptance_criteria: PE stamp and license number are present and current.

items.text: Review groundwater table depth and seasonal fluctuation estimates.
items.acceptance_criteria: Groundwater depth is recorded at time of drilling with a note on expected seasonal high.

items.text: Identify presence of expansive, collapsible, or organic soils affecting foundation design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any problematic soil strata are flagged with a recommended mitigation measure.

items.text: Confirm depth to bedrock or refusal is recorded for each boring.
items.acceptance_criteria: Refusal depth or bedrock elevation is noted for all borings within the foundation influence zone.

items.text: Review corrosivity and sulfate testing results for buried concrete and metal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sulfate content and resistivity results are compared against exposure class thresholds.

items.text: Assess liquefaction potential for sites in moderate-to-high seismic design categories.
items.acceptance_criteria: Liquefaction analysis is included when the site is in a moderate-to-high seismic zone.

items.text: Verify the recommended foundation type and allowable bearing capacity match structural design assumptions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bearing capacity value in the geotechnical report meets or exceeds the structural engineer's design value.

items.text: Confirm the recommended footing embedment depth accounts for frost depth and bearing stratum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Embedment depth meets or exceeds the local frost depth requirement.

items.text: Review recommended subgrade preparation, overexcavation, and compaction requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Compaction requirement is specified (e.g., 95% modified Proctor) with the test method referenced.

items.text: Verify slope stability recommendations for cuts and fills exceeding project-specific thresholds.
items.acceptance_criteria: Factor of safety for permanent slopes is 1.5 or greater per the report.

items.text: Confirm recommended pavement subgrade/section design is included if applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: R-value or CBR result is used to develop the pavement thickness design.

items.text: Distribute the geotechnical report to structural, civil, and architectural design teams.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report distribution is confirmed to all disciplines within 3 business days of receipt.

items.text: Confirm the structural engineer has incorporated bearing capacity and settlement criteria into the foundation design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Structural drawings reference the geotechnical report number and date.

items.text: Verify the civil engineer has incorporated earthwork and pavement recommendations into the grading plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grading plan notes match the geotechnical compaction and subgrade recommendations.

items.text: Identify any conflicts between geotechnical recommendations and architectural or structural assumptions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Conflicts are logged and routed to the design team for resolution prior to permit submission.

items.text: Confirm the requirement for geotechnical engineer observation during foundation excavation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Observation requirement is noted in the report and included in the inspection and test plan.

items.text: Verify special inspection requirements for compacted fill placement are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Special inspection scope matches code requirements for fill placement.

items.text: Confirm dewatering recommendations are reviewed if groundwater impacts excavation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Dewatering plan addresses the groundwater depth noted in the geotechnical report.

items.text: Review recommendations for temporary excavation shoring and slope requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Shoring design references the soil classification identified in the report.

items.text: File the final geotechnical report and all addenda in the project document control system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report and revisions are uploaded and version-controlled within 2 business days.

items.text: Log open questions or requests for supplemental investigation with the consultant.
items.acceptance_criteria: RFI log tracks all geotechnical clarification requests to closure.

items.text: Confirm the design team acknowledges geotechnical recommendations are incorporated into contract documents.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written acknowledgment is obtained from the structural and civil engineers.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming geotechnical review is complete prior to permit submission.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is recorded by the project manager.

templates.name: Design Review and Validation Checklist
templates.description: Coordinated review of construction documents across disciplines to validate completeness, code compliance, constructability, and alignment with owner requirements before permitting.
prerequisites: 100% construction documents received
Owner's project requirements program document available

items.text: Confirm architectural, structural, MEP, and civil drawings are issued for the same revision/date set.
items.acceptance_criteria: All discipline drawing sets carry a matching issue date and revision number.

items.text: Verify the drawing sheet index matches the actual sheets included in the set.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of sheets listed in the index are present, with no missing or duplicate sheet numbers.

items.text: Check that specifications (CSI divisions) correspond to items shown on the drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: No drawing references a spec section that is absent from the project manual.

items.text: Confirm general notes and legends are consistent across all discipline drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Abbreviations and symbols legend match usage across the full set.

items.text: Verify addenda and bulletins issued during design are incorporated into the current set.
items.acceptance_criteria: All addenda items are cross-checked against the current drawing revisions.

items.text: Check structural framing against architectural reflected ceiling plans for clearance conflicts.
items.acceptance_criteria: No structural member penetrates a required ceiling clearance without a noted exception.

items.text: Verify MEP routing does not conflict with structural members or fire-rated assemblies.
items.acceptance_criteria: Duct/pipe routing is clash-checked against the structural model with zero unresolved clashes over 2 in.

items.text: Confirm the door/window schedule matches architectural floor plans and elevations.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of schedule entries match tagged openings on the plans.

items.text: Review the structural foundation plan against geotechnical report recommendations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bearing pressures and footing depths match the values in the geotechnical report.

items.text: Verify the site/civil utility plan aligns with building MEP entry points.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility stub locations are within 6 in. of the building entry points shown on MEP plans.

items.text: Confirm fire protection and life safety plans coordinate with the architectural egress plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Egress path widths and fire-rated wall locations match between disciplines.

items.text: Verify occupancy classification and construction type are stated and consistent throughout the set.
items.acceptance_criteria: Occupancy/construction type on the cover sheet matches the life safety plan and structural design basis.

items.text: Confirm accessibility (ADA) requirements are addressed in plans and details.
items.acceptance_criteria: Accessible route, clearances, and fixture heights meet minimum published dimensions.

items.text: Check that energy code compliance documentation (envelope, lighting, mechanical) is included.
items.acceptance_criteria: Energy code compliance forms are included and complete for the project jurisdiction.

items.text: Verify structural design criteria (wind, seismic, snow loads) are stated and match the project location.
items.acceptance_criteria: Design loads on the structural general notes match published values for the project site.

items.text: Confirm fire-resistance ratings of assemblies match required ratings for occupancy/construction type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wall/floor assembly listings match the required fire rating per the applicable code table.

items.text: Identify details with conflicting dimensions or unbuildable conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Constructability comments are logged for details with dimension conflicts greater than 1/2 in.

items.text: Review specified materials and systems for availability and lead-time risk.
items.acceptance_criteria: Long-lead items (over 12 weeks) are identified and flagged to procurement.

items.text: Assess sequencing feasibility of structural and enclosure systems as detailed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Structural engineer confirms the erection sequence is achievable as designed.

items.text: Verify tolerances specified are achievable with intended construction methods.
items.acceptance_criteria: Specified tolerances match industry-standard achievable tolerances.

items.text: Review temporary works implications (shoring, bracing) suggested by the design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Design does not require unconventional temporary works without a noted allowance.

items.text: Confirm the design meets the owner's project requirements (OPR) program document.
items.acceptance_criteria: Room/area schedule matches approved program square footages within 5% variance.

items.text: Verify the finish schedule matches owner-approved finish selections.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of finish schedule entries match the approved selections log.

items.text: Confirm specified systems meet the owner's operational and maintenance expectations.
items.acceptance_criteria: O&M-critical systems are reviewed and accepted by the owner's facilities representative.

items.text: Review budget alignment of the design against the approved project budget.
items.acceptance_criteria: Design estimate reconciles within the approved budget contingency (typically plus or minus 10%).

items.text: Compile the design review comment log and route it to the design team for response.
items.acceptance_criteria: Comment log is issued with unique tracking numbers within 5 business days of the review.

items.text: Confirm the design team has resolved all critical review comments prior to permit submission.
items.acceptance_criteria: Critical comment closure rate is 100% before submission.

items.text: File the final reviewed drawing set and comment resolution log in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Records are archived and accessible to the project team within 2 business days.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming the design is validated for construction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the owner and design manager with date.

templates.name: Value Engineering Checklist
templates.description: Structured process for generating, evaluating, and implementing cost or performance improvement alternatives to reconcile project design with the approved budget.
prerequisites: Design development or construction document estimate available
Project budget target defined

items.text: Confirm the project budget gap or savings target driving the VE study is documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Target savings amount and percentage of budget are stated in the VE charter.

items.text: Verify the VE team composition includes owner, design, and construction representation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of owner, architect, and GC/CM representatives confirmed attending.

items.text: Confirm the current cost estimate and schedule baseline are available for comparison.
items.acceptance_criteria: Baseline estimate is dated within 30 days of the VE study start.

items.text: Identify project elements excluded from VE consideration (owner priorities/non-negotiables).
items.acceptance_criteria: Exclusion list is approved and signed by the owner prior to the study.

items.text: Generate VE alternatives for structural systems (framing, foundation).
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of 2 structural alternatives evaluated with cost and schedule impact.

items.text: Generate VE alternatives for building envelope/exterior systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of 2 envelope alternatives evaluated including life-cycle cost impact.

items.text: Generate VE alternatives for MEP systems (HVAC, electrical distribution).
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of 2 MEP alternatives evaluated with energy/operating cost comparison.

items.text: Generate VE alternatives for interior finishes and fit-out.
items.acceptance_criteria: Alternatives documented with unit cost and durability comparison.

items.text: Screen VE ideas for code compliance and owner requirement conflicts before costing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ideas conflicting with code or the owner's project requirements are removed from further study.

items.text: Prepare a comparative cost estimate for each VE alternative against the baseline.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cost delta is calculated to within plus or minus 5% accuracy for each alternative.

items.text: Evaluate schedule impact (acceleration or delay) of each VE alternative.
items.acceptance_criteria: Schedule impact in working days is documented for each alternative.

items.text: Assess life-cycle cost impact (energy, maintenance, replacement) for major system changes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Life-cycle cost analysis period matches the owner's standard (typically 20-30 years).

items.text: Evaluate quality/performance trade-offs against the original design intent.
items.acceptance_criteria: Performance comparison is documented against original spec criteria (e.g., R-value, load rating).

items.text: Confirm constructability and risk implications of each alternative are assessed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Risk register is updated with new or changed risks per alternative.

items.text: Present VE alternatives with cost, schedule, and quality impacts to the owner/design team.
items.acceptance_criteria: Presentation package includes all alternatives with a recommendation ranking.

items.text: Obtain design team technical acceptance for alternatives affecting code or structural systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written acceptance is obtained from the engineer of record for structural/life-safety alternatives.

items.text: Confirm the owner's decision on each proposed alternative is documented (accept/reject/modify).
items.acceptance_criteria: Decision log records disposition for 100% of proposed alternatives.

items.text: Verify accepted alternatives are reconciled against the total project savings target.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cumulative accepted savings are compared against the target with variance noted.

items.text: Confirm design documents are revised to reflect accepted VE alternatives.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drawing revision log shows VE items incorporated with revision date.

items.text: Update the project cost estimate and budget to reflect accepted VE decisions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Revised estimate matches accepted VE savings within 2%.

items.text: Verify specifications are updated to match accepted material/system substitutions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spec sections are revised and reissued for all accepted substitutions.

items.text: Confirm subcontractor/vendor pricing is obtained to validate estimated VE savings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Firm pricing is obtained for at least 80% of accepted alternatives by dollar value.

items.text: Compile the final VE study report with all alternatives, decisions, and savings summary.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report is issued to the owner within 10 business days of the final decision meeting.

items.text: File the VE decision log and revised documents in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Records are archived and version-linked to the drawing revisions.

items.text: Confirm lessons learned from the VE process are documented for future project use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lessons-learned summary is added to the company knowledge base within 30 days of study closeout.

items.text: Obtain sign-off accepting the final VE outcomes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the owner and design manager with date and total validated savings amount.

templates.name: Bid Package Review Checklist
templates.description: Review of bid documents, scope, commercial terms, and estimate development to ensure a compliant and accurate bid is assembled and submitted on time.
prerequisites: Bid documents received from owner/CM
Bid due date and submission instructions confirmed

items.text: Confirm all drawing sheets and specification sections listed in the bid documents index are included.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of indexed sheets/sections are present in the received package.

items.text: Verify addenda issued prior to the bid date are received and incorporated.
items.acceptance_criteria: All addenda numbers referenced match those received and acknowledged.

items.text: Confirm the bid form, instructions to bidders, and agreement form are included and current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bid form matches the project name, number, and bid date.

items.text: Verify the geotechnical report and existing conditions documents are included or referenced.
items.acceptance_criteria: Geotechnical report is available for review prior to bid submission.

items.text: Confirm bonding and insurance requirements are stated clearly in the bid documents.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bond percentage and insurance limits are explicitly stated.

items.text: Review the scope of work for completeness against drawings and specifications.
items.acceptance_criteria: Scope narrative matches drawing/spec content with no unaddressed systems.

items.text: Identify ambiguous, conflicting, or missing scope items requiring an RFI.
items.acceptance_criteria: All identified ambiguities are logged as RFIs prior to the RFI cutoff date.

items.text: Confirm alternates and unit price items are clearly defined and quantifiable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Each alternate/unit price item has a defined scope and measurement basis.

items.text: Verify allowances and owner-furnished items are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Allowance list matches the specification Division 1 allowance schedule.

items.text: Confirm site visit/pre-bid conference notes are reviewed for scope clarifications.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pre-bid meeting minutes are reviewed and incorporated into estimate assumptions.

items.text: Review contract type (lump sum, GMP, unit price) and payment terms.
items.acceptance_criteria: Payment terms, retainage percentage, and billing cycle are identified and acceptable.

items.text: Verify liquidated damages provisions and the substantial completion date are understood.
items.acceptance_criteria: LD rate and milestone dates are documented in the bid review summary.

items.text: Confirm insurance and bonding requirements match the company's available capacity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bond capacity is confirmed available with the surety prior to bid submission.

items.text: Review indemnification, warranty, and dispute resolution clauses for acceptability.
items.acceptance_criteria: Legal/risk review is completed for non-standard contract clauses.

items.text: Confirm prevailing wage, DBE/MBE, or other regulatory requirements are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Applicable wage determination and participation goals are documented.

items.text: Confirm the quantity takeoff is complete for all major scope divisions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Takeoff covers 100% of CSI divisions shown in the scope of work.

items.text: Verify subcontractor and supplier quotes are solicited for all major trade packages.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of 3 quotes solicited per trade where the market allows.

items.text: Confirm general conditions and general requirements costs are estimated for the project duration.
items.acceptance_criteria: General conditions duration matches the proposed schedule within 5%.

items.text: Review the estimate for inclusion of escalation, contingency, and risk allowances.
items.acceptance_criteria: Contingency percentage applied matches company standard for project phase/risk.

items.text: Verify self-perform versus subcontract decisions are documented with rationale.
items.acceptance_criteria: Make/buy decision log is completed for all major scope items.

items.text: Confirm the bid form is filled out completely and mathematically accurate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bid form total matches the sum of line items with zero calculation errors.

items.text: Verify all required bid forms, certifications, and bonds are signed and attached.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of required attachments are present per the instructions to bidders checklist.

items.text: Confirm the bid bond amount and form match solicitation requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bid bond is equal to or greater than the required percentage (typically 5-10%) of the bid amount.

items.text: Verify the bid submission method and deadline are confirmed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Submission is confirmed received before the stated deadline with a time-stamped receipt.

items.text: File the final bid package copy, all addenda, and submission confirmation in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete bid file is archived within 1 business day of submission.

items.text: Log post-bid RFIs or clarifications issued by the owner/CM.
items.acceptance_criteria: Post-bid clarification log is maintained through award notification.

items.text: Log the final bid amount and submission timestamp in the company bid tracking system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bid tracking entry is completed within 1 business day of submission with amount, date, and outcome fields populated.

items.text: Obtain sign-off approving the final bid price and terms prior to submission.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the estimator and an executive before bid transmittal.

templates.name: Proposal Submission Compliance Checklist
templates.description: Verification that a competitive proposal fully complies with solicitation requirements, pricing rules, and submission procedures before transmittal to the owner or client.
prerequisites: RFP/RFQ document received
Proposal outline approved by pursuit team

items.text: Confirm the RFP/RFQ submission deadline, format, and delivery method are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deadline date/time and delivery method are documented and disseminated to the team.

items.text: Verify page limits and formatting requirements (font, margin, section order) are captured.
items.acceptance_criteria: Proposal outline matches the stated page limit and formatting rules.

items.text: Confirm mandatory forms, certifications, and licenses required for submission are listed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete list of required forms matches the RFP section on submission requirements.

items.text: Review evaluation criteria and scoring weights to align proposal content emphasis.
items.acceptance_criteria: Proposal outline allocates content proportional to the stated scoring weights.

items.text: Confirm pre-proposal conference/site visit attendance requirements are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mandatory pre-proposal attendance is confirmed and documented if required.

items.text: Build a compliance matrix mapping each RFP requirement to a proposal section/page.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of RFP requirements are mapped to a proposal location.

items.text: Confirm the technical approach addresses all scope elements described in the RFP.
items.acceptance_criteria: Technical narrative addresses each scope item listed in the solicitation.

items.text: Verify project team resumes and qualifications meet stated minimum experience requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Key personnel meet or exceed the minimum years of experience stated in the RFP.

items.text: Confirm relevant project references meet size, type, and recency requirements specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: References match the required project type/value within the specified lookback period.

items.text: Review safety record and past performance data required for submission.
items.acceptance_criteria: EMR value stated matches the most recent OSHA 300A-derived rate and meets any stated threshold.

items.text: Confirm subcontractor/JV partner qualification documentation is included if applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: All partner qualification packages received are compliant with the RFP format.

items.text: Confirm the pricing/cost proposal format matches the required schedule of values or forms.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pricing forms match the RFP-provided templates exactly with no altered formulas.

items.text: Verify the bonding capacity letter and insurance certificates meet stated minimums.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bonding capacity letter is dated within 90 days and meets stated aggregate/single project limits.

items.text: Confirm addenda acknowledgments are included and signed.
items.acceptance_criteria: All addenda are acknowledged on the required form with signature.

items.text: Review pricing for mathematical accuracy and consistency with the technical scope.
items.acceptance_criteria: Line item totals reconcile to the proposal grand total with zero discrepancies.

items.text: Conduct a technical review of the draft proposal content.
items.acceptance_criteria: Technical review is completed at least 5 business days before the final due date.

items.text: Conduct a compliance review against the solicitation requirements matrix.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of compliance matrix items are verified present in the final draft.

items.text: Perform a final proofreading and formatting quality check.
items.acceptance_criteria: Zero formatting or page-limit violations remain in the final version.

items.text: Obtain executive approval of final pricing and strategic content prior to submission.
items.acceptance_criteria: Executive sign-off is documented before printing/final submission.

items.text: Confirm required numbers of hard copies and electronic copies are produced per RFP instructions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Copy count matches the RFP requirement exactly.

items.text: Verify all required signatures are obtained on forms.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of required signature blocks are completed.

items.text: Confirm electronic submission file size/format meets portal requirements if applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: File format and size comply with the submission portal limits.

items.text: Verify the proposal is delivered/submitted before the stated deadline with proof of submission.
items.acceptance_criteria: Submission timestamp/receipt is obtained before the deadline.

items.text: Archive the final submitted proposal, compliance matrix, and pricing backup in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete submission file is archived within 2 business days.

items.text: Log any post-submission clarification requests or interview invitations received.
items.acceptance_criteria: Clarification/interview log is maintained through the award decision.

items.text: Update the pursuit tracking system with final submission status and follow-up date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tracking record is updated within 1 business day of submission with status and next action date.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming submission is complete and compliant.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the proposal manager with the submission confirmation number.

templates.name: Subcontractor Prequalification Checklist
templates.description: Evaluation of a subcontractor's licensing, financial capacity, safety performance, and technical qualifications before they are added to a bid list or awarded work.
prerequisites: Prequalification application received from subcontractor
Trade scope for prequalification identified

items.text: Confirm business license and trade-specific license are current and valid for the project jurisdiction.
items.acceptance_criteria: License expiration date is beyond the project completion date.

items.text: Verify company legal structure, years in business, and ownership information are provided.
items.acceptance_criteria: Company has a minimum of 3 years operating history in the applicable trade, or an exception is documented.

items.text: Confirm federal tax ID and W-9 are on file.
items.acceptance_criteria: W-9 information matches the legal business name on the license.

items.text: Verify DBE/MBE/WBE or other certification status if required for the project.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certification number is verified active in the relevant state/federal database.

items.text: Confirm bonding capacity (single and aggregate) meets the project requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Available bonding capacity is at least 1.5x the anticipated subcontract value.

items.text: Review financial statements or a credit report for financial stability.
items.acceptance_criteria: Financial review shows no going-concern flags within the trailing 12 months.

items.text: Confirm a bank/credit reference is provided and verified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bank reference contact is confirmed and responsive.

items.text: Verify current backlog of work does not exceed stated capacity for a new project commitment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reported backlog plus the new project value does not exceed the self-reported capacity limit.

items.text: Verify the OSHA Experience Modification Rate (EMR) meets the project/company threshold.
items.acceptance_criteria: EMR of 1.0 or below, or company-specific threshold, with a 3-year history provided.

items.text: Confirm OSHA 300/300A logs for the past 3 years are provided and reviewed.
items.acceptance_criteria: 300A logs are provided for each of the last 3 years with no undisclosed fatalities.

items.text: Review the written safety program and site-specific safety plan capability.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written safety program addresses fall protection, PPE, and hazard communication at minimum.

items.text: Confirm OSHA citation history is reviewed for willful or repeat violations.
items.acceptance_criteria: No willful/repeat citations in the trailing 3 years, or a mitigation plan is documented.

items.text: Verify required safety training certifications for key personnel.
items.acceptance_criteria: Competent-person certifications are current for excavation, fall protection, and confined space as applicable.

items.text: Review a list of comparable completed projects matching scope and size.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of 2 references of similar scope/value within the past 5 years.

items.text: Confirm key personnel and equipment resources are adequate for the project scope.
items.acceptance_criteria: Named superintendent/foreman has a minimum of 5 years of trade experience.

items.text: Verify a quality control program or warranty history is acceptable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty claim history shows no unresolved disputes exceeding 90 days.

items.text: Confirm manufacturer certifications required for specialty systems are current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certification documentation matches specification requirements.

items.text: Check for pending litigation, liens, or claims history affecting performance capability.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unresolved litigation exceeding 10% of company net worth.

items.text: Confirm insurance certificates (general liability, auto, umbrella, workers' comp) meet minimum limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certificate limits meet or exceed contract-required minimums.

items.text: Verify the subcontractor is not on any debarment or exclusion list.
items.acceptance_criteria: Debarment check shows no active exclusion.

items.text: Review reference check results from prior GC/CM regarding performance and payment history.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of 2 reference checks completed with no unresolved payment disputes reported.

items.text: Compile the prequalification file with all supporting documents in the procurement system.
items.acceptance_criteria: File is complete with 100% of required documents before bid invitation.

items.text: Assign a prequalification status with rationale documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Status decision is recorded with reviewer name and date.

items.text: Set a prequalification expiration/renewal date per company policy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Renewal date is set at 12 months from approval, or per policy.

items.text: Obtain sign-off approving the subcontractor for the bid list.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the procurement manager before the subcontractor is added to the bid list.

templates.name: Permitting & Regulatory Compliance Checklist
templates.description: Tracking of required permits, agency approvals, and regulatory notifications from application through issuance to ensure the project is legally authorized to proceed.
prerequisites: Approved construction documents available
Jurisdiction identified and permit fee schedule reviewed

items.text: Confirm the authority having jurisdiction (AHJ) for building, fire, and zoning approvals is identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: AHJ contact and submission portal are confirmed for all required approvals.

items.text: Verify zoning compliance (use, setbacks, height, parking) for the proposed project.
items.acceptance_criteria: Zoning analysis confirms compliance with district requirements, or a variance is obtained.

items.text: Identify all required permits (building, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire, grading, right-of-way).
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit matrix lists every required permit type with a responsible party assigned.

items.text: Confirm environmental permits required (stormwater, wetlands, air quality) are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: NPDES/SWPPP permit requirement is confirmed for disturbance of 1 acre or more.

items.text: Verify utility company permits/approvals (water, sewer, power connection) are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility approval requirements are listed with application status tracked.

items.text: Confirm permit application forms are completed accurately with correct project information.
items.acceptance_criteria: Application data matches the approved construction documents (address, scope, valuation).

items.text: Verify the plan sets submitted match the version approved by the design team and owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Submitted set revision number matches the design team's issued-for-permit set.

items.text: Confirm required supporting documents (energy compliance, structural calcs, geotech letter) are attached.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of AHJ-required attachments are included at time of submission.

items.text: Verify permit fees are calculated correctly and payment is submitted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fee calculation matches the AHJ fee schedule for the project valuation.

items.text: Confirm submission is logged with a tracking/case number from the AHJ.
items.acceptance_criteria: AHJ case number is recorded within 1 business day of submission.

items.text: Track plan review comments and response deadlines from each reviewing agency.
items.acceptance_criteria: Comment log is updated within 2 business days of receipt from the AHJ.

items.text: Confirm design team responses to plan review comments are submitted before the deadline.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of responses are submitted before the AHJ resubmission deadline.

items.text: Verify resubmittals incorporate all requested revisions and are tracked to closure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Resubmittal comment closure rate is 100% before permit issuance.

items.text: Confirm approved permit documents are stamped/released and copies obtained for the site.
items.acceptance_criteria: Approved stamped set is received and available on-site before work begins.

items.text: Confirm the special inspection agency is approved by the AHJ and contracted prior to start.
items.acceptance_criteria: Special inspection agency approval letter is on file before foundation work begins.

items.text: Verify the statement of special inspections matches the structural drawings requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Statement of special inspections lists all items required by code.

items.text: Confirm the inspection and testing schedule is coordinated with the construction schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Testing schedule aligns with concrete pour/steel erection dates with zero missed inspections.

items.text: Confirm special inspection progress reports are submitted to the AHJ per the required schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Progress reports are submitted per the statement of special inspections schedule with zero missed submissions.

items.text: Confirm required pre-construction notifications (demolition notice, asbestos notice) are filed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Notice is filed with the regulatory agency at least the required lead time before start (e.g., 10 working days for NESHAP).

items.text: Verify the SWPPP is implemented and inspections are scheduled per permit conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: SWPPP inspections are conducted at the frequency required by the permit (e.g., weekly and after 0.5 in. rain).

items.text: Confirm signage/posting requirements are met at the site entrance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit card and required postings are visible at the primary site entrance.

items.text: Verify scheduled inspections (footing, framing, rough-in, final) are called in and documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Each required inspection milestone is logged with the AHJ inspector name and result.

items.text: Confirm certificate of occupancy requirements and final inspection sequence are understood.
items.acceptance_criteria: CO prerequisite inspections are identified and scheduled in the project schedule.

items.text: Maintain a permit log with status, expiration, and renewal dates for all active permits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit log is updated monthly with zero expired active permits.

items.text: File all approved permits, stamped drawings, and inspection records in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Records are archived and accessible within 2 business days of receipt.

items.text: Log permit renewal/expiration reminders in the project schedule tracking system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reminder is set at least 30 days before each permit expiration date with a responsible party assigned.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming all required permits are obtained prior to mobilization.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the project manager before site mobilization begins.

templates.name: Title Search & Insurance Checklist
templates.description: Verification of clear property title, resolution of encumbrances, and procurement of adequate title insurance prior to closing and project mobilization.
prerequisites: Preliminary title report ordered from title company
Legal description of property confirmed

items.text: Confirm a preliminary title report/commitment is obtained from a licensed title company.
items.acceptance_criteria: Title commitment is dated within 30 days of review.

items.text: Verify the legal description in the title report matches the survey and recorded plat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Legal description matches the recorded plat/deed with zero discrepancies.

items.text: Confirm the current vested owner of record matches the contracting party/seller.
items.acceptance_criteria: Vesting deed name matches the purchase agreement/contract party exactly.

items.text: Review the chain of title for gaps or unresolved ownership claims.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unexplained gaps in the chain of title within the statutory search period.

items.text: Confirm property tax status shows no delinquent taxes or unpaid assessments.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tax certificate shows current status with zero delinquency.

items.text: Review all recorded easements affecting the property for construction impact.
items.acceptance_criteria: Easement locations are plotted on the survey with no conflict with the proposed building footprint.

items.text: Identify recorded liens, mortgages, or judgments requiring release before or at closing.
items.acceptance_criteria: All monetary liens are identified with the payoff/release process confirmed.

items.text: Verify restrictive covenants do not conflict with the project design or use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Covenant review confirms the proposed use and design comply with recorded restrictions.

items.text: Confirm mineral rights, air rights, or subsurface rights reservations are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any severed mineral/subsurface rights are documented with an impact assessment.

items.text: Review encroachments identified by the survey against title exceptions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey-identified encroachments are cross-referenced with the title exceptions list.

items.text: Confirm an ALTA/NSPS land title survey is ordered and matches the title commitment schedule B items.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey plots 100% of Schedule B-II exceptions capable of being shown.

items.text: Verify the survey confirms no boundary disputes or adverse possession indicators.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unresolved boundary discrepancy exceeds the survey tolerance.

items.text: Confirm flood zone certification is included with the survey or obtained separately.
items.acceptance_criteria: FEMA flood zone designation is documented on the survey or a separate determination.

items.text: Verify the zoning compliance letter/survey matches the title legal description acreage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Acreage on the survey matches the title report within 0.5% variance.

items.text: Confirm the owner's title insurance policy amount matches the purchase price/property value.
items.acceptance_criteria: Policy face amount equals or exceeds the purchase price/appraised value.

items.text: Verify the lender's title insurance policy is procured if the project is financed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Loan policy amount matches the loan amount per lender requirements.

items.text: Confirm required endorsements are requested and issued.
items.acceptance_criteria: All endorsements required by the lender/owner's counsel are listed on the policy.

items.text: Review title insurance exceptions to ensure standard exceptions are removed where possible.
items.acceptance_criteria: Standard pre-printed exceptions are removed via survey affidavit where customary.

items.text: Confirm the premium and closing costs for title insurance are budgeted and paid.
items.acceptance_criteria: Title insurance invoice matches the quoted premium with payment confirmed.

items.text: Confirm all title exceptions required to be cured are resolved before closing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cure items are closed with recorded releases prior to the closing date.

items.text: Verify the closing/settlement statement matches the negotiated purchase price and prorations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Settlement statement figures reconcile with the purchase agreement within $0 variance.

items.text: Confirm the deed and closing documents are prepared, reviewed by counsel, and executed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deed is recorded within the statutory timeframe after closing.

items.text: Verify recording of the deed and title policy issuance are confirmed post-closing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Final title policy is received within 30-60 days of closing.

items.text: File the title commitment, survey, and final policy in project/legal records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Documents are archived and accessible to the project team within 5 business days.

items.text: Log any unresolved title exceptions carried forward with a mitigation plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Open exceptions log includes responsible party and resolution deadline.

items.text: Log the final title policy number and effective date in project financial/legal records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Policy number and effective date are recorded within 5 business days of receipt.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming title and insurance are clear to proceed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the project manager and legal counsel before construction mobilization.

templates.name: Project Kick-Off Meeting Checklist
templates.description: Agenda and coordination checklist for the internal and owner kick-off meetings held at contract execution to align the team on roles, schedule, safety, and administration.
prerequisites: Contract executed
Project team assigned

items.text: Confirm the kick-off meeting agenda is developed and distributed in advance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Agenda is distributed to all invitees at least 3 business days before the meeting.

items.text: Verify all key stakeholders (owner, design team, GC, key subs) are invited.
items.acceptance_criteria: Invitation list includes the owner representative, architect/engineer of record, PM, and superintendent at minimum.

items.text: Confirm the meeting location/platform and required AV/technology are arranged.
items.acceptance_criteria: Meeting logistics are confirmed and tested 1 day prior for virtual/hybrid meetings.

items.text: Verify contract documents, schedule, and budget summary are prepared for review.
items.acceptance_criteria: Baseline schedule and budget documents are available in the meeting packet.

items.text: Confirm the project organization chart with names and roles is presented and distributed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Org chart includes primary and backup contacts for each discipline.

items.text: Verify communication protocols (RFI, submittal, meeting schedule) are established.
items.acceptance_criteria: RFI/submittal turnaround times are agreed and documented in the meeting minutes.

items.text: Confirm the chain of command and change order authorization limits are clarified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Authorization limits are documented matching the contract terms.

items.text: Verify the emergency contact list is distributed to all parties.
items.acceptance_criteria: 24-hour emergency contact list includes name, role, and phone number for key personnel.

items.text: Confirm document control procedures (submittal log, RFI log, drawing distribution) are reviewed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Document control platform and access are confirmed for all team members.

items.text: Confirm the baseline project schedule is presented with key milestones highlighted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Schedule includes notice to proceed, substantial completion, and final completion dates matching the contract.

items.text: Verify long-lead procurement items and submittal requirements are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Long-lead item list (over 8 weeks) is reviewed with a procurement responsible party assigned.

items.text: Confirm milestone/liquidated damages dates are acknowledged by all parties.
items.acceptance_criteria: LD milestone dates are confirmed matching the contract with no disputed dates.

items.text: Review the schedule update frequency and reporting format.
items.acceptance_criteria: Schedule update frequency and format are agreed and documented.

items.text: Confirm the site-specific safety plan and site logistics plan are reviewed with the team.
items.acceptance_criteria: Safety plan is reviewed with acknowledgment from all attending subcontractors.

items.text: Verify the quality control/quality assurance plan and inspection hold points are discussed.
items.acceptance_criteria: QC plan hold points are reviewed and agreed by the design team and inspector.

items.text: Confirm site access, laydown, parking, and security procedures are communicated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Site logistics plan is distributed and posted at the site entrance.

items.text: Review environmental and permit compliance responsibilities (SWPPP, noise, dust control).
items.acceptance_criteria: Responsible party is assigned for each permit compliance obligation.

items.text: Confirm billing/payment application procedures and schedule are reviewed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pay application due dates and required backup documentation are agreed and documented.

items.text: Verify insurance certificates and bonds are on file before work commences.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certificates of insurance are received and verified against contract minimums before notice to proceed.

items.text: Confirm the change order process and pricing methodology are reviewed with the team.
items.acceptance_criteria: Change order markup percentages and approval workflow are documented per contract.

items.text: Review retainage terms and close-out payment requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Retainage percentage and release conditions match the contract terms.

items.text: Distribute kick-off meeting minutes to all attendees within the required timeframe.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minutes are distributed within 3 business days of the meeting.

items.text: Confirm action items from the kick-off meeting are logged with an assigned owner and due date.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of action items have an assigned owner and due date in the tracking log.

items.text: File the meeting agenda, sign-in sheet, and minutes in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Records are archived and accessible within 2 business days.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming kick-off meeting objectives were met.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the project manager with date.

templates.name: Stakeholder Communication Plan Checklist
templates.description: Development and verification of a structured plan defining how project information, risks, and issues will be communicated to owner, design, field, and community stakeholders.
prerequisites: Project stakeholder list compiled
Project kick-off meeting completed

items.text: Confirm a comprehensive stakeholder list is compiled including owner, design team, regulators, and community.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stakeholder list includes contact information and role for 100% of identified parties.

items.text: Verify internal stakeholders (executives, PM, field team) are identified with reporting needs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Internal reporting hierarchy is documented matching the company organizational structure.

items.text: Identify external stakeholders (neighbors, tenants, public agencies) requiring notification.
items.acceptance_criteria: External stakeholder list includes all parties within the defined impact radius.

items.text: Confirm stakeholder influence/interest levels are assessed to prioritize communication effort.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stakeholder matrix classifies each party by influence and interest level.

items.text: Confirm the communication method (meetings, email, reports, portal) is defined for each stakeholder group.
items.acceptance_criteria: Communication method matrix covers 100% of identified stakeholder groups.

items.text: Verify the communication frequency is established per audience.
items.acceptance_criteria: Frequency schedule is documented and agreed by the project team.

items.text: Confirm the escalation path for urgent issues/emergencies is defined.
items.acceptance_criteria: Escalation contacts and response time targets are documented (e.g., 2-hour response for safety issues).

items.text: Review format and content requirements for owner progress reports.
items.acceptance_criteria: Progress report template matches owner-required content (schedule, budget, safety, quality).

items.text: Confirm public/community notification procedures for disruptive activities are defined.
items.acceptance_criteria: Notification lead time is defined for noise, road closure, or utility shutdown events (e.g., 72 hours).

items.text: Confirm the project management/collaboration platform is set up and accessible to all stakeholders.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of designated stakeholders have active platform accounts before work begins.

items.text: Verify document naming and version control conventions are established and communicated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Naming convention is documented and applied to all issued documents.

items.text: Confirm meeting minutes distribution list and turnaround time are defined.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minutes are distributed within the agreed timeframe to the full distribution list.

items.text: Review RFI and submittal log accessibility and update frequency for stakeholders.
items.acceptance_criteria: Logs are updated and accessible within 24 hours of a status change.

items.text: Confirm the process for communicating schedule delays or budget variances to the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Variance threshold triggering formal notification is defined (e.g., over 5% budget or 10 days schedule).

items.text: Verify the safety incident notification procedure and required timeframes are established.
items.acceptance_criteria: Notification to required parties occurs within the regulatory timeframe (8 hours for fatality, 24 hours for hospitalization/amputation/loss of eye).

items.text: Confirm change order and claim notification procedures are documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Notice of change/claim procedure matches the contract notice provisions and timeframes.

items.text: Review the procedure for communicating quality nonconformances to the design team/owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Nonconformance notification is issued within 24 hours of identification.

items.text: Confirm public agency inspection and reporting communication points are identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Agency contact list and required reporting frequency are documented.

items.text: Verify a community liaison or complaint hotline is established if required by permit/ordinance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complaint response time target is defined (e.g., 24-hour acknowledgment).

items.text: Confirm procedures for coordinating utility shutdowns or traffic impacts with affected parties.
items.acceptance_criteria: Advance notice requirements match municipal/utility company standards.

items.text: Confirm signage or public notification boards required by permit/ordinance are posted and maintained.
items.acceptance_criteria: Required public notice signage is posted at the site entrance and visible from the public right-of-way.

items.text: Confirm the communication plan is reviewed and approved by the project executive/owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written approval is obtained before plan distribution.

items.text: Verify the communication plan is distributed to all project team members and key stakeholders.
items.acceptance_criteria: Distribution is confirmed to 100% of the stakeholder list within 5 business days of approval.

items.text: Confirm the communication plan is reviewed/updated at defined intervals.
items.acceptance_criteria: Review interval is defined and the first review date is scheduled.

items.text: Confirm a backup/alternate contact is designated for each key stakeholder role.
items.acceptance_criteria: Backup contact is listed for owner, design lead, and PM roles in the communication plan.

items.text: File the approved communication plan and distribution log in project records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Records are archived and accessible within 2 business days of approval.

items.text: Log any stakeholder communication issues or plan revisions during project execution.
items.acceptance_criteria: Revision log tracks changes with date and rationale.

items.text: Confirm lessons learned regarding stakeholder communication are captured at project closeout.
items.acceptance_criteria: Closeout report includes a stakeholder communication effectiveness summary.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming the communication plan is active and understood by the team.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sign-off is documented by the project manager with date.

templates.name: Site Mobilization Readiness Checklist
templates.description: Confirms permits, temporary facilities, access, environmental controls, and safety preparations are complete before full-scale construction activity begins.
prerequisites: Executed contract and notice to proceed
Approved site logistics plan
Issued building/grading permits

items.text: Verify building/grading/NPDES permits are issued and posted on site.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit copies displayed at site entrance or trailer; permit numbers match approved plans.

items.text: Confirm executed contract, notice to proceed, and insurance certificates are on file.
items.acceptance_criteria: NTP date recorded; COI limits meet contract requirements and are not expired.

items.text: Confirm approved site logistics/mobilization plan is distributed to all subcontractors.
items.acceptance_criteria: Logistics plan issued to all subs of record with acknowledgment.

items.text: Verify pre-construction survey and existing conditions documentation is complete.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo/video survey of adjacent properties, ROW, and existing structures on file.

items.text: Confirm geotechnical report is available to site management.
items.acceptance_criteria: Current geotech report accessible on site or in project document control.

items.text: Verify local jurisdiction notifications (noise, dust, haul route) have been filed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Required notices filed within jurisdiction's lead time prior to mobilization.

items.text: Confirm site access points, haul routes, and traffic control plan are established.
items.acceptance_criteria: Traffic control plan matches jurisdiction approval; signage locations identified.

items.text: Verify perimeter fencing/barricades are installed around active work areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fencing continuous with no gaps greater than 4 inches at grade; gates lockable.

items.text: Confirm construction signage (site ID, emergency contact, no trespassing) is posted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signage visible from all public access points and legible from 20 ft.

items.text: Verify designated parking and lay-down areas are marked and communicated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Parking/lay-down zones flagged or striped; no conflict with fire lanes or egress.

items.text: Confirm site is accessible for emergency vehicles at all times.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 20 ft unobstructed access maintained to all work areas.

items.text: Verify wash rack or tire wash station is installed at site exit where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wash station operational and preventing track-out onto public roadway.

items.text: Confirm temporary power service and distribution panels are installed and GFCI protected.
items.acceptance_criteria: All 125V, single-phase, 15/20/30A receptacles on GFCI per code.

items.text: Verify temporary water supply is connected and adequate for construction use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flow and pressure sufficient for dust control and sanitary facilities.

items.text: Confirm sanitary facilities (toilets) are provided at required ratio to workforce.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1 toilet seat per 20 workers per OSHA sanitation requirement.

items.text: Verify field office/trailer set with emergency contact postings and first aid station.
items.acceptance_criteria: First aid kit stocked per ANSI Z308.1; emergency numbers posted at trailer.

items.text: Confirm temporary lighting is installed for early/late shift and interior work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum illumination levels met for general construction areas.

items.text: Verify dumpster/waste staging area located away from combustibles and site entrances.
items.acceptance_criteria: Waste containers at least 10 ft from structures unless rated enclosure used.

items.text: Confirm SWPPP is approved and posted, with BMPs installed per plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Silt fence, inlet protection, and stabilized entrance installed prior to land disturbance.

items.text: Verify stabilized construction entrance is installed to reduce track-out.
items.acceptance_criteria: Entrance pad meets plan dimensions (length/width/stone depth).

items.text: Confirm concrete washout area is designated and lined.
items.acceptance_criteria: Washout pit or container lined and clearly signed, located away from storm drains.

items.text: Verify tree/vegetation protection fencing is installed per landscape plan prior to grading.
items.acceptance_criteria: Protective fencing in place at drip line before any equipment mobilizes.

items.text: Confirm site-specific safety plan and emergency action plan are complete and posted.
items.acceptance_criteria: EAP includes evacuation routes, assembly point, and nearest hospital route map.

items.text: Verify fire extinguishers are staged per requirement in trailers and work areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 2A rated extinguisher within 100 ft travel distance of any work area.

items.text: Confirm all workers have completed site orientation and badge-in prior to work.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of workforce on site orientation log before starting first task.

items.text: Verify emergency contact list and utility shutoff locations are posted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gas, water, and electrical shutoff points identified and labeled on site plan.

items.text: Confirm mobilized equipment has current inspection tags and is fit for use.
items.acceptance_criteria: All cranes, lifts, and heavy equipment show current annual/pre-use inspection tag.

items.text: Verify material lay-down areas are level, drained, and identified by trade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Staging areas graded to drain; no ponding after 1 inch rain event.

items.text: Confirm fuel and hazardous material storage areas meet secondary containment requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Secondary containment sized to 110% of largest container volume.

items.text: Verify site security measures (lighting, cameras, or watchman) are operational.
items.acceptance_criteria: Perimeter lighting functional at dusk walk-through; security coverage confirmed.

items.text: Compile mobilization checklist package with photos into project record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Package uploaded to project document control within 24 hours of completion.

items.text: Obtain superintendent acknowledgment that site is ready for full-scale work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed readiness certification on file prior to first major activity.

items.text: Distribute mobilization completion notice to owner/GC and design team.
items.acceptance_criteria: Notice sent and receipt acknowledged within 2 business days.

templates.name: Jobsite Safety & Compliance Checklist: Construction Site Assessment
templates.description: A general jobsite walkthrough assessing fall protection, PPE, electrical, fire, and housekeeping compliance against OSHA 29 CFR 1926 requirements.
prerequisites: Site-specific safety plan approved
Prior assessment corrective actions available

items.text: Verify perimeter fencing and signage restrict unauthorized entry.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fencing continuous, minimum 6 ft, with warning signage at 100 ft intervals.

items.text: Confirm visitor sign-in and PPE issuance process is enforced at entry points.
items.acceptance_criteria: Visitor log current; PPE offered to all non-employees entering active work areas.

items.text: Verify designated pedestrian walkways are separated from vehicle/equipment paths.
items.acceptance_criteria: Walkways marked and physically separated where site traffic exceeds plan thresholds.

items.text: Confirm excavations and openings adjacent to walkways are barricaded.
items.acceptance_criteria: Barricades or covers installed on all openings within 6 ft of a travel path.

items.text: Verify fall protection is provided at unprotected edges 6 ft or greater.
items.acceptance_criteria: Guardrails, safety nets, or personal fall arrest systems in place at all qualifying edges.

items.text: Confirm guardrail systems meet height and load requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Top rail 42 in +/- 3 in above walking surface; withstands 200 lb outward/downward force.

items.text: Verify floor and roof openings are covered or guarded.
items.acceptance_criteria: Covers marked 'HOLE' or 'COVER' and support twice the intended load.

items.text: Confirm personal fall arrest system anchorage points are rated 5,000 lb per worker.
items.acceptance_criteria: Anchorage certified or independently designed for 5,000 lb per attached worker.

items.text: Verify ladders and stairways are properly secured and extend 3 ft above landing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ladder side rails extend minimum 3 ft above upper landing surface, tied off or footed.

items.text: Verify all workers are wearing ANSI-approved hard hats in designated areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% hard hat compliance observed in walkthrough of active work zones.

items.text: Confirm high-visibility apparel is worn where exposed to vehicular/equipment traffic.
items.acceptance_criteria: ANSI/ISEA 107 Class 2 or 3 apparel worn by workers in traffic-exposed zones.

items.text: Verify eye and face protection is used for grinding, cutting, and nailing operations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Safety glasses or face shields meeting ANSI Z87.1 worn during flagged tasks.

items.text: Confirm hearing protection is available and used in high-noise areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hearing protection provided where noise exposure exceeds 85 dBA TWA.

items.text: Verify respiratory protection program is in place for dust/silica-generating tasks.
items.acceptance_criteria: Respirators used per written program with fit testing on file where required.

items.text: Verify temporary wiring and cords are free of damage and properly rated.
items.acceptance_criteria: No exposed conductors, cracked insulation, or missing ground pins observed.

items.text: Confirm GFCI protection is used on all temporary receptacles.
items.acceptance_criteria: GFCI verified functional by test button on inspected circuits.

items.text: Verify lockout/tagout procedures are followed for energized equipment work.
items.acceptance_criteria: LOTO devices applied and verified before work on de-energized circuits/equipment.

items.text: Confirm minimum clearance is maintained from overhead power lines.
items.acceptance_criteria: 10 ft minimum clearance maintained for lines up to 50kV per equipment operation.

items.text: Verify work areas are free of debris, trip hazards, and protruding nails.
items.acceptance_criteria: No accumulation of scrap materials blocking egress or walkways.

items.text: Confirm flammable/combustible materials are stored away from ignition sources.
items.acceptance_criteria: Storage meets minimum separation distances from hot work and heat sources.

items.text: Verify fire extinguishers are accessible, inspected, and tagged monthly.
items.acceptance_criteria: Extinguisher tag shows inspection within last 30 days; gauge in operable range.

items.text: Confirm hot work permits are issued and fire watch posted where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit on file and fire watch present during and 30 min after hot work.

items.text: Verify safety data sheets are accessible for all chemicals on site.
items.acceptance_criteria: SDS binder or digital access available at point of use for all stored chemicals.

items.text: Confirm hazardous materials are properly labeled per HazCom standard.
items.acceptance_criteria: Secondary containers labeled with product identity and hazard warnings.

items.text: Verify silica exposure control plan is implemented for concrete cutting/grinding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wet methods or dust extraction used per Table 1 control method.

items.text: Confirm confined space entry permits are used where applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit-required confined space entries logged with atmospheric testing results.

items.text: Log all identified deficiencies with corrective action owner and due date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every non-conformance assigned an owner and closure date within 5 business days.

items.text: Confirm prior assessment corrective actions have been closed out.
items.acceptance_criteria: No open items from previous assessment older than 30 days without documented reason.

items.text: Obtain safety officer and superintendent sign-off on assessment results.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained same day as assessment.

templates.name: Subcontractor Compliance Checklist: Construction Site Safety & Legal Review
templates.description: Verifies subcontractor licensing, insurance, contractual, and safety program compliance before and during mobilization to the jobsite.
prerequisites: Executed subcontract agreement
Subcontractor prequalification file

items.text: Verify subcontractor holds current, applicable trade license for scope of work.
items.acceptance_criteria: License number verified against state/local licensing board and not expired.

items.text: Confirm certificate of insurance meets contract minimum limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: General liability, auto, and umbrella limits equal or exceed contract requirement.

items.text: Verify workers' compensation coverage is active for all on-site personnel.
items.acceptance_criteria: COI shows workers' comp coverage current with no lapse in the policy period.

items.text: Confirm additional insured and waiver of subrogation endorsements are on file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Endorsement documents match contract insurance exhibit requirements.

items.text: Verify business registration and tax compliance documentation is current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Registration active in jurisdiction of work; no outstanding compliance holds.

items.text: Confirm executed subcontract agreement matches approved scope and value.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed subcontract on file matching latest approved scope/budget.

items.text: Verify submittal and schedule of values obligations are being met.
items.acceptance_criteria: Submittals tracked against contract log with no items overdue beyond 5 days.
