items.text: Confirm lower-tier sub-subcontractors and suppliers are disclosed and approved.
items.acceptance_criteria: All second-tier subs listed and approved per contract flow-down requirements.

items.text: Verify lien waivers are current with each payment application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Conditional/unconditional waivers submitted matching pay app amount and period.

items.text: Verify subcontractor has a written site-specific safety plan on file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plan addresses scope-specific hazards and references applicable OSHA subparts.

items.text: Confirm subcontractor's OSHA recordable incident rate (EMR) meets prequalification threshold.
items.acceptance_criteria: EMR at or below contract-required threshold (typically 1.0) for prior 3 years.

items.text: Verify subcontractor has designated a competent person for applicable hazardous work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Competent person named in writing for excavation, scaffold, or fall protection tasks as applicable.

items.text: Confirm subcontractor has a documented hazard communication program.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written HazCom program and SDS access provided to crew.

items.text: Verify subcontractor participates in site safety orientation before mobilizing crew.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of subcontractor crew completed orientation prior to first day on site.

items.text: Verify OSHA 10/30-hour training cards are on file for applicable personnel.
items.acceptance_criteria: Card numbers verified and legible; matches contract training requirement.

items.text: Confirm equipment operators hold current certifications for machinery operated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Crane, forklift, aerial lift operator certifications current and on file.

items.text: Verify workers requiring specialty certification (welding, rigging, confined space) are qualified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Welder certifications per AWS D1.1 and rigger qualifications documented.

items.text: Confirm I-9 / work authorization compliance process is followed by subcontractor.
items.acceptance_criteria: Subcontractor attests to work authorization verification for all crew members.

items.text: Verify subcontractor crew is using required PPE for their scope of work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Task-specific PPE observed in use matching JHA/task hazard analysis.

items.text: Confirm daily task hazard analyses or pre-task plans are completed for high-risk work.
items.acceptance_criteria: JHA/pre-task plan signed by crew before start of shift for identified high-risk tasks.

items.text: Verify subcontractor equipment on site has current inspection documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspection tags current and visible on all powered equipment and lifts.

items.text: Confirm subcontractor reports incidents/near misses per site protocol within required timeframe.
items.acceptance_criteria: Incidents reported to GC safety officer within 24 hours per site policy.

items.text: Verify housekeeping standards are maintained in subcontractor's work areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Work areas free of debris and material staged neatly at end of shift.

items.text: Compile subcontractor compliance file with all verified documents.
items.acceptance_criteria: File contains license, insurance, safety plan, and training records in document control.

items.text: Flag any expired or missing documentation for immediate follow-up.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deficiency list issued to subcontractor with cure period per contract terms.

items.text: Obtain GC project manager and safety officer sign-off on compliance status.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained prior to subcontractor scope start or continuation.

templates.name: Excavation Safety Plan Checklist
templates.description: Verifies utility locates, soil classification, protective systems, and daily competent-person inspections are in place for excavation and trenching work under OSHA Subpart P.
prerequisites: 811/one-call locate ticket completed
Written excavation safety plan approved
Competent person designated in writing

items.text: Verify utility locate (811/one-call) request was submitted and locates completed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Locate ticket number on file; positive response received from all affected utility owners.

items.text: Confirm underground utility markings are visible and match locate ticket.
items.acceptance_criteria: Paint/flags present and legible at excavation limits prior to digging.

items.text: Verify estimated location of underground installations has been determined before opening.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility drawings reviewed and cross-referenced with field markings.

items.text: Confirm a written excavation/trench safety plan is on site.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plan identifies soil type, protective system, and competent person by name.

items.text: Verify surface encumbrances (structures, trees, pavement) near excavation are addressed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Encumbrances removed, supported, or accounted for in excavation plan.

items.text: Verify competent person has classified soil type (A, B, or C) prior to entry.
items.acceptance_criteria: Soil classification documented using visual and manual analysis tests.
items.reference: OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P, Appendix A

items.text: Confirm sloping, benching, or shoring meets requirements for classified soil type and depth.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slope/bench angles or shield rating match Appendix B tables for soil class and depth.

items.text: Verify excavations 5 ft or deeper have an approved protective system, unless solid rock.
items.acceptance_criteria: Protective system installed for all excavations 5 ft deep or greater.

items.text: Confirm trench box/shield is rated for depth and soil conditions and installed correctly.
items.acceptance_criteria: Shield manufacturer tabulated data on site matches depth/soil class in use.

items.text: Verify spoil and excavated materials are placed at least 2 ft from excavation edge.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spoil pile setback measured at 2 ft minimum from trench edge.

items.text: Verify ladder, ramp, or stairway is provided within 25 ft of workers in trenches 4 ft or deeper.
items.acceptance_criteria: Egress means present with no more than 25 ft of lateral travel to reach it.

items.text: Confirm ladders used for egress extend 3 ft above the trench edge.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ladder side rails extend a minimum of 3 ft above the excavation surface.

items.text: Verify structural ramps used for equipment/personnel are designed by a competent person.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ramp design documented and cleats installed for personnel ramps.

items.text: Verify precautions are taken for water accumulation, including dewatering as needed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Water removal system operating and monitored; competent person inspects after any water intrusion.

items.text: Confirm atmospheric testing is conducted for excavations over 4 ft deep in suspect areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Oxygen, combustible gas, and toxic gas levels tested and logged before entry.

items.text: Verify emergency rescue equipment is available for excavations with hazardous atmospheres.
items.acceptance_criteria: Retrieval system and rescue equipment staged at excavation when atmosphere is hazardous.

items.text: Verify vehicles/equipment operating near excavation edge use a warning system or barrier.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wheel stops, barricades, or signal person used to prevent equipment from entering excavation.

items.text: Confirm adjacent structures are supported or underpinned where excavation could affect stability.
items.acceptance_criteria: Engineering support system installed per design when excavation is within influence zone.

items.text: Verify employees are not permitted to work below excavated or partly excavated faces subject to caving.
items.acceptance_criteria: No workers observed below unsupported overhangs or undercut faces.

items.text: Verify competent person inspects excavation daily before work and after rain or other hazard-increasing event.
items.acceptance_criteria: Daily inspection log signed by competent person prior to entry each shift.

items.text: Confirm signs of instability (tension cracks, sloughing, undercutting) are documented and addressed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any instability signs trigger immediate work stoppage until corrected.

items.text: Verify excavation is backfilled or protected against unauthorized entry at end of shift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Excavation covered, barricaded, or fenced when unattended.

items.text: Compile daily inspection logs and soil classification records for the project file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Logs filed continuously with no gaps for days excavation was open.

items.text: Verify competent person designation letter is on file for the project.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed designation on file naming individual and authority.

items.text: Obtain competent person and superintendent sign-off on excavation safety plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained before excavation work begins.

templates.name: Steel Erection Safety Checklist
templates.description: Verifies structural stability, fall protection, bolting/welding, decking, and crane operations comply with OSHA Subpart R during structural steel erection.
prerequisites: Site-specific erection plan approved
Written concrete strength notification received
Approved shop drawings on site

items.text: Verify site-specific erection plan is developed and available to crew.
items.acceptance_criteria: Erection plan addresses sequence, crane locations, and fall protection per structure.

items.text: Confirm controlling contractor has provided written notification that concrete has cured to adequate strength for anchor bolt loading.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written notice on file confirming concrete meets erector's or engineer's specified strength.

items.text: Verify approved shop and erection drawings are on site and match steel delivered.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drawing revisions match piece marks on delivered steel.

items.text: Confirm site is clear of hazards along crane paths and lay-down areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Overhead obstructions, soft ground, and underground utilities identified and marked.

items.text: Verify structural stability of columns is maintained by anchor bolts meeting design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 4 anchor bolts per column unless engineer of record approves fewer.

items.text: Confirm column anchor bolts are not repaired, replaced, or field-modified without engineer approval.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any bolt deficiency addressed per engineer of record's written direction.

items.text: Verify perimeter safety cables are installed at final interior and exterior perimeters as required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cables installed prior to erection of next tier, meeting height and strength requirements.

items.text: Confirm hoisting equipment is inspected and rigging rated for steel piece weights.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rigging capacity meets or exceeds piece weight with documented safety factor.

items.text: Verify fall protection is provided for connectors working at heights above 15 ft to 30 ft.
items.acceptance_criteria: Connectors provided fall protection equipment and required to be tied off above 30 ft, or per site plan above 15 ft.

items.text: Confirm workers on walking/working surfaces are protected at 15 ft or greater above lower level.
items.acceptance_criteria: Guardrails, PFAS, or safety net used for exposures 15 ft and above.

items.text: Verify controlled decking zone (CDZ) procedures are followed if used for decking crew.
items.acceptance_criteria: CDZ limited to 90 ft from leading edge; only authorized decking employees inside.

items.text: Confirm double connections are made before load is released from hoisting equipment.
items.acceptance_criteria: No load released from crane until minimum bolts/welds per erection plan are complete.

items.text: Verify bolted connections are made using proper torque/tension method per RCSC specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bolt tensioning verified by turn-of-nut, calibrated wrench, or DTI per RCSC spec.

items.text: Confirm welders are certified for the process and position being performed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Current welder qualification test records on file matching WPS.

items.text: Verify welding procedure specifications (WPS) are followed and available at point of use.
items.acceptance_criteria: WPS matches joint type, material, and process being welded.

items.text: Confirm fire watch and hot work permit are in place for welding/cutting operations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit issued and fire watch maintained during and 30 min after hot work.

items.text: Verify decking is not walked on until it is secured to prevent movement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deck fastened per pattern prior to foot traffic beyond installers.

items.text: Confirm roof/floor openings created during decking are protected or covered immediately.
items.acceptance_criteria: Openings covered or guarded before decking crew leaves the area.

items.text: Verify decking bundles are landed on supports capable of carrying the load.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bundle placement matches structural engineer's load layout drawing.

items.text: Verify crane operator holds current certification applicable to crane type and capacity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certification current, matches crane category being operated.

items.text: Confirm daily crane inspection is completed and documented before use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pre-shift inspection checklist completed and on file for day of use.

items.text: Verify ground conditions support crane and outriggers per manufacturer requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ground bearing capacity confirmed or cribbing/mats used per load chart requirement.

items.text: Confirm signal person is qualified and communication method is established before lifts.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signal person qualification documented; radio or hand signal protocol confirmed with operator.

items.text: Compile bolt torque/tension and weld inspection records for the erected structure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Records filed matching each connection point per erection sequence.

items.text: Verify special inspection reports (if required by code) are logged and any deficiencies closed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Special inspector reports on file with no open structural deficiencies.

items.text: Obtain erector superintendent and controlling contractor sign-off for structural stability milestone.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained at completion of each tier before proceeding to next.

templates.name: Utilities Coordination Checklist
templates.description: Coordinates 811/one-call locates, utility marking verification, existing line protection, and new utility installation with utility owners to prevent damage and delays.
prerequisites: 811/one-call ticket submitted
Utility as-built drawings reviewed

items.text: Verify 811/one-call locate request was submitted within required notice window.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ticket submitted minimum 2-3 business days (per state law) before excavation start.

items.text: Confirm ticket number and positive responses from all affected utility owners are logged.
items.acceptance_criteria: All member utilities show 'marked' or 'clear' status before digging.

items.text: Verify private utility locator was engaged for lines not covered by one-call system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Private locate report on file for on-site/private utilities outside public ROW.

items.text: Confirm ticket expiration date is tracked and re-marked if excavation extends beyond validity period.
items.acceptance_criteria: Re-mark requested before ticket expiration (typically 15-30 days per state).

items.text: Verify field markings use standard APWA color code for each utility type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Colors match APWA Uniform Color Code (red-electric, yellow-gas, orange-comm, blue-water, green-sewer, purple-reclaimed).

items.text: Confirm markings are legible and have not been washed out or disturbed before digging.
items.acceptance_criteria: Paint/flags visible and re-marked if faded prior to excavation start.

items.text: Verify potholing (vacuum excavation) is performed to confirm depth/location of critical crossings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Potholes exposed at all crossing points before mechanical excavation within tolerance zone.

items.text: Confirm hand digging is used within the tolerance zone around marked utilities.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mechanical equipment not used within 24 in (or per state law) of marked utility without hand exposure.

items.text: Verify utility owner representative is notified for work near critical infrastructure (high pressure gas, transmission lines).
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility owner contacted and, where required, present for excavation near critical lines.

items.text: Confirm relocation or de-energization requests submitted to utility owners are tracked to completion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Relocation/outage requests logged with confirmed completion date before conflicting work proceeds.

items.text: Verify coordination meeting held with all utility stakeholders prior to major utility work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Meeting minutes distributed identifying conflicts, sequencing, and responsible parties.

items.text: Confirm as-built records are requested from utility owners for existing lines lacking documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Record drawings obtained or noted as unavailable with risk documented.

items.text: Verify exposed utilities are supported, protected, or shored during adjacent excavation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cradling, banding, or support installed per utility owner standard when exposed.

items.text: Confirm damage to any utility during excavation is reported immediately per protocol.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility owner and emergency services notified immediately for any strike or damage.

items.text: Verify temporary utility protection (plating, barricades) remains in place until backfill.
items.acceptance_criteria: Protection measures inspected daily and remain intact through active work period.

items.text: Confirm minimum clearance is maintained between new work and existing utility crossings per code/utility standard.
items.acceptance_criteria: Vertical/horizontal clearance meets utility owner's minimum separation standard.

items.text: Verify new utility installation sequencing avoids conflicts with other trades' work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility installation sequence reviewed against overall project schedule for conflicts.

items.text: Confirm inspection/testing by utility owner or AHJ is scheduled before backfill.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspection request submitted with adequate lead time before trench closure.

items.text: Verify tracer wire or locating tape is installed with new non-metallic utility lines.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tracer wire continuity tested and locating tape placed 12-18 in above line.

items.text: Confirm as-built survey/GPS data is captured for new utility installations before backfill.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey shots or GPS coordinates logged for all new utility runs prior to cover.

items.text: Compile all locate tickets, potholing records, and utility correspondence into project file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete utility coordination file archived in document control.

items.text: Verify updated utility as-built drawings are submitted to owner/engineer.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-builts reflect field-verified utility locations and depths.

items.text: Obtain superintendent sign-off confirming utility coordination is complete for the phase of work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature obtained before proceeding to next construction phase affecting utilities.

templates.name: Tree Protection Measures Checklist
templates.description: Establishes and monitors tree protection zones, root zone safeguards, and construction restrictions to preserve designated trees per ANSI A300 practices.
prerequisites: Certified arborist tree assessment completed
Approved tree protection plan

items.text: Verify certified arborist assessment identifies trees to be preserved and their condition.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tree inventory documents species, DBH, condition rating, and preservation priority.

items.text: Confirm tree protection plan is included in approved construction documents.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plan shows tree protection zone (TPZ) boundaries matching arborist recommendations.

items.text: Verify trees to be removed vs. preserved are clearly identified and flagged in the field.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field flagging matches approved tree disposition plan with no discrepancies.

items.text: Confirm critical root zone (CRZ) radius is calculated per trunk diameter for each protected tree.
items.acceptance_criteria: CRZ calculated at minimum 1 ft radius per inch of DBH, adjusted for species and soil.

items.text: Verify tree protection fencing is installed at the drip line or CRZ boundary before any site work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fencing installed and inspected prior to mobilization, grading, or demolition.

items.text: Confirm fencing is a rigid, highly visible material (chain link or equivalent) and remains intact.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fencing minimum 4 ft high, orange or high-visibility, anchored and not easily moved.

items.text: Verify tree protection zone signage is posted at intervals along the fence line.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signage reads 'Tree Protection Zone - No Entry' visible at max 50 ft spacing.

items.text: Confirm no storage of materials, equipment, or spoil occurs within the tree protection zone.
items.acceptance_criteria: Zero observed encroachment of materials or equipment inside fenced TPZ.

items.text: Verify no trenching or excavation occurs within the critical root zone without arborist approval.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any CRZ excavation pre-approved in writing by project arborist with mitigation method specified.

items.text: Confirm root pruning, where required, is performed cleanly by or under supervision of a qualified arborist.
items.acceptance_criteria: Roots cut cleanly with sharp tools; no ripping or crushing observed.

items.text: Verify soil compaction within the root zone is prevented via mats, plywood, or exclusion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ground protection mats used for any authorized equipment access through TPZ.

items.text: Confirm grade changes (cut or fill) within the root zone are avoided or mitigated per arborist recommendation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No more than arborist-approved depth of fill or cut occurs within CRZ.

items.text: Verify irrigation to protected trees is maintained or a temporary watering plan is implemented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Supplemental watering schedule maintained through construction per arborist recommendation.

items.text: Verify no washout of concrete, paint, or chemicals occurs near or within the tree protection zone.
items.acceptance_criteria: Zero observed washout activity within 50 ft of any protected tree.

items.text: Confirm no vehicle parking, fueling, or maintenance occurs within the tree protection zone.
items.acceptance_criteria: No vehicles or equipment observed staged/parked inside TPZ fencing.

items.text: Verify no attachment of signs, cables, or equipment directly to tree trunks or limbs.
items.acceptance_criteria: No nails, screws, or wraps observed on protected tree trunks or branches.

items.text: Confirm pruning of branches for clearance is performed per ANSI A300 standards by a qualified arborist.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pruning cuts made at branch collar; no more than 25% of live crown removed in one season.

items.text: Verify tree protection fencing is inspected weekly and after storm events for damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Weekly inspection log shows fencing intact with repairs made within 24 hours of damage.

items.text: Confirm tree health is monitored periodically by arborist during construction (canopy, leaf color, pests).
items.acceptance_criteria: Arborist site visit log shows periodic health assessments through construction duration.

items.text: Verify any tree damage incidents are reported and remediation plan is implemented promptly.
items.acceptance_criteria: Damage reported within 24 hours; arborist-recommended remediation initiated within 5 days.

items.text: Compile tree protection inspection logs and arborist reports into the project record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete log maintained from mobilization through fencing removal.

items.text: Verify photographic documentation of tree condition exists at project start and completion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Baseline and closeout photos on file for each protected tree.

items.text: Obtain landscape architect/arborist and superintendent sign-off on tree protection compliance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained at project milestones per tree protection plan.

templates.name: Vegetation Removal Compliance Checklist
templates.description: Confirms permitting, environmental review, safe removal methods, and erosion control are in place before and during land clearing and vegetation removal operations.
prerequisites: Land clearing permit issued
Environmental/habitat survey completed

items.text: Verify land clearing/vegetation removal permit is issued by the local jurisdiction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit number matches approved clearing limits on site plan.

items.text: Confirm tree removal permits are obtained for regulated or protected species/sizes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit lists specific trees approved for removal by tag number or location.

items.text: Verify wetland/environmental permits are secured if clearing affects delineated wetland buffers.
items.acceptance_criteria: Army Corps/state wetland permit on file if clearing within mapped buffer.

items.text: Confirm seasonal restrictions (nesting season, migratory bird windows) are reviewed and observed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Clearing schedule avoids restricted dates or nesting survey completed per local ordinance.

items.text: Verify pre-clearing survey for protected species (nests, dens, endangered species) is completed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Qualified biologist survey completed within required window before clearing.

items.text: Confirm buffer zones for streams, wetlands, or sensitive habitats are flagged and observed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Buffer flagging matches approved environmental plan; no clearing inside buffer.

items.text: Verify invasive species removal, if part of scope, follows approved disposal method to prevent spread.
items.acceptance_criteria: Invasive material bagged/disposed per jurisdiction protocol, not left on site or mulched on-site.

items.text: Confirm limits of clearing are staked/flagged in the field matching approved plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field flagging verified by survey against approved clearing limit line.

items.text: Verify equipment used for clearing is appropriate for terrain and does not exceed approved disturbance limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Equipment operates only within staked clearing limits; no excursions observed.

items.text: Confirm chainsaw and equipment operators use required PPE for clearing operations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Chaps, hard hat, eye/ear protection, and cut-resistant gloves worn during chainsaw operation.

items.text: Verify felling operations maintain safe distance (minimum 2 tree lengths) from workers and structures.
items.acceptance_criteria: Exclusion zone maintained at minimum 2x tree height during felling operations.

items.text: Confirm trees adjacent to overhead utility lines are handled by qualified line-clearance personnel.
items.acceptance_criteria: Line-clearance arborist or utility-coordinated crew used within 10 ft of energized lines.

items.text: Verify erosion and sediment control BMPs are installed prior to clearing operations beginning.
items.acceptance_criteria: Silt fence/sediment barriers installed at downslope limits before first tree is cleared.

items.text: Confirm clearing is phased to limit exposed soil area at any given time where required by permit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Disturbed area at any time does not exceed permit-specified maximum acreage.

items.text: Verify stockpiled cleared material does not block drainage paths or BMPs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Debris stockpiles located outside of drainage flow paths and away from BMPs.

items.text: Verify cleared vegetation debris is disposed of, chipped, or mulched per permit/local requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Disposal method matches permit conditions; no open burning without separate permit.

items.text: Confirm stumps and root balls are removed or ground per grading plan requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stump removal depth matches geotechnical/grading plan specification.

items.text: Verify disposal tickets or manifests are retained for debris hauled off site.
items.acceptance_criteria: Haul tickets logged with facility name, quantity, and date for each load.

items.text: Confirm site is left free of scattered debris and hazards after clearing operations conclude.
items.acceptance_criteria: Walkthrough confirms no loose limbs, stumps, or debris pose trip/fire hazard.

items.text: Compile permits, environmental survey reports, and disposal records into the project file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete vegetation removal compliance package archived in document control.

items.text: Verify any required post-clearing environmental notifications are submitted to the jurisdiction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Completion notice filed within required timeframe after clearing concludes.

items.text: Obtain environmental compliance officer and superintendent sign-off on vegetation removal completion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained before grading or subsequent construction phase begins.

templates.name: Foundation Excavation Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that foundation excavations are cut to the correct line, grade, and bearing condition, and that excavation safety controls are in place before footing or foundation placement begins.
prerequisites: Approved foundation/footing drawings on site
Geotechnical report reviewed
Utility locates (call-before-you-dig) completed

items.text: Confirm underground utility locates are marked and current.
items.acceptance_criteria: All utility markings visible and within the valid ticket window (typically 10-14 days per local one-call rules).

items.text: Verify excavation permit and competent person designation on file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written designation of competent person present; permit posted if required by AHJ.

items.text: Confirm layout stakes/batter boards match approved foundation plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stake locations within +/-0.05 ft of plan coordinates.

items.text: Verify erosion and sediment controls installed around excavation perimeter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Silt fence/inlet protection installed per SWPPP prior to soil disturbance.

items.text: Check for surface water diversion around excavation limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Positive drainage away from open excavation; no ponding at edges.

items.text: Verify excavation length and width against footing/foundation dimensions plus working clearance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 18-24 in. working clearance beyond footing edge unless formwork requires less.

items.text: Verify bottom-of-excavation elevation by survey shot.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation within +/-0.10 ft of design subgrade unless plans specify tighter tolerance.

items.text: Confirm excavation side slopes or shoring conform to soil classification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slope ratio matches OSHA soil type (Type A 3/4:1, Type B 1:1, Type C 1.5:1) or protective system engineered.

items.text: Check that excavation is free of loose, sloughed, or frozen material at bearing surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bearing surface firm, undisturbed native soil or engineered fill; no loose spoil.

items.text: Verify no over-excavation beyond design bottom elevation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Over-excavation greater than 6 in. requires engineer-approved backfill with compacted structural fill.

items.text: Confirm soil bearing capacity observed matches geotechnical report assumption.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bearing stratum consistent with report; no soft spots, organics, or fill material exposed.

items.text: Perform proof-rolling or hand-probe of subgrade where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible pumping, rutting, or deflection under proof-roll load.

items.text: Verify groundwater is not present at or above bearing elevation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bearing surface dry or dewatered; no standing water in excavation.

items.text: Confirm geotechnical engineer has inspected and approved bearing surface (if required by plans).
items.acceptance_criteria: Written approval or field report from geotechnical engineer of record on file.

items.text: Check for undocumented fill, debris, or organic material in excavation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No topsoil, roots, debris, or undocumented fill remaining within bearing zone.

items.text: Verify means of egress provided for excavations 4 ft or deeper.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ladder, ramp, or stairway within 25 ft of lateral travel for workers in excavation.

items.text: Confirm spoil piles and equipment are set back from excavation edge.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spoil and materials stored at least 2 ft from excavation edge.

items.text: Verify barricades, warning signage, or fencing around open excavation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Physical barrier or signage present on all sides accessible to personnel/public.

items.text: Confirm daily competent person inspection log is current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspection log entries current for today and after any precipitation event.

items.text: Check adjacent structures/utilities for signs of undermining or settlement.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible cracking, settlement, or exposed undermined utilities adjacent to excavation.

items.text: Record as-built bottom-of-excavation elevations at grid points.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation data logged at minimum 4 corners and center or per plan grid.

items.text: Attach geotechnical bearing approval letter or field report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Document attached to project record prior to concrete placement.

items.text: Photograph excavation bottom and side conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 4 photos covering full excavation extent and bearing surface.

items.text: Inspector sign-off recorded prior to footing formwork or blinding placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file before next construction stage proceeds.

items.text: Superintendent acknowledges excavation ready for next stage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Superintendent signature confirms readiness for blinding/formwork.

templates.name: Cut & Fill Balance Verification Checklist
templates.description: Confirms that earthwork cut and fill quantities, haul routes, and mass-grading sequencing match the approved earthwork plan and that on-site balance calculations are tracked accurately.
prerequisites: Approved mass grading/earthwork plan
Cut/fill quantity takeoff or earthwork balance report

items.text: Confirm current earthwork plan revision matches quantity takeoff used for balance calculation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plan revision date/number matches takeoff document referenced.

items.text: Verify cut and fill volumes calculated from same datum and survey control.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cut/fill volumes referenced to single consistent benchmark and coordinate system.

items.text: Check shrinkage/swell factors applied are appropriate for soil type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Shrinkage/swell factor sourced from geotechnical report or accepted local values, documented in calculation.

items.text: Confirm topsoil strip volume excluded from structural cut/fill balance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Topsoil volume tracked separately from engineered cut/fill quantities.

items.text: Verify unsuitable material (organics, debris, oversize rock) quantity estimated and excluded from reusable fill volume.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unsuitable material volume documented and removed from balance as export.

items.text: Cross-section or grid-shoot cut areas against design subgrade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field elevations within +/-0.10 ft of design cut elevation.

items.text: Verify cut slopes constructed at design ratio.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slope within +/-5% of design ratio (e.g., 2:1 or 3:1) per plan.

items.text: Confirm cut material suitability for reuse as fill (gradation, moisture, organics).
items.acceptance_criteria: Material meets specified fill gradation/plasticity limits per geotech spec.

items.text: Verify benching of cut slopes on existing grades steeper than 5H:1V where fill will be placed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Horizontal benches minimum 4 ft wide cut into existing slope before fill placement.

items.text: Cross-section or grid-shoot fill areas against design finish subgrade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field elevations within +/-0.10 ft of design fill elevation.

items.text: Confirm fill placed in lifts of specified maximum thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: Loose lift thickness does not exceed 8-12 in. unless equipment/spec allows otherwise.

items.text: Verify compaction testing performed and passing at each fill lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 95% of maximum dry density (standard or modified Proctor as specified) per lift.

items.text: Confirm fill slopes constructed at design ratio and compacted to face.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slope face compacted; ratio within +/-5% of design ratio.

items.text: Verify haul routes approved and do not cross incomplete utility trenches or unstable areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Haul route matches traffic control plan; no conflicts with open trenches.

items.text: Confirm on-site stockpile locations do not encroach on wetlands, buffers, or drainage ways.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stockpiles located outside setback/buffer zones per permit.

items.text: Verify truck loads or haul tickets tracked to reconcile actual export/import volumes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Daily haul ticket count reconciles with running cut/fill balance log within 5%.

items.text: Check dust control measures active on haul roads and active cut/fill areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Water truck or equivalent dust suppression in use during dry/windy conditions.

items.text: Compare running cumulative cut vs. fill quantities to plan projection.
items.acceptance_criteria: Running balance within 5-10% of planned cut/fill ratio at each milestone.

items.text: Identify and document any import/export volume triggered by unforeseen conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Change documented with cause, volume, and cost/schedule impact noted.

items.text: Verify updated earthwork balance report issued to project team at each phase.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report issued matches current field conditions and survey data.

items.text: Confirm final mass grading tie-in elevations match adjacent completed grading.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tie-in elevations within +/-0.10 ft of adjacent finished grade.

items.text: Attach final cut/fill quantity summary and survey cross-sections.
items.acceptance_criteria: Document set includes original, current, and design surfaces.

items.text: Record any approved plan changes affecting balance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Change order or RFI reference number logged.

items.text: Engineer of record confirms balance reconciliation is acceptable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written acceptance on file prior to demobilization of grading equipment.

items.text: Superintendent sign-off on completed mass grading.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature confirms grading complete and ready for next construction phase.

templates.name: Soil Compaction Verification Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that placed soil or engineered fill achieves specified density and moisture content through proper testing methods, frequency, and documentation.
prerequisites: Approved geotechnical report with compaction specification
Proctor curve(s) established for fill material

items.text: Confirm laboratory Proctor curve is current for the material being tested.
items.acceptance_criteria: Proctor test (ASTM D698 or D1557) performed on representative sample within project material source change.

items.text: Verify test method specified matches contract requirement (standard vs. modified Proctor).
items.acceptance_criteria: Method matches project specification (D698 standard or D1557 modified).

items.text: Confirm nuclear density gauge or approved alternative is calibrated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calibration/standardization count within manufacturer tolerance, performed same day.

items.text: Verify lift is uniform in thickness and free of oversize material before testing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lift thickness does not exceed 8-12 in. loose; no particles larger than 2/3 of lift thickness.

items.text: Perform in-place density test at required frequency per lift/area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum one test per 2,500 sf per lift or per specification frequency, whichever is more frequent.

items.text: Record wet density and calculate dry density using moisture correction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Dry density calculated per gauge moisture reading or oven-dry correlation.

items.text: Verify percent compaction meets specified minimum relative to maximum dry density.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 95% of maximum dry density (Proctor) in structural fill zones; 90% in non-structural areas unless specified otherwise.

items.text: Verify in-place moisture content within specified range of optimum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Moisture within -2% to +2% of optimum moisture content unless spec states otherwise.

items.text: Confirm test locations are randomized and representative of lift area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test locations selected per random or grid pattern, not selected by contractor.

items.text: Re-test and document any failing area after recompaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Retest performed after moisture conditioning/recompaction; passing result recorded before next lift.

items.text: Verify each lift is approved before placement of subsequent lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Density test result reviewed and passing before next lift placed.

items.text: Confirm fill material matches approved source/gradation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material gradation consistent with approved submittal; no visible contamination.

items.text: Check compaction equipment type is suited to soil type (e.g., sheepsfoot for cohesive, vibratory for granular).
items.acceptance_criteria: Equipment matches geotechnical recommendation for material type.

items.text: Verify adequate number of compactor passes achieved per lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Passes meet contractor's approved compaction method or test-strip results.

items.text: Confirm no soft, yielding, or pumping areas remain after compaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible deflection or rutting under proof-roll or equipment traffic.

items.text: Verify fill is not placed on frozen, saturated, or muddy subgrade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Subgrade free of frost, standing water, and visibly saturated soil.

items.text: Confirm moisture conditioning (wetting/drying) performed as needed before compaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Soil moisture adjusted to within specified range before compactive effort applied.

items.text: Check fill surface is sealed/rolled at end of shift if rain is forecast.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface bladed and rolled smooth to shed water before work stoppage.

items.text: Log all density test results with location, elevation, and lift number.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test log includes station/offset or coordinate, lift number, and pass/fail result.

items.text: Attach compaction test summary report to project record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Summary report includes all tests, Proctor reference, and cumulative pass rate.

items.text: Photograph test locations and gauge readings for failing tests.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo documentation attached for each failed and retested location.

items.text: Testing technician and superintendent sign off on lift acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures present before proceeding to next construction phase.

templates.name: Backfilling and Compaction Checklist (around foundation)
templates.description: Verifies proper material selection, lift control, compaction, and drainage protection during backfilling operations around completed foundation walls and footings.
prerequisites: Foundation concrete achieved minimum strength for backfill loading
Waterproofing/damp-proofing inspected and approved
Approved backfill material source

items.text: Confirm foundation concrete has reached minimum strength to resist backfill and equipment loads.
items.acceptance_criteria: Concrete strength at least 70% of design strength or per engineer's written approval before backfill.

items.text: Verify waterproofing, damp-proofing, or drainage board is installed and undamaged.
items.acceptance_criteria: Membrane/coating continuous with no tears, punctures, or holidays visible.

items.text: Confirm foundation drain (footing drain) installed and inspected before backfill covers it.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drain pipe sloped minimum 1% (1/8 in. per ft), wrapped in filter fabric, and connected to outlet/sump.

items.text: Verify bracing or shoring remains in place until backfill provides lateral support, or engineer approves removal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wall bracing not removed until backfill placed to engineer-specified height or floor diaphragm in place.

items.text: Confirm excavation is free of debris, forms, organic material before backfill placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: No wood, trash, or organic debris left against foundation wall or in backfill zone.

items.text: Verify backfill material meets specified gradation and plasticity requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material free of debris, organics, frozen clods, and stones larger than 3 in. (or per spec) within 2 ft of structure.

items.text: Confirm select granular material used adjacent to foundation walls where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Free-draining granular backfill placed within specified zone (e.g., 12-24 in. from wall).

items.text: Verify no expansive or highly plastic clay used as backfill against foundation unless engineered for it.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plasticity index within limits specified by geotechnical report.

items.text: Confirm backfill placed in controlled lifts of specified maximum thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: Loose lift thickness not exceeding 8 in. for hand-operated compaction equipment near walls.

items.text: Verify backfill is placed and compacted evenly on both sides of walls where applicable to avoid unbalanced lateral loads.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lift elevation difference between opposite sides not exceeding 2 ft unless engineer approves.

items.text: Confirm compaction equipment used near foundation walls does not induce excessive lateral pressure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Only hand-guided/walk-behind compactors used within 3 ft of wall unless engineer approves heavier equipment.

items.text: Verify in-place density testing performed at specified frequency.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 95% of maximum dry density achieved per ASTM D1557/D698 in structural backfill zones.

items.text: Confirm moisture content within specified range at time of compaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Moisture within -2% to +2% of optimum unless specified otherwise.

items.text: Check backfill is kept clear of utility penetrations and sleeves without displacement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sleeves, conduits, and pipe penetrations remain in original position and undamaged after backfill.

items.text: Verify finish grade slopes away from foundation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum slope of 5% (6 in. drop over first 10 ft) away from foundation per code, unless site constraints require alternate drainage.

items.text: Confirm final backfill elevation matches design grade at foundation wall.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation within +/-0.10 ft of design finish grade at wall line.

items.text: Verify no ponding or depressions remain adjacent to foundation after grading.
items.acceptance_criteria: No standing water within 10 ft of foundation after test irrigation or rainfall.

items.text: Record backfill density test results by location and lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test log includes wall segment, lift number, and pass/fail result.

items.text: Photograph drainage system and waterproofing prior to backfill cover.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos taken before each wall segment is covered by backfill.

items.text: Attach compaction test summary to project closeout record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Summary includes all test results and pass rate for backfill zone.

items.text: Superintendent and inspector sign off on completed backfill.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures on file before floor slab or hardscape installation proceeds.

templates.name: Grade Control & Survey Accuracy Checklist
templates.description: Confirms that horizontal and vertical control points, staking, and machine-control data used for grading operations are accurate, current, and traceable to project benchmarks.
prerequisites: Approved grading/site plan with design elevations
Established project benchmark and control network

items.text: Confirm project benchmark elevation and datum match approved plans.
items.acceptance_criteria: Benchmark elevation verified against two independent control points within 0.02 ft.

items.text: Verify horizontal control points are undisturbed and referenced to plan coordinate system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Control point coordinates match plan within survey tolerance (typically +/-0.02 ft).

items.text: Confirm GPS base station or total station setup checked against known control before use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Instrument check-in shows less than 0.02 ft deviation from known point.

items.text: Verify machine control (GPS/GNSS grading system) calibration and design file are current revision.
items.acceptance_criteria: Design file version matches latest approved plan set; calibration performed same day.

items.text: Verify grade stakes, hubs, or offset stakes match plan station and offset.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stake location within +/-0.10 ft horizontal of plan.

items.text: Confirm cut/fill information marked on stakes is legible and current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stake markings match most recent design elevation revision.

items.text: Verify slope stakes reflect correct catch points for design slope ratios.
items.acceptance_criteria: Catch point within +/-0.5 ft horizontal of calculated slope intercept.

items.text: Confirm building corner and column line stakes verified by independent check shot.
items.acceptance_criteria: Independent check shows agreement within +/-0.02 ft of layout coordinates.

items.text: Perform grid or cross-section shots on rough grade surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rough grade elevations within +/-0.10 ft of design subgrade.

items.text: Perform grid or cross-section shots on finish grade surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: Finish grade elevations within +/-0.05 ft of design elevation for paved areas; +/-0.10 ft for landscape areas.

items.text: Verify positive drainage slopes achieved across graded areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1-2% slope maintained across paved/landscape areas per plan, no reverse-grade pockets.

items.text: Confirm drainage swale and ditch inverts match design flow line elevations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Invert elevations within +/-0.05 ft of design flow line.

items.text: Spot-check machine-control blade elevation against independent survey shot.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blade elevation agrees with survey check within +/-0.05 ft.

items.text: Verify GNSS correction signal is stable during grading operation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No loss-of-fix events logged during the shift beyond momentary dropouts.

items.text: Confirm design surface model matches current approved plan revision.
items.acceptance_criteria: Model revision date matches latest issued-for-construction plan set.

items.text: Record as-built grid/cross-section survey data.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey data file attached with point IDs, coordinates, and elevations.

items.text: Log discrepancies between design and as-built grades exceeding tolerance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Discrepancy report includes location, magnitude, and corrective action.

items.text: Attach benchmark and control point verification records.
items.acceptance_criteria: Records include date, instrument used, and closure error.

items.text: Surveyor and superintendent sign off on grade acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures on file before next construction phase begins.

templates.name: Topsoil Salvage & Stockpiling Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that topsoil is properly identified, stripped, quantified, and stockpiled in a manner that preserves soil quality and complies with erosion and sediment control requirements.
prerequisites: Approved grading/erosion control plan showing stockpile locations
SWPPP in effect

items.text: Verify topsoil strip limits match approved grading/erosion control plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Strip limits staked and match plan within +/-2 ft.

items.text: Confirm designated stockpile locations are outside wetlands, buffers, and drainage ways.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stockpile sites located outside regulated buffer setbacks per permit.

items.text: Verify stockpile area has perimeter sediment control installed before stripping begins.
items.acceptance_criteria: Silt fence or equivalent BMP installed downslope of stockpile prior to material placement.

items.text: Confirm estimated topsoil volume calculated from strip depth and area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Volume estimate documented and reconciled against measured stockpile volume within 10%.

items.text: Verify topsoil stripping depth matches field-observed organic layer depth.
items.acceptance_criteria: Strip depth captures full topsoil horizon, typically 4-12 in. or per geotechnical recommendation.

items.text: Confirm topsoil is stripped only in areas actively being graded (phased stripping).
items.acceptance_criteria: No more than the area needed for current phase of work is stripped at one time.

items.text: Verify subsoil and topsoil are not commingled during stripping.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stripping equipment operated to keep topsoil separate from underlying subsoil.

items.text: Check that stripped areas are free of debris, roots, and construction waste before subgrade work begins.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible debris or organic matter left in stripped subgrade area.

items.text: Verify stockpile height and side slope comply with plan/permit limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stockpile height typically limited to 35 ft or per local ordinance; side slopes 2:1 or flatter for stability.

items.text: Confirm stockpile is seeded, mulched, or covered if inactive more than 14 days.
items.acceptance_criteria: Temporary stabilization (seed/mulch/tarp) applied within 14 days of stockpile becoming inactive, per NPDES CGP.

items.text: Verify perimeter sediment barrier remains intact and maintained around stockpile.
items.acceptance_criteria: Silt fence/berm continuous, no gaps, sediment accumulation removed when reaching 1/3 fence height.

items.text: Confirm stockpile location does not obstruct site drainage, haul roads, or emergency access.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stockpile placement does not block designed flow paths or access routes.

items.text: Verify stockpile is free of contamination (debris, trash, invasive weed seed source) prior to future reuse.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible contamination; weed growth controlled per site maintenance plan.

items.text: Measure and record stockpile volume by survey or truck count.
items.acceptance_criteria: Volume documented and compared to original strip estimate within 10%.

items.text: Verify topsoil quality (organic content, texture) sampled if reuse for finish grading is planned.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sample results meet project specification for organic content and texture class.

items.text: Confirm stockpile inventory log updated with location, volume, and date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log entry current and accessible to grading/landscape crews.

items.text: Photograph stockpile formation and perimeter controls.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos taken at initial formation and at each site inspection interval.

items.text: Attach topsoil volume calculations and reconciliation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calculation sheet attached to project earthwork record.

items.text: Record any stabilization measures applied and dates.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log includes BMP type, application date, and inspector initials.

items.text: Superintendent sign-off confirming topsoil salvage complete and protected.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature and date on file before mass grading of stripped area proceeds.

templates.name: Topsoil Placement & Grading Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that salvaged or imported topsoil is placed at proper depth, quality, and finish grade to support planting, seeding, or landscape establishment.
prerequisites: Finish subgrade approved and accepted
Topsoil source approved (salvaged or imported)
Approved landscape/planting plan

items.text: Verify finish subgrade elevation approved before topsoil placement begins.
items.acceptance_criteria: Subgrade elevation within +/-0.10 ft of design elevation minus specified topsoil depth.

items.text: Confirm subgrade is scarified or loosened to promote bonding with topsoil.
items.acceptance_criteria: Subgrade surface scarified to minimum 2-3 in. depth immediately before topsoil placement.

items.text: Verify subgrade is free of construction debris, rock, and compacted crust.
items.acceptance_criteria: No debris or oversize rock (greater than 2 in.) visible at subgrade surface.

items.text: Confirm subsurface drainage (if specified) is installed and functional before topsoil placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drain lines tested/flushed and functioning prior to cover.

items.text: Verify topsoil source meets specified quality (texture, organic matter, pH, no contaminants).
items.acceptance_criteria: Test results meet project specification (typical loam texture, organic matter 3-10%, pH 5.5-7.5 unless specified otherwise).

items.text: Confirm topsoil is free of debris, roots larger than 1 in., weeds, and stones larger than 1-2 in.
items.acceptance_criteria: Visual inspection shows material within specified gradation/cleanliness limits.

items.text: Verify imported topsoil delivery tickets match approved source and quantity ordered.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delivery tickets reference approved source location and match quantity log.

items.text: Verify topsoil placed at specified minimum depth.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum depth 4 in. for turf areas, 6-18 in. for planting beds/trees, or per plan.

items.text: Confirm topsoil placed in areas with adequate moisture (not excessively wet or dry).
items.acceptance_criteria: Soil workable without clodding or dust generation during spreading.

items.text: Verify topsoil is not over-compacted during placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Only lightweight equipment or hand tools used for final spreading in planting areas.

items.text: Check depth uniformity by probe or test pit at representative locations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Depth verified within +/-1 in. of specified depth at minimum 3 locations per acre.

items.text: Verify finish grade elevation matches design plan after topsoil placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation within +/-0.10 ft of design finish grade.

items.text: Confirm positive drainage maintained across topsoil-covered areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1-2% slope maintained; no ponding or reverse-grade areas.

items.text: Verify finish grade transitions smoothly to adjacent pavement, curbs, and structures.
items.acceptance_criteria: No abrupt grade breaks or trip hazards at transitions; grade meets curb/walk within 1 in.

items.text: Confirm surface is raked/floated smooth and free of clods, debris, or ruts before seeding/planting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface ready for seed bed preparation with no clumps larger than 2 in.

items.text: Verify temporary stabilization (seed, mulch, or blanket) applied promptly after topsoil placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stabilization applied within 14 days of final grading per NPDES CGP, or sooner per local requirement.

items.text: Confirm erosion control blankets or matting anchored per manufacturer spec on slopes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blanket staked/anchored at spacing per manufacturer installation guide; no gaps or lifting.

items.text: Record topsoil depth verification results by location.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log includes location, measured depth, and pass/fail against spec.

items.text: Attach topsoil quality test report and delivery tickets.
items.acceptance_criteria: Documents attached to project closeout record.

items.text: Photograph finished topsoil grading prior to seeding/planting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos cover representative areas and any problem spots noted.

items.text: Superintendent sign-off confirming topsoil placement and grading complete.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature and date on file before seeding/planting operations begin.

templates.name: Erosion and Sediment Control Implementation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that best management practices (BMPs) required by the SWPPP are properly installed, maintained, and inspected to control erosion and sediment discharge from active construction areas.
prerequisites: Approved SWPPP and site map
NPDES Construction General Permit coverage confirmed
NOI filed with regulatory agency

items.text: Verify NPDES Construction General Permit coverage is active and posted/available on site.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit/NOI documentation available on site or accessible electronically.

items.text: Confirm SWPPP map matches current site conditions and disturbed area limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: SWPPP site map updated to reflect current phase within last update cycle.

items.text: Verify qualified SWPPP inspector or trained personnel conducting inspections.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspector name/certification documented in SWPPP records.

items.text: Confirm inspection frequency meets permit requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspections conducted at minimum weekly and within 24 hours after a qualifying rain event (typically 0.25 in. or greater), per permit.

items.text: Verify silt fence or perimeter BMP installed along all down-gradient disturbed area boundaries.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous barrier with no gaps greater than plan-specified spacing; keyed into ground minimum 6 in.

items.text: Confirm perimeter controls are structurally sound and properly staked.
items.acceptance_criteria: Posts spaced per manufacturer spec (typically 6-8 ft); fabric not torn or undermined.

items.text: Verify sediment accumulation behind barriers is removed before reaching design capacity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sediment removed when accumulation reaches 1/3 of barrier height.

items.text: Check construction entrance/exit has stabilized aggregate pad to reduce track-out.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stabilized construction entrance minimum 50 ft long, per plan dimensions, with clean aggregate.

items.text: Verify storm drain inlet protection installed at all active inlets receiving site runoff.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inlet protection device installed and functioning at 100% of active inlets per SWPPP map.

items.text: Confirm inlet protection is not causing excessive ponding or bypass flow.
items.acceptance_criteria: No standing water depth exceeding device design capacity; overflow routed safely.

items.text: Verify check dams or velocity dissipation installed in conveyance channels/ditches as designed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Check dam spacing and height match SWPPP design detail.

items.text: Confirm outfall/discharge points show no visible sediment plume or turbidity beyond permitted limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible sheen, turbidity plume, or sediment deposition observed at discharge point.

items.text: Verify temporary or permanent stabilization applied to disturbed areas inactive per permit timeframe.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stabilization initiated within 14 days of last disturbance (or permit-specified timeframe) where work has ceased.

items.text: Confirm erosion control blankets/matting on slopes are properly anchored with no gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blanket contact with soil continuous; staple pattern per manufacturer spec.

items.text: Verify slope drains or diversion berms direct concentrated flow away from unprotected slopes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slope drains functioning without erosion at outlet; berms continuous with no breaches.

items.text: Verify concrete washout area is designated, lined, and signed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Washout containment intact, no visible leakage or overflow.

items.text: Confirm material storage/spill prevention controls in place for fuel, chemicals.
items.acceptance_criteria: Secondary containment present for stored fuels/chemicals; spill kit accessible.

items.text: Check site is free of illicit discharges (e.g., wash water, dewatering discharge) to storm system.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unauthorized discharge observed entering storm drain or waterway.

items.text: Verify trash and construction debris are contained and not contributing to site runoff.
items.acceptance_criteria: Debris contained in covered receptacles; no loose debris near drainage paths.

items.text: Complete weekly/post-storm inspection report per permit format.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report includes date, rainfall amount (if applicable), findings, and corrective actions.

items.text: Photograph BMP condition and any deficiencies identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos attached for each deficiency with corrective action tracked to closure.

items.text: Log corrective actions with completion date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corrective action completed within 7 calendar days of identification or per permit deadline.

items.text: SWPPP inspector sign-off on inspection report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature and date on file per permit recordkeeping requirement.

templates.name: Stormwater Management Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies proper construction of permanent stormwater management facilities including detention/retention basins, bioretention areas, and conveyance systems per approved design.
prerequisites: Approved stormwater management plan/design
Geotechnical infiltration testing (if applicable)
Utility conflicts resolved

items.text: Verify installed facility type and location match approved stormwater management plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Facility location within +/-1 ft of plan coordinates; type matches design (detention, bioretention, etc.).

items.text: Confirm facility sizing (volume, footprint) matches approved hydraulic/hydrologic calculations.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-built volume within 5% of design volume.

items.text: Verify any design changes have been reviewed and approved by engineer of record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field changes documented with RFI/change order reference and engineer approval.

items.text: Verify infiltration testing performed at facility subgrade where infiltration is design basis.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured infiltration rate meets or exceeds design rate used in sizing calculation.

items.text: Confirm subgrade is not over-compacted in infiltration-based facilities.
items.acceptance_criteria: Subgrade scarified/decompacted where construction traffic caused compaction; no smearing or crusting.

items.text: Verify basin side slopes and bottom grades match design elevations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bottom elevation within +/-0.10 ft of design; side slopes within +/-5% of design ratio.

items.text: Confirm liner or impermeable barrier installed where design requires (non-infiltration facilities).
items.acceptance_criteria: Liner continuous, seams sealed per manufacturer spec, no visible punctures.

items.text: Verify outlet structure (riser, weir, orifice) installed at design elevation and dimensions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Outlet invert/crest elevation within +/-0.05 ft of design.

items.text: Confirm emergency spillway constructed at design elevation and armored per plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spillway crest elevation within +/-0.10 ft of design; rip-rap/armoring per plan gradation.

items.text: Verify inlet and outlet pipes are set at design invert elevations and slopes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pipe inverts within +/-0.05 ft of design; slope matches plan within 0.5%.

items.text: Confirm trash racks, anti-vortex devices, and access grates installed per detail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Components match design detail and are securely fastened.

items.text: Verify concrete structures achieve required strength before backfill or loading.
items.acceptance_criteria: Concrete strength at least 70% of design strength or per engineer approval before backfill.

items.text: Verify pipe bedding material and depth match specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bedding material (typically crushed stone) placed to specified depth below and around pipe haunch.

items.text: Confirm pipe joints are properly assembled and gasketed per manufacturer requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joints fully seated with no visible gaps; gasket seated correctly.

items.text: Verify trench backfill over pipe compacted in specified lift thickness without damaging pipe.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lift thickness 6-8 in. within pipe zone; density minimum 90-95% per specification.

items.text: Confirm swales and channels are stabilized per design (vegetated, riprap, or lined).
items.acceptance_criteria: Stabilization method matches plan detail and covers full channel length.

items.text: Verify engineered soil media meets specified gradation and infiltration rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Media test results meet project specification for permeability and organic content.

items.text: Confirm underdrain system (if specified) installed at correct elevation with proper wrap/filter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Underdrain slope and elevation match design; filter fabric or pea gravel envelope per detail.

items.text: Verify plant material and mulch installed per landscape plan for bioretention areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plant species, spacing, and mulch depth match approved planting plan.

items.text: Perform test flow or visual inspection of facility during/after rainfall to confirm functional drawdown.
items.acceptance_criteria: Facility drains within design drawdown time (commonly 24-72 hours for detention).

items.text: Verify no erosion, scour, or sediment deposition observed after first functional test.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible scour at inlet/outlet or unexpected sediment accumulation in facility.

items.text: Attach as-built survey of facility grades, structures, and pipe inverts.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-built data set includes all critical elevations referenced in design.

items.text: Record infiltration/functional test results.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test data logged with date, method, and result compared to design.

items.text: Photograph completed facility including outlet structure and stabilization.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos cover full facility extent and all structural components.

items.text: Engineer of record and superintendent sign off on facility acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures on file before facility is placed into service.

templates.name: Sub-base Preparation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that subgrade and sub-base course preparation for pavements, slabs, or structures meets specified material, compaction, and grade tolerances before subsequent course placement.
prerequisites: Approved pavement/slab section design
Subgrade proof-rolled and accepted
Material source approval for sub-base aggregate

items.text: Verify subgrade proof-rolled with loaded vehicle to identify soft/yielding areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible rutting, pumping, or deflection greater than 1 in. under proof-roll load.

items.text: Confirm subgrade compacted to specified density before sub-base placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 95% of maximum dry density (standard Proctor) or per project specification.

items.text: Verify subgrade elevation matches design minus specified pavement/sub-base section thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation within +/-0.05 ft of design subgrade.

items.text: Confirm subgrade is free of organic material, debris, and soft pockets.
items.acceptance_criteria: No organics, debris, or undocumented soft spots present at surface.

items.text: Verify subgrade moisture content is within acceptable range for compaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Moisture within -2% to +2% of optimum moisture content.

items.text: Confirm sub-base aggregate gradation matches approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gradation test results within specified gradation band per submittal.

items.text: Verify sub-base material free of deleterious materials (clay lumps, organics, oversize particles).
items.acceptance_criteria: Material visually free of contamination; oversize particles do not exceed spec limit.

items.text: Confirm delivery tickets match approved source and quantity for each load.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ticket source matches approved submittal; quantities logged against estimate.

items.text: Verify sub-base placed in lifts not exceeding specified maximum loose thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: Loose lift thickness not exceeding 6-8 in. per lift unless heavy compaction equipment/spec allows more.

items.text: Confirm each lift compacted and tested before placing subsequent lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Density test passing before next lift placed; no lift skipped.

items.text: Verify sub-base material moisture-conditioned as needed prior to compaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Moisture adjusted to within specified range before compactive effort.

items.text: Perform in-place density testing at specified frequency per lift/area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum one test per 2,500-5,000 sf per lift or per specification frequency.

items.text: Verify percent compaction meets specified minimum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 95-100% of maximum dry density per ASTM D1557 for pavement sub-base (per project spec).

items.text: Confirm re-test and document any failing area after recompaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Retest passing result recorded before proceeding.

items.text: Verify finished sub-base surface elevation within specified tolerance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface within +/-0.03 ft (3/8 in.) of design elevation under a 10 ft straightedge for paving applications.

items.text: Confirm cross-slope of sub-base surface matches design for drainage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cross-slope within +/-0.5% of design slope.

items.text: Verify surface is free of loose material, ruts, or segregation before next course placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible ruts, loose aggregate windrows, or segregated material at surface.

items.text: Confirm sub-base kept free of standing water and protected from traffic damage before paving/slab placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: No ponded water or visible rutting from construction traffic prior to next course.

items.text: Log compaction test results by location, lift, and pass/fail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test log includes station/offset, lift number, and density result.

items.text: Attach gradation and material source approval documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Documents attached to project material submittal record.

items.text: Photograph finished sub-base surface prior to next course placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos cover representative areas and any repaired sections.

items.text: Superintendent and inspector sign off on sub-base acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signatures on file before pavement/slab course placement begins.

templates.name: Concrete Mix Design Verification Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that a submitted concrete mix design meets project specifications, exposure requirements, and code requirements before the mix is approved for use on site.
prerequisites: Project specifications and structural drawings on hand
Batch plant mix design submittal package received

items.text: Confirm mix design submittal includes proportions for all materials by weight per cubic yard.
items.acceptance_criteria: Submittal lists cement, SCMs, coarse/fine aggregate, water, and each admixture in lb/yd3 or kg/m3.

items.text: Verify mix design is signed and sealed or certified by a qualified mix design laboratory.
items.acceptance_criteria: Submittal bears lab certification or engineer stamp per contract requirements.

items.text: Confirm mix design number/ID matches the concrete element or placement it is submitted for.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mix ID on submittal matches mix schedule on structural drawings for the intended element.

items.text: Verify source and documentation for each aggregate, cementitious material, and admixture is included.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material source statements, mill certificates, and admixture data sheets are attached.

items.text: Verify specified 28-day compressive strength (f'c) matches structural drawing requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mix design f'c equals or exceeds drawing f'c for the designated element.

items.text: Confirm required average compressive strength (f'cr) is calculated with an approved statistical method or overdesign margin.
items.acceptance_criteria: f'cr documented per ACI 301 Table 4.2.3.4a/b or standard deviation method with adequate test record.

items.text: Verify maximum water-cementitious materials ratio (w/cm) meets exposure class requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: w/cm at or below the maximum allowed for the governing exposure category (e.g., 0.45 for freeze-thaw, 0.40 for chloride exposure).

items.text: Confirm minimum cementitious content meets project specification or exposure class minimum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cementitious content equal to or greater than specified minimum lb/yd3.

items.text: Verify air content range is appropriate for freeze-thaw exposure and maximum aggregate size.
