items.text: Verify overall frame squareness by diagonal measurement comparison.
items.acceptance_criteria: Diagonal measurements within +/-1/4 in. of each other for a typical bay.

items.text: Check building corner plumbness over the full erected height.
items.acceptance_criteria: Out-of-plumb not exceeding 1:500 of height, 2 in. maximum.

items.text: Verify temporary bracing is installed and effective prior to alignment release.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bracing installed per the erection plan before releasing crane or alignment aids.

items.text: Confirm alignment survey is performed before permanent bolt-up or final welding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey complete and within tolerance before connections are made permanent.

items.text: Record as-erected survey data for column lines and elevations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey data logged and archived for the structural record.

items.text: Photograph alignment survey setups and out-of-tolerance conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos document any deviations and corrective measures.

items.text: Inspector sign-off confirming alignment within tolerance before final connections.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file prior to permanent bolt-up or final welding.

items.text: Superintendent acknowledges the frame is ready for the next erection lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature confirms readiness for the subsequent lift.

templates.name: Welding Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Verifies structural field welding is performed by qualified welders using approved WPS, and that completed welds meet AWS D1.1 visual and nondestructive testing acceptance criteria.
prerequisites: Approved WPS and PQR on file
Welder qualification records verified
Structural steel erection drawings on site

items.text: Verify welder certification is current for the process, position, and material.
items.acceptance_criteria: Welder qualification test record on file, tested within a 6-month continuity period.

items.text: Confirm the WPS is approved and available at the work location.
items.acceptance_criteria: WPS available and matches the joint detail and material group being welded.

items.text: Verify base material matches the WPS qualified range (thickness, grade).
items.acceptance_criteria: Material thickness and grade fall within PQR qualified limits.

items.text: Check filler metal matches the WPS specification (classification, diameter).
items.acceptance_criteria: Filler metal certifications match the specified AWS classification (e.g., E70XX).

items.text: Verify welding equipment (ammeter/voltmeter) is calibrated if required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calibration current within the manufacturer or contract interval.

items.text: Verify joint root opening and bevel angle match the WPS.
items.acceptance_criteria: Root opening within +/-1/16 in. of the WPS value; bevel angle within +/-5 degrees.

items.text: Check base metal surfaces are free of mill scale, rust, oil, or moisture within 3 in. of the weld.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surfaces clean per AWS D1.1 requirements before arc is struck.

items.text: Verify backing bars or backup material match the WPS requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Backing type and fit match the approved WPS.

items.text: Confirm tack welds meet the same quality requirements as the final weld.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tack welds sound, no cracks, made by a qualified welder.

items.text: Verify part alignment (misalignment) is within tolerance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Misalignment not exceeding 1/10 of thickness, 1/8 in. maximum for butt joints.

items.text: Verify minimum preheat temperature is achieved before welding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Preheat meets or exceeds AWS D1.1 Table 3.2 minimum for the material group and thickness.

items.text: Confirm preheat is measured correctly at the proper location.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured 3 in. from the weld location using a temp-indicating crayon or contact pyrometer.

items.text: Verify interpass temperature does not exceed the WPS maximum during multi-pass welding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Interpass temperature maintained below the WPS maximum (commonly 550 deg F for structural steels).

items.text: Check ambient conditions (wind, moisture) meet AWS D1.1 limits for field welding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wind shielding provided if velocity exceeds 5 mph for GMAW/FCAW-G; no welding in unprotected precipitation.

items.text: Verify welding parameters (amperage, voltage, travel speed) are within the WPS range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Observed parameters match the WPS within its stated tolerance band.

items.text: Check interpass cleaning (slag removal) between passes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slag and spatter removed prior to the subsequent pass.

items.text: Verify electrode storage and handling for low-hydrogen electrodes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Electrodes held in a rated oven; exposure time within AWS D1.1 Table 5.1 limits.

items.text: Confirm weld sequence follows the approved plan to control distortion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sequence matches the erection or welding plan.

items.text: Inspect the weld for cracks of any size.
items.acceptance_criteria: No cracks permitted.

items.text: Check weld-to-base-metal fusion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete fusion; no cold lap or overlap onto base metal.

items.text: Verify weld size or leg length meets the detail requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fillet weld leg size not less than the specified minimum, per the AWS D1.1 Table 6.1 undersize tolerance.

items.text: Inspect for undercut depth.
items.acceptance_criteria: Undercut not exceeding 1/32 in. for material under 1 in., 1/16 in. for material 1 in. and over.

items.text: Check for surface porosity.
items.acceptance_criteria: No piping porosity greater than 1/8 in.; cumulative diameter within Table 6.1 limits.

items.text: Verify weld profile (convexity/concavity) and check for overlap.
items.acceptance_criteria: Profile within AWS D1.1 acceptable limits; no overlap onto base metal.

items.text: Verify ultrasonic testing (UT) is performed on complete-joint-penetration groove welds per contract.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% UT on CJP tension welds unless a reduced scope is engineer-approved; acceptance per AWS D1.1.

items.text: Confirm MT/PT is performed where specified for base metal or weld repair areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: No relevant indications found.

items.text: Verify NDT technician certification (Level II or higher).
items.acceptance_criteria: Current certification on file matching the test method used.

items.text: Check NDT reports are logged with weld location and acceptance status.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reports cross-referenced to the erection drawing weld map.

items.text: Record weld inspection results on a weld map/log referencing joint numbers.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log complete for all welds inspected during the visit.

items.text: Photograph representative and any rejected welds with location markers.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos labeled with joint ID and defect type where applicable.

items.text: CWI sign-off approving welds for cover-up (fireproofing/decking).
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file prior to concealment.

items.text: Contractor QC representative countersigns the weld inspection report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature acknowledges findings and any required repairs.

templates.name: Bolting Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Verifies high-strength bolted connections are installed, tensioned, and inspected per the RCSC Specification for Structural Joints Using High-Strength Bolts and the approved connection details.
prerequisites: Approved connection details and bolt schedule on site
RCSC-compliant bolt/nut/washer assemblies with mill certifications
Calibrated tension verification equipment (e.g., Skidmore-Wilhelm) available for pretensioned/slip-critical joints

items.text: Verify bolt, nut, and washer assemblies match the specified ASTM F3125 grade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Markings confirm grade (e.g., Grade A325 or A490) and manufacturer identification.

items.text: Confirm rotational-capacity test reports are on file for each lot used in pretensioned joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lot RC test results show a minimum of 3 turns from snug tight without failure.

items.text: Verify bolt length is appropriate for the grip (thread engagement).
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum of one full thread beyond the nut face after installation.

items.text: Check bolts, nuts, and washers are stored properly to prevent contamination or corrosion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stored in original containers, protected from moisture and dirt.

items.text: Verify direct tension indicators (DTIs) or twist-off bolts, if used, are certified lots matching manufacturer certifications.
items.acceptance_criteria: DTI protrusion/gap dimensions verified per RCSC requirements.

items.text: Verify faying surfaces are free of dirt, burrs, and paint for slip-critical joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slip coefficient class matches the specified faying surface treatment (Class A/B); surfaces free of interference coatings.

items.text: Check hole alignment and diameter for bolt fit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Standard hole equals bolt diameter plus 1/16 in.; no elongation beyond RCSC oversize/slotted limits.

items.text: Verify plies of connected material are drawn into firm contact before tensioning.
items.acceptance_criteria: No gaps exceeding 1/16 in. between plies at bolt locations, or filler plates installed.

items.text: Confirm the connection is identified as snug-tight, pretensioned, or slip-critical per drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint category matches design documents before the installation method is selected.

items.text: Verify snug-tight condition is achieved prior to pretensioning.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plies in firm contact; snug-tight condition confirmed by full effort of an ironworker or a few impacts of an impact wrench.

items.text: Confirm bolting sequence progresses systematically from the most rigid part of the joint to the free edges.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sequence follows RCSC pattern to prevent joint distortion.

items.text: Verify the pretensioning method used (turn-of-nut, calibrated wrench, DTI, or twist-off) matches the approved method.
items.acceptance_criteria: Method matches the project specification.

items.text: For the turn-of-nut method, verify nut rotation from snug-tight matches the bolt length/grip requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rotation between 1/3 and 1 full turn per RCSC Table 8.2, depending on bolt length and surface disposition.

items.text: For direct tension indicators, verify gap closure/refusal criteria are met.
items.acceptance_criteria: Average gap at DTI protrusions 0.005 in. or less at a minimum of 50% of protrusions.

items.text: For the calibrated wrench method, verify daily calibration against a tension-measuring device.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wrench calibrated to produce tension at least 5% above the minimum specified pretension, checked daily and after each grip change.

items.text: Perform arbitration inspection with a calibrated torque wrench per RCSC procedure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sample size and reinspection torque per RCSC; bolts rotating further than specified are rejected.

items.text: Verify minimum bolt pretension is achieved for the connection size and grade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pretension meets or exceeds the RCSC minimum (e.g., 51 kips for 3/4 in. A325, 64 kips for 3/4 in. A490).

items.text: Check the percentage of bolts inspected meets the project QC sampling plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum sample size per the contract QC plan (commonly 10% or per a statistical sampling table).

items.text: Verify no bolts show thread stripping, nut/washer damage, or failure during installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Zero damaged fasteners remain in place; replace with a new assembly.

items.text: Confirm twist-off bolt splined ends sheared cleanly at proper tension.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spline end fully sheared off, indicating the minimum tension was achieved.

items.text: Verify all bolt holes in the connection are filled.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of the designed bolt positions filled.

items.text: Check bolt orientation/head placement matches the specification where a directional requirement is noted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Head/nut orientation matches the drawing note where applicable.

items.text: Verify washers are used as required (over slotted/oversized holes, under the turned element).
items.acceptance_criteria: Hardened washers installed per RCSC requirements.

items.text: Confirm no field welding or heating has been performed on high-strength bolts.
items.acceptance_criteria: No arc strikes, weld spatter, or heat damage on installed bolts.

items.text: Record bolted connection inspection results referencing connection/grid ID.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log complete with pass/fail status per connection.

items.text: Photograph representative connections and any rejected or replaced bolts.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos labeled with connection ID.

items.text: Inspector sign-off approving bolted connections for cover-up.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file prior to concealment (fireproofing, decking, cladding).

items.text: Contractor QC representative countersigns the bolting inspection report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature acknowledges findings.

templates.name: Column/Beam Alignment and Plumbness Checklist
templates.description: Verifies individual erected columns are plumb and beams are level and properly aligned within AISC 303 erection tolerances before permanent connections are completed.
prerequisites: Temporary guy wires/bracing materials on site
Plumbing equipment (transit, laser, plumb bob) calibrated
Approved erection sequence plan

items.text: Verify the column is temporarily connected with the minimum required bolts before release from the crane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum two bolts per connection, snug-tightened, per the erection plan before crane release.

items.text: Confirm plumbing/aligning equipment is calibrated and functioning.
items.acceptance_criteria: Transit/laser calibration current, verified against a known reference point.

items.text: Verify guy wires, turnbuckles, or bracing struts are installed at each column requiring temporary support.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bracing installed per the erection engineer's plan at all columns exposed to wind or out-of-plane load.

items.text: Check wind/weather conditions are acceptable for plumbing operations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sustained wind speed within erection plan limits, commonly under 20-25 mph for unbraced plumbing.

items.text: Measure column plumbness over its full erected height.
items.acceptance_criteria: Out-of-plumb not exceeding 1:500 of the column height.

items.text: Verify individual column plumbness between splice points does not exceed the absolute maximum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Maximum lateral deviation of 1 in. toward and 2 in. away from the adjacent exterior building line.

items.text: Check exterior column plumbness relative to adjacent exterior columns (envelope tolerance).
items.acceptance_criteria: Cumulative offset of the exterior column line not exceeding 2 in., or 1:500 of height, whichever governs.

items.text: Verify column plumbness is measured in two perpendicular directions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both orthogonal readings within tolerance; a single-plane check is insufficient.

items.text: Confirm plumbness is verified after final tensioning of guy wires, before guy wire removal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Final plumb reading taken and recorded prior to release of temporary bracing.

items.text: Verify beam top flange elevation at each end of the span.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation differential across the span within +/-1/4 in. unless camber is intended.

items.text: Check beam horizontal alignment (sweep) relative to centerline.
items.acceptance_criteria: Beam centerline deviation not exceeding span length/500.

items.text: Verify beam-to-column connection working points align with the design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Working point offset within +/-1/8 in. of the theoretical location.

items.text: Confirm beam bearing seats are level and fully engaged before releasing the crane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Full bearing contact; seat level within 1/8 in. before load transfer.

items.text: Verify connecting bolts are installed to the minimum requirement before crane release.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum erection bolts installed and snug-tight prior to unhooking.

items.text: Verify column splice plumbness is carried through from the tier below.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cumulative plumbness deviation at the splice within 1:500 of total erected height above the base.

items.text: Check splice plate fit-up and bolt hole alignment at column splices.
items.acceptance_criteria: Splice plates seated flush; holes aligned without reaming beyond 1/16 in.

items.text: Verify an alignment survey is performed at each tier before proceeding to the next tier erection.
items.acceptance_criteria: Survey data recorded and within tolerance before next-tier columns are set.

items.text: Confirm base-to-splice elevation matches the design story height.
items.acceptance_criteria: Story height within +/-1/4 in. of the design dimension.

items.text: Verify permanent bracing/diaphragm is installed before releasing temporary guy wires.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permanent lateral system complete and connected per the erection plan prior to release.

items.text: Confirm a final plumbness re-check is performed after permanent connections are completed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plumbness re-verified within tolerance after final bolt-up/welding.

items.text: Check for residual stress or binding indicating misalignment during connection.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible distortion, gap, or forced fit-up at final connections.

items.text: Verify temporary bracing is removed only after structural engineer/erection plan approval.
items.acceptance_criteria: Removal authorized in writing per the erection plan sequence.

items.text: Record plumbness and alignment survey readings per column/beam ID.
items.acceptance_criteria: Data logged referencing grid and elevation for each member checked.

items.text: Photograph plumb bob/laser readings for out-of-tolerance members and corrective action.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos document as-found and as-corrected condition.

items.text: Inspector sign-off confirming alignment within tolerance before permanent connection release.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file prior to final weld-out/bolt-up.

items.text: Erection Superintendent acknowledges the tier/section is ready for the next lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature confirms readiness for subsequent erection.

templates.name: Framing Material Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Verifies dimensional lumber, engineered wood products, and connectors delivered to the site meet grade, moisture content, and specification requirements before framing installation begins.
prerequisites: Approved framing plans and structural notes on site
Lumber grade stamps visible on delivered material
Calibrated moisture meter available

items.text: Verify lumber grade stamps are present and legible on structural members.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grade stamp shows species, grade, moisture content designation (S-DRY/KD), and grading agency.

items.text: Confirm lumber grade matches the structural drawing specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grade equal to or better than specified on the structural notes (e.g., No. 2 or better).

items.text: Verify engineered wood products (I-joists, LVL, glulam, PSL) are stamped and match the specified evaluation report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Product stamped with manufacturer ID and matches the specified ICC-ES ESR number.

items.text: Check the delivery ticket/packing list against material ordered.
items.acceptance_criteria: Species, size, and quantity match the approved submittal.

items.text: Inspect material for shipping/handling damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: No broken, split, or crushed members exceeding allowable defect limits.

items.text: Measure moisture content of dimensional lumber using a calibrated meter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Moisture content 19% or less for S-DRY framing lumber.

items.text: Verify lumber is stored off the ground and covered to prevent moisture absorption.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material stacked on dunnage, protected from precipitation and ground contact.

items.text: Check engineered wood products are protected from prolonged moisture exposure per manufacturer requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: No exposure exceeding the manufacturer's weather-exposure limit; no visible delamination.

items.text: Verify preservative-treated lumber is used at required locations (sill plates, exterior contact).
items.acceptance_criteria: Treated lumber bears the required treatment stamp for ground contact or above-ground use.

items.text: Inspect structural members for knots exceeding the grade allowance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Knot size within the limits of the stamped grade.

items.text: Check for wane, checks, splits, or shake affecting member capacity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Defects within the visual grade allowance; no splits exceeding member length limits at bearing/connection points.

items.text: Verify no decay, fungal staining, or insect damage is present.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible decay or infestation; reject affected members.

items.text: Inspect engineered lumber (LVL/PSL/glulam) for delamination or manufacturing defects.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible glue-line separation or laminate voids.

items.text: Verify sawn beam/header members are free of excessive crook or bow.
items.acceptance_criteria: Crook/bow not exceeding 1/2 in. per 8 ft, or per manufacturer limit.

items.text: Verify metal connectors (joist hangers, hurricane ties, hold-downs) match the structural schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Connector model and size match the structural drawing schedule and load table.

items.text: Check connector material/finish is appropriate for exposure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Connector coating rated for treated lumber contact per manufacturer guidance (e.g., G185 or stainless).

items.text: Verify fasteners supplied for connectors match the manufacturer's specified type and quantity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Nail/screw type, length, and count match the connector's published fastener schedule.

items.text: Inspect connector hardware for damage, rust, or bent flanges prior to installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No structural damage or corrosion affecting load capacity.

items.text: Verify structural screws/bolts for engineered connections match the specified grade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener grade and diameter match the design specification.

items.text: Record grade stamps and species observed for structural members.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log species/grade for beams, headers, and posts in the load path.

items.text: Photograph delivered material, grade stamps, and any rejected items.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos document condition and grade marks.

items.text: Record moisture content readings for sampled members.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum sample readings logged (e.g., one per ten pieces or per plan).

items.text: Inspector sign-off approving material for use in framing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file prior to installation.

items.text: Superintendent acknowledges rejected material is removed from site or segregated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature confirms nonconforming material is quarantined.

templates.name: Framing Layout Verification Checklist
templates.description: Verifies wall, floor, and roof framing layout matches approved plans for dimensions, member spacing, opening sizes, and load path continuity before sheathing or concealment.
prerequisites: Approved framing plans/truss layout on site
Foundation as-built survey verified
Engineered truss/joist layout drawings on site if applicable

items.text: Verify exterior wall lines match the foundation plan and are square.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wall line offset from the foundation edge within +/-1/4 in.; diagonal square-check measurements within 1/4 in.

items.text: Check overall building dimensions against the approved plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Dimensions within +/-1/2 in. per 40 ft run.

items.text: Verify interior partition layout matches the floor plan for room dimensions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Partition location within +/-1/4 in. of the plan dimension.

items.text: Confirm chalk lines/layout marks correspond to the plate layout (stud, king/jack, opening marks).
items.acceptance_criteria: Layout marks legible and match plan notation.

items.text: Verify floor/roof level datum is consistent across the framing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation consistent within 1/4 in. across the diaphragm per level survey.

items.text: Verify stud spacing matches the structural drawing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spacing within +/-1/2 in. of the specified 16 in. or 24 in. o.c. dimension.

items.text: Check the double top plate is lapped and spliced per code at corners and intersections.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 48 in. lap at splices; full lap at corners.

items.text: Verify header sizes at openings match the structural schedule for the span.
items.acceptance_criteria: Header size and species match the schedule for the opening width and load.

items.text: Confirm king and jack (trimmer) stud counts at openings meet the schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Jack stud quantity matches the header bearing requirement per the plan.

items.text: Verify shear wall panel layout and hold-down locations match the engineered plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hold-down and shear panel locations within +/-2 in. of the plan location.

items.text: Verify floor joist spacing and direction match the structural plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spacing within +/-1/2 in. of specified o.c.; direction matches the plan.

items.text: Check joist/truss bearing length at supports meets the minimum requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum bearing 1.5 in. on wood/steel, 3 in. on masonry, or per the truss design drawing.

items.text: Verify rim board/blocking is installed continuously at the floor perimeter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rim/blocking present with no gaps exceeding manufacturer allowance.

items.text: Confirm roof rafter/truss spacing and layout match the approved truss placement plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Truss spacing within +/-1/2 in. of design; layout matches the stamped truss placement diagram.

items.text: Verify roof pitch and ridge/hip layout match the architectural plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pitch within +/-1/4:12 of the specified slope.

items.text: Verify a continuous load path from roof to foundation at bearing walls.
items.acceptance_criteria: Vertical alignment of bearing points within a 6 in. offset or per the engineer's transfer detail.

items.text: Check window and door rough opening dimensions against the schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rough opening within +1/2 in./-0 in. of the manufacturer or schedule requirement.

items.text: Verify structural beam pockets/bearing points are sized and located correctly.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pocket dimension provides the minimum bearing length per plan, within +/-1/4 in.

items.text: Confirm framing around mechanical penetrations does not compromise structural members without engineering approval.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unapproved cutting or notching of engineered members; sawn lumber notch/hole limits per code.

items.text: Verify temporary wall bracing is installed until sheathing/permanent bracing is complete.
items.acceptance_criteria: Diagonal bracing installed per plan at maximum spacing prior to wind exposure.

items.text: Check truss bracing (permanent and temporary) is installed per the truss manufacturer's drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bracing matches the truss design drawing and industry bracing guidelines.

items.text: Verify walls are plumbed and braced before floor/roof framing is loaded onto them.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wall plumb within 1/4 in. per 8 ft of height before loading.

items.text: Confirm cross bracing or blocking is installed at required intervals for joists/rafters.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blocking installed per plan spacing, commonly at midspan for joists over 2x10.

items.text: Record framing layout deviations and corrective actions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deviations documented with the resolution noted.

items.text: Photograph overall framing layout and any engineered connections.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos cover each elevation/level of framing.

items.text: Inspector sign-off approving framing layout for sheathing installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file prior to sheathing cover-up.

items.text: Superintendent acknowledges framing is ready for the next trade/stage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature confirms readiness.

templates.name: Sheathing Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies structural wood panel sheathing is installed with the correct panel type, orientation, edge support, and gapping per APA and IBC/IRC requirements before weatherproofing or fastening inspection.
prerequisites: Approved sheathing schedule/nailing plan on site
Framing inspection approved prior to sheathing
Panel span rating verified against support spacing

items.text: Verify panel span rating/grade stamp matches the specified sheathing type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rated stamp shows a span rating (e.g., 32/16) meeting or exceeding the support spacing.

items.text: Confirm panel thickness matches the structural schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Thickness within manufacturer tolerance of the specified value (e.g., 7/16 in. OSB, 15/32 in. plywood).

items.text: Verify exposure rating (Exposure 1/Exterior) is appropriate for the application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Roof/wall sheathing rated Exposure 1 minimum; exterior applications per plan.

items.text: Inspect panels for delamination, moisture damage, or broken edges prior to installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible delamination or edge damage exceeding manufacturer allowance.

items.text: Verify panel strength axis is oriented perpendicular to supports.
items.acceptance_criteria: Long dimension/face grain perpendicular to framing per the panel span rating requirements.

items.text: Check panel end joints are staggered between adjacent rows.
items.acceptance_criteria: End joints offset a minimum of 24 in. between courses, or per plan.

items.text: Verify panels span a minimum of two framing members, with three supports preferred.
items.acceptance_criteria: Panel edges bear on framing at all four sides.

items.text: Confirm floor sheathing is installed with tongue-and-groove edges or panel edge clips engaged.
items.acceptance_criteria: T&G fully seated; edge clips installed at unsupported edges per plan.

items.text: Verify roof sheathing clips (H-clips) are installed at unsupported panel edges where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: H-clips installed at midspan of unsupported edges per the span rating.

items.text: Verify panel edge gap for expansion.
items.acceptance_criteria: 1/8 in. gap at panel edges and ends per APA recommendation, unless the manufacturer specifies otherwise.

items.text: Check gap is maintained at panel butt joints over framing.
items.acceptance_criteria: 1/8 in. spacing maintained consistently at butt joints.

items.text: Verify panels are not forced or wedged tightly against adjacent panels.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible buckling from panels installed without gap.

items.text: Confirm sheathing does not bridge expansion/control joints in the structure without a detail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sheathing detailed per plan at building expansion joints.

items.text: Verify blocking is installed at horizontal panel joints where required by shear design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blocking present at all panel edges for a blocked shear wall/diaphragm per plan.

items.text: Check blocking size and fit provide a full nailing surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blocking width matches the framing member, minimum 1.5 in. nailing surface.

items.text: Verify panel edges bear fully on framing/blocking with no unsupported edges outside clip spacing.
items.acceptance_criteria: All edges supported per the span rating requirements.

items.text: Confirm roof sheathing extends and is supported at gable end/rake framing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Panel edges land on rake framing/outlookers per detail.

items.text: Verify sheathing is cut cleanly around openings without oversized gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gap around openings (windows, vents) not exceeding 1/4 in. unless detailed otherwise.

items.text: Check sheathing at shear wall corners/openings is reinforced per the engineered detail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blocking/strapping installed per the shear wall schedule at openings.

items.text: Verify continuous sheathing seams do not align directly over structural openings without support.
items.acceptance_criteria: Panel layout avoids unsupported seams over headers/openings.

items.text: Confirm penetrations for mechanical/electrical do not exceed the shear panel allowable hole size.
items.acceptance_criteria: Penetration size and location within engineered shear wall limits.

items.text: Record panel span rating, thickness, and gapping observations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log data for typical wall, roof, and floor areas inspected.

items.text: Photograph sheathing layout, blocking, and clip installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos document representative areas and any deficiencies.

items.text: Inspector sign-off approving sheathing installation prior to fastening inspection/cover-up.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file before weather barrier installation.

items.text: Superintendent acknowledges sheathing is ready for fastening verification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature confirms readiness for the next checklist stage.

templates.name: Structural Sheathing Fastening Checklist
templates.description: Verifies structural sheathing fasteners (nail/screw type, size, spacing, and edge distance) meet the approved fastening schedule and shear wall/diaphragm nailing requirements per IBC/IRC and APA guidance.
prerequisites: Approved fastening schedule/shear wall nailing plan on site
Sheathing installation inspection approved
Pneumatic nailer depth-of-drive calibrated

items.text: Verify fastener type matches the specification (common nail, box nail, or structural screw).
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener type matches the shear wall/diaphragm schedule; substitutions require engineering approval.

items.text: Check fastener diameter and length meet the schedule requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Nail size matches the schedule (e.g., 8d common = 0.131 in. dia x 2.5 in.).

items.text: Verify minimum fastener penetration into the framing member.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1.5 in. penetration into framing for common nails.

items.text: Confirm galvanized/corrosion-resistant fasteners are used where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener coating rated for treated wood contact per manufacturer guidance.

items.text: Verify the pneumatic nailer is set to the correct depth of drive.
items.acceptance_criteria: Nail head flush to slightly below the surface, not fractured through the panel face.

items.text: Verify field (intermediate) fastener spacing on wall sheathing panels.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field nailing at 12 in. o.c. maximum unless the engineered schedule specifies tighter spacing.

items.text: Check field fastener spacing on roof sheathing matches the wind/seismic design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field spacing per the roof sheathing schedule, typically 12 in. o.c.

items.text: Verify floor sheathing field fastening includes adhesive where a glued-nailed system is specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Subfloor adhesive applied continuously per the manufacturer if a glue-nail system is specified.

items.text: Confirm no missed fasteners (skips) occur across the panel field.
items.acceptance_criteria: No gaps in the fastening pattern exceeding one missed spacing interval.

items.text: Verify screw fasteners, where used, are driven to the correct depth without stripping.
items.acceptance_criteria: Screw head seated flush; no stripped panel surface or spun-out screws.

items.text: Verify edge fastener spacing on panel edges.
items.acceptance_criteria: Edge nailing per schedule, commonly 6 in. o.c. for standard walls, tighter for engineered shear walls.

items.text: Check boundary nailing at the diaphragm perimeter/shear wall boundary members.
items.acceptance_criteria: Boundary spacing matches the engineered shear wall schedule.

items.text: Verify minimum edge distance from fastener to panel edge.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3/8 in. edge distance to prevent panel splitting.

items.text: Confirm fasteners are not overdriven, breaking the panel face fibers.
items.acceptance_criteria: No fastener head penetration through the outer ply/veneer exceeding manufacturer allowance.

items.text: Verify a staggered fastener pattern at panel edges where required by high-demand shear wall design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Staggered rows per the engineered detail to reduce wood splitting at high nail densities.

items.text: Verify the high-load shear wall nailing schedule matches the engineered shear wall type designation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Nailing pattern matches the engineered shear wall schedule for the specified wall type.

items.text: Check 3x nominal framing is provided at adjoining panel edges where nail spacing is 2 in. or 3 in. o.c.
items.acceptance_criteria: 3x minimum nominal width framing at edges for closely spaced nailing.

items.text: Verify hold-down and strap fastener schedules match the manufacturer's published values.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener quantity and type match the evaluation report for the hold-down/strap model used.

items.text: Confirm diaphragm boundary and chord fastening is complete before the roof/floor is loaded.
items.acceptance_criteria: Boundary fastening complete prior to next-stage loading.

items.text: Verify unblocked diaphragm panel edge nailing meets the reduced-value schedule if blocking is omitted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Nailing and spacing match unblocked diaphragm values where blocking is not installed.

items.text: Perform a sample fastener spacing measurement using a tape/spacing gauge.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum sample measurement per wall/diaphragm segment logged (e.g., 3 locations per 20 ft of wall).

items.text: Verify no fasteners are installed at an angle causing reduced holding value.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fasteners driven perpendicular to the panel face, within 15 degrees of normal.

items.text: Check for split panel edges caused by fastening.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible splits at fastener locations affecting shear capacity; reject and repair per the engineer.

items.text: Verify fastening schedule compliance is re-checked at randomly selected shear wall segments.
items.acceptance_criteria: Random QC re-check performed on a minimum of 10% of designated shear walls.

items.text: Record fastener type, spacing measurements, and schedule reference used.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log data per wall, roof, or floor segment inspected.

items.text: Photograph representative fastening patterns and any nonconforming areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos document as-installed spacing with a reference scale.

items.text: Inspector sign-off approving fastening compliance prior to cover-up.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed approval on file before concealment (insulation/finish).

items.text: Superintendent acknowledges corrective fastening is completed where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature confirms deficiencies are resolved.

templates.name: Roof Deck Preparation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies the structural deck, substrate condition, slope, and attachment are acceptable before roofing membrane or insulation installation begins.
prerequisites: Approved roof plans and manufacturer specifications on site
Deck installation complete and inspected by structural engineer of record

items.text: Verify deck type and gauge/thickness match approved construction documents.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deck material, gauge (steel) or thickness (wood/concrete) matches approved drawings; no unauthorized substitutions.

items.text: Inspect deck fastening/welding pattern against structural drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener/weld spacing and pattern match engineered fastening schedule; no missing fasteners.

items.text: Check deck for excessive deflection under foot traffic and point loads.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible deflection, oil-canning, or bounce exceeding L/240 under normal construction loads.

items.text: Confirm deck surface is free of standing water, ice, frost, or debris.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface dry and clean; no ponding water or debris greater than 1/4 in. depth.

items.text: Verify roof slope achieves positive drainage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum slope of 1/4 in. per ft (2%) to drains/scuppers, per design; no reverse slope areas.

items.text: Inspect deck joints and seams for proper alignment and gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Steel deck side laps and end laps tight, no gaps exceeding 1/4 in.; wood deck joints staggered per plan.

items.text: Test deck moisture content (wood) or moisture condition (concrete/gypsum).
items.acceptance_criteria: Wood deck moisture content 19% or less; concrete deck moisture emission acceptable per manufacturer requirement.

items.text: Inspect deck surface for delamination, rot, corrosion, or spalling.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible rot, corrosion, delamination, or spalled concrete; damaged areas identified and marked.

items.text: Verify deck is swept and vacuumed free of loose fasteners, debris, and dust.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface broom-clean, free of loose material that could puncture membrane or impede adhesion.

items.text: Confirm concrete deck cure time meets minimum before membrane application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Concrete cured minimum 28 days or per manufacturer's moisture-reduced cure schedule.

items.text: Check for oil, grease, or contaminants on deck surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible oil, grease, asphalt residue, or other contaminants that impair adhesion.

items.text: Verify all roof curbs, sleeves, and penetrations are installed and secured.
items.acceptance_criteria: All curbs minimum 8 in. above finished roof surface, structurally attached per drawings.

items.text: Confirm blocking and nailers are installed at perimeters and curbs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wood nailers pressure-treated, attached at spacing per manufacturer fastening schedule, flush with insulation height.

items.text: Inspect roof edge metal substrate and blocking for continuity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Edge blocking continuous, level, and securely fastened per approved shop drawings.

items.text: Verify drain bodies, clamping rings, and sumps are set to correct elevation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drain bowl set minimum 1/4 in. below adjacent deck to promote positive drainage into sump.

items.text: Check that temporary weather protection is in place for exposed deck areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: All exposed deck areas covered or dried-in at end of each work shift; no unprotected substrate overnight.

sections.name: Vapor Retarder & Air Barrier Continuity (if specified)

items.text: Verify vapor retarder material and installation match specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Vapor retarder type, permeance rating, and lap width match approved submittal.

items.text: Inspect vapor retarder laps and seams for continuity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Laps minimum 2 in., sealed and continuous with no gaps, tears, or fishmouths.

items.text: Confirm vapor retarder is tied into wall air/vapor barrier at parapets and penetrations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous seal with no breaks at transitions to wall assembly.

items.text: Inspect vapor retarder for punctures or damage from foot traffic before cover.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible punctures, tears, or displaced sections prior to insulation installation.

items.text: Confirm manufacturer's pre-installation meeting occurred and is documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Meeting minutes on file identifying substrate acceptance criteria and installer certification.

items.text: Verify installer certification/approval for specified roofing system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installer holds current manufacturer certification for warranty-eligible installation.

items.text: Confirm weather forecast is acceptable for membrane installation start.
items.acceptance_criteria: No precipitation forecast during installation window; ambient temperature within manufacturer's application range.

items.text: Verify staging and material storage areas protect materials from moisture and UV.
items.acceptance_criteria: Materials stored on pallets, covered, off ground, out of direct sun per manufacturer requirements.

items.text: Photograph overall deck condition prior to cover.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos taken of entire deck area including problem areas identified during inspection.

items.text: Record deck moisture test results on inspection log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test locations and readings logged with date, time, and instrument used.

items.text: Obtain written acceptance of deck condition from roofing installer.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed substrate acceptance form on file prior to membrane installation.

items.text: Complete and file deck preparation inspection report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report signed, dated, and distributed to project file within 24 hours of inspection.

templates.name: Roofing Membrane Installation Checklist
templates.description: Documents proper installation of low-slope roofing membrane including seams, attachment, flashings, and terminations for warranty compliance and watertightness.
prerequisites: Roof Deck Preparation Checklist complete and approved
Manufacturer installation instructions on site

items.text: Verify insulation type, thickness, and R-value match approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Insulation matches specified type and thickness within 1/8 in.; R-value per drawings.

items.text: Inspect insulation board joints for tight fit and stagger pattern.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joints butted tight (gaps less than 1/4 in.), staggered minimum 6 in. between rows.

items.text: Verify insulation attachment (mechanical or adhesive) meets wind uplift design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener/adhesive pattern matches engineered uplift rating (FM or manufacturer approval).

items.text: Confirm cover board is installed over insulation where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cover board joints offset from insulation joints minimum 6 in., fully attached per fastening schedule.

items.text: Confirm membrane type, thickness, and color match approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Membrane mil thickness and product match approved shop drawing/submittal.

items.text: Inspect membrane for proper relaxation before seaming (single-ply).
items.acceptance_criteria: Membrane allowed to relax minimum 30 minutes or per manufacturer instruction before seaming to reduce wrinkles.

items.text: Verify membrane sheets are free of wrinkles, fishmouths, and blisters.
items.acceptance_criteria: No wrinkles greater than 1/4 in. height, no visible air pockets or blisters.

items.text: Check membrane attachment pattern (mechanically fastened, adhered, or ballasted).
items.acceptance_criteria: Attachment method and fastener spacing match approved wind uplift design.

items.text: Verify seam overlap width meets minimum requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Side laps minimum 3 in.; end laps minimum 6 in., or per manufacturer specification.

items.text: Inspect heat-welded or solvent-welded seams for continuity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous weld with no skips; probe test shows no separation over full seam length.

items.text: Perform seam probe test on completed seams.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cool probe drawn along seam shows no penetration or separation; minimum 10% of seams tested.

items.text: Verify seam width consistency using measuring gauge on sample sections.
items.acceptance_criteria: Weld width minimum 1.5 in. for heat-welded seams, measured at minimum 3 locations per 100 LF.

items.text: Inspect T-joints and cross seams for additional reinforcement/patching.
items.acceptance_criteria: All T-joints covered with reinforcement patch minimum 4 in. round or square, fully welded.

items.text: Inspect base flashing height at walls and curbs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Base flashing extends minimum 8 in. above finished roof surface.

items.text: Verify termination bar attachment and sealant at top of flashings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Termination bar fastened at 6 in. o.c. maximum, continuous sealant bead above bar.

items.text: Inspect penetration flashings (pipes, conduits, supports) for proper seal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pourable sealer pockets or prefabricated boots fully sealed with no gaps; minimum 2 in. clearance maintained where required.

items.text: Verify roof edge metal and coping installation per SPRI ES-1.
items.acceptance_criteria: Edge metal meets wind design pressure, continuous cleat engagement, joints per manufacturer detail.

items.text: Inspect scupper and overflow scupper flashing integration.
items.acceptance_criteria: Scupper flashing overlaps membrane minimum 4 in., sealed watertight, overflow set 2 in. above primary drain inlet.

items.text: Verify positive drainage achieved with no ponding areas exceeding limit.
items.acceptance_criteria: No ponding water remaining 48 hours after rainfall in areas larger than a footprint of a basketball (per FM/NRCA guidance).

items.text: Inspect drain strainers/domes are installed and secured.
items.acceptance_criteria: Strainer basket installed, seated correctly, and free of debris.

items.text: Verify tapered insulation crickets direct water away from curbs and equipment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cricket slope minimum 1/4 in. per ft, diverting flow around obstruction to nearest drain.

items.text: Inspect low-slope areas for membrane wrinkles that could trap water.
items.acceptance_criteria: No wrinkles or ridges greater than 1/4 in. height in areas subject to standing water.

items.text: Conduct water test or flood test on completed membrane sections as required.
items.acceptance_criteria: No leaks observed after 24-hour flood test or per specified test duration.

items.text: Conduct electronic leak detection survey on applicable membrane systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: No leak signals detected across tested area; anomalies marked and repaired.

items.text: Cut and inspect membrane sample seam for weld quality if required by manufacturer.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sample seam shows full-width fusion with no delamination when peeled.

items.text: Verify repaired test cuts are patched and re-tested.
items.acceptance_criteria: All test cut locations patched with compatible material and probe-tested with no separation.

items.text: Photograph completed seams, flashings, and penetrations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Representative photos taken of each roof area, flashing detail, and any repairs.

items.text: Complete manufacturer's warranty inspection checklist if applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer field inspection form completed and submitted for warranty issuance.

items.text: Record ambient temperature and weather conditions during installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Conditions logged daily; installation within manufacturer's temperature range.

items.text: Obtain sign-off from quality control inspector for completed roof area.
items.acceptance_criteria: QC inspector signature on file confirming acceptance of installed area.

templates.name: Roof Drainage System Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Confirms roof drains, scuppers, gutters, downspouts, and slope are properly installed and functioning to prevent ponding, overflow, and water intrusion.
prerequisites: Roof drainage plan and calculations available on site

items.text: Verify roof drain quantity and location match approved drainage plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drain count and placement match hydraulic design; no drains omitted or relocated without approval.

items.text: Confirm drain sump depression provides positive flow to drain.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sump depressed minimum 1/4 in. to 1/2 in. below adjacent roof surface within 18 in. radius.

items.text: Inspect drain body, clamping ring, and strainer dome are correctly assembled.
items.acceptance_criteria: Clamping ring fully compresses membrane, all bolts torqued, strainer dome seated and secured.

items.text: Verify drain leader/riser size matches design calculations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pipe diameter matches sizing per plumbing code hydraulic calculation for roof area served.

items.text: Test drain flow with water to confirm no obstruction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Water introduced at drain flows freely with no backup or standing water after 5 minutes.

items.text: Verify overflow drains or scuppers are provided per code.
items.acceptance_criteria: Secondary drainage system present, sized independently of primary system per code requirement.

items.text: Confirm overflow drain inlet is set 2 inches above primary drain low point.
items.acceptance_criteria: Overflow inlet elevation minimum 2 in. above primary drain sump, per code.

items.text: Verify overflow scuppers are sized and located to prevent structural overload.
items.acceptance_criteria: Scupper dimensions and count match structural design for 100-year storm event.

items.text: Inspect overflow scupper flashing and through-wall detail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Scupper flashing extends through wall with end dam and continuous seal to membrane.

items.text: Verify roof slope directs water to drains without low spots.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1/4 in. per ft slope maintained; no birdbaths deeper than 1/4 in. after 48 hrs dry.

items.text: Conduct post-rain ponding survey.
items.acceptance_criteria: No ponding areas remain 48 hours after rain event exceeding manufacturer/FM ponding limits.

items.text: Inspect tapered insulation crickets at curbs and equipment for proper diversion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Crickets divert water around obstructions with minimum 1/4 in. per ft slope on cricket faces.

items.text: Verify low points and valleys drain fully without birdbaths.
items.acceptance_criteria: No residual ponding deeper than 1/4 in. remains in valleys or low points 48 hours after rain.

items.text: Verify gutter slope and size match design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gutter slope minimum 1/16 in. per ft toward outlets; size matches rainfall intensity calculation.

items.text: Inspect gutter hangers and support spacing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hangers spaced per manufacturer requirement, typically 36 in. o.c. maximum, additional at joints.

items.text: Confirm downspout size, quantity, and discharge location match plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Downspout sizing and count match hydraulic design; discharge directed away from foundation minimum 5 ft.

items.text: Inspect conductor head and downspout connections for watertight seal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joints soldered, sealed, or gasketed with no visible gaps or leaks.

items.text: Verify interior roof drain piping is insulated to prevent condensation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Piping insulated with vapor-retarder jacket in conditioned/unconditioned transition areas per spec.

items.text: Inspect drain leader supports and expansion joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Piping supported per code spacing, expansion joints/couplings provided at directional changes as designed.

items.text: Verify cleanouts are provided and accessible per code.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cleanouts installed at base of each riser and per horizontal run spacing required by code.

items.text: Inspect pipe hangers for corrosion protection and proper isolation from dissimilar metals.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hangers isolated from piping with non-conductive material where dissimilar metals are in contact; no visible corrosion.

items.text: Perform flood test on roof drainage system prior to final acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Water introduced to design flow rate drains without backup, overflow activation, or leakage at joints.

items.text: Verify no leaks at drain-to-membrane transition during flood test.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible leakage observed at membrane/drain interface during or after test.

items.text: Confirm secondary/overflow drainage activates only after primary system is at capacity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Overflow discharge observed only after primary drain flow is deliberately restricted during test.

items.text: Verify interior leaders show no leaks at accessible joints during test.
items.acceptance_criteria: No moisture or leakage visible at accessible pipe joints, hangers, or cleanouts during flood test.

items.text: Photograph each drain, scupper, and overflow location with identifying tag/number.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log created for all drainage penetrations with location reference keyed to roof plan.

items.text: Record flood test results including duration and water volume.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test log includes date, duration, and observations for each drain tested.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming drainage system meets design intent.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection report on file prior to roof turnover.

items.text: File as-built drainage layout with drain/scupper tag references.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-built drawing on file matching installed drain and scupper locations and tag numbers.

templates.name: Waterproofing Membrane Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies below-grade, plaza deck, and other waterproofing membrane systems are installed to substrate, seam, and detail requirements to achieve a continuous watertight assembly.
prerequisites: Substrate inspection and acceptance complete
Manufacturer installation guide and MSDS on site

items.text: Inspect concrete substrate for surface defects (honeycombing, spalls, form tie holes).
items.acceptance_criteria: No voids, spalls, or protrusions greater than 1/4 in.; defects patched with compatible repair mortar.

items.text: Verify substrate concrete cure time before membrane application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 7-14 day cure (or per manufacturer) achieved prior to fluid-applied membrane installation.

items.text: Test substrate moisture condition prior to membrane installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Moisture vapor emission rate and/or RH meets manufacturer's maximum threshold (e.g., 3 lb/1000 sf/24hr or 80% RH).

items.text: Confirm substrate is free of laitance, curing compound, dust, and oil.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface mechanically or chemically prepared per manufacturer surface profile requirement (CSP per ICRI guideline).

items.text: Inspect and fill construction joints, cracks, and cold joints per detail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cracks greater than 1/16 in. routed and sealed; joints treated with detail strip or sealant per manufacturer detail.

items.text: Verify all fillets/coves are formed at inside corners and transitions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cant strip or fillet minimum 3/4 in. radius/leg installed at all deck-to-wall transitions.

items.text: Verify primer type and application rate match manufacturer specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Primer applied at coverage rate specified (e.g., 250-350 sf/gal), uniform coverage with no dry/skipped areas.

items.text: Confirm primer flash/cure time observed before membrane application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Primer flash time meets manufacturer minimum/maximum window before topcoat application.

items.text: Inspect detail/reinforcing strips at joints, penetrations, and terminations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reinforcing fabric or detail strip embedded with no wrinkles, fully saturated, minimum overlap per manufacturer (typically 2 in.).

items.text: Verify penetrations are pre-treated with pourable sealer or boot prior to field membrane.
items.acceptance_criteria: All pipe/conduit penetrations sealed with compatible detail material before general membrane application.

items.text: Verify membrane type (sheet-applied or fluid-applied) matches approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Product and system match approved shop drawings; no unauthorized substitutions.

items.text: For fluid-applied membranes, measure wet film thickness during application.
items.acceptance_criteria: WFT meets manufacturer's minimum to achieve specified DFT (commonly 60-90 mils WFT per coat).

items.text: Verify cured dry film thickness meets specification using gauge on cured sample.
items.acceptance_criteria: DFT meets or exceeds specified minimum (typically 60-125 mils total depending on system).

items.text: For sheet membranes, verify seam overlap and roller/seam roller pass.
items.acceptance_criteria: Seams overlap minimum 2.5-3 in., seam roller applied to full seam length with no visible gaps.

items.text: Inspect membrane surface for pinholes, blisters, and holidays.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible pinholes, blisters, or discontinuities; holiday testing performed where specified.

items.text: Verify number of coats/passes matches specification for fluid-applied systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum number of coats applied per manufacturer data sheet, with proper cure between coats.

items.text: Inspect membrane termination at walls, curbs, and penetrations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Membrane terminates minimum 6-8 in. above finished grade/surface or per detail, mechanically fastened and sealed.

items.text: Verify compatibility of sealants and flashing materials with membrane system.
items.acceptance_criteria: All ancillary materials listed as compatible by membrane manufacturer; no mixed incompatible chemistries.

items.text: Inspect drain integration and clamping ring compression into membrane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Membrane extends into drain clamping ring with full compression and no gaps.

items.text: Verify expansion joint waterproofing detail is continuous with adjacent field membrane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Expansion joint flashing/bellows laps field membrane minimum 3 in. each side, fully sealed.

items.text: Verify protection course/board is installed over completed membrane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Protection board installed full coverage prior to backfill, insulation, or overburden per spec.

items.text: Conduct flood test or electronic leak detection survey prior to cover.
items.acceptance_criteria: No leaks detected after minimum 24-hour flood test or ELD survey with no anomalies.

items.text: Inspect membrane for damage from subsequent trades before backfill/topping.
items.acceptance_criteria: No punctures, tears, or displaced protection board observed prior to cover-up.

items.text: Verify drainage/protection composite (if specified) is installed over protection board.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drainage composite installed with fabric side out per manufacturer orientation, seams overlapped minimum 4 in.

items.text: Record ambient and substrate temperature during application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Temperatures within manufacturer's minimum/maximum application range at time of installation.

items.text: Verify no precipitation occurred during application or before initial cure.
items.acceptance_criteria: No rain or moisture contact until manufacturer-specified initial cure/rain-safe time elapsed.

items.text: Confirm ventilation is adequate for solvent-based systems applied in enclosed spaces.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mechanical ventilation maintained per manufacturer safety data sheet where applying in confined areas.

items.text: Verify relative humidity is within manufacturer's application limit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Relative humidity at or below manufacturer's maximum (commonly 85%) at time of application.

items.text: Photograph membrane installation at each phase (substrate, detailing, field, protection).
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log covers substrate prep, detail work, completed membrane, and protection course.

items.text: Record DFT/WFT measurements and locations on QC log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measurement log includes minimum 1 reading per 100 sf with gauge type noted.

items.text: Obtain manufacturer field inspection and warranty sign-off.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer representative inspection completed and warranty application submitted.

items.text: Complete flood/leak test report and file with project documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed test report on file prior to concealment.

templates.name: Air Barrier Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies continuous air barrier assembly installation across wall, roof, and foundation transitions to meet code air-leakage limits and manufacturer requirements.
prerequisites: Air barrier assembly drawings and details approved
Substrate rough-in complete (sheathing, framing)

items.text: Inspect substrate (sheathing/masonry/concrete) for gaps, holes, and damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gaps and penetrations greater than 1/4 in. identified and pre-filled per manufacturer detail before membrane application.

items.text: Verify substrate is clean, dry, and free of frost, dust, and form-release agents.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface visibly clean and dry; no contaminants that impair adhesion.

items.text: Confirm sheathing fasteners are set flush and not overdriven.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener heads flush or slightly below surface, no torn sheathing paper/facer at fastener locations.

items.text: Verify sheathing joints are supported on framing and gapped per manufacturer allowance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Panel joints fall on framing members, gapped 1/8 in. per manufacturer to allow for expansion.

items.text: Verify air barrier product matches approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Product type (self-adhered, fluid-applied, mechanically attached) matches approved documents.

items.text: For fluid-applied air barriers, measure wet film thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: WFT meets manufacturer minimum to achieve specified dry mil thickness (commonly 20-40 wet mils).

items.text: Verify cured dry film thickness on sample area.
items.acceptance_criteria: DFT meets manufacturer minimum specification, typically 15-25 dry mils.

items.text: Inspect sheet membrane laps and seam widths.
items.acceptance_criteria: Horizontal laps minimum 2 in., vertical laps minimum 6 in., shingle-lapped to shed water.

items.text: Verify roller or seam pressure applied to all laps of self-adhered membrane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Laps rolled with hand or J-roller for full contact, no visible fishmouths or air pockets.

items.text: Inspect coverage for pinholes, thin spots, or missed areas (fluid-applied).
items.acceptance_criteria: No pinholes or holidays visible; touch-up applied to any thin/missed spots before cover.

items.text: Verify air barrier is continuous at window/door rough openings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Air barrier laps window flange minimum 2 in. and integrates per manufacturer sequencing (sill pan, jambs, head).

items.text: Inspect transition from wall air barrier to roof air barrier/membrane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous seal with no gaps at parapet, roof-to-wall, or transition detail per drawings.

items.text: Verify air barrier continuity at foundation-to-wall transition.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wall air barrier laps below-grade waterproofing minimum 6 in. or per detail, fully sealed.

items.text: Inspect sealing at all penetrations (pipes, conduits, ties, anchors).
items.acceptance_criteria: All penetrations sealed with compatible sealant or boot; no visible gaps around penetration items.

items.text: Verify air barrier continuity at floor line transitions (multi-story).
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous seal maintained at shelf angles and floor slab edges per detail; no unsealed gaps.

items.text: Verify sealants, tapes, and transition materials are manufacturer-approved compatible products.
items.acceptance_criteria: All ancillary products listed on manufacturer's compatible materials list; no substitutions without written approval.

items.text: Confirm air barrier is protected from UV exposure per manufacturer time limit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Membrane covered by cladding/insulation within manufacturer's maximum UV exposure window (commonly 30-180 days).

items.text: Inspect for physical damage from subsequent trades before cladding installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No tears, punctures, or delaminated areas present prior to covering with insulation/cladding.

items.text: Verify repair of any identified damage before concealment.
items.acceptance_criteria: All punctures/tears patched with compatible material lapping the defect minimum 4 in. beyond edges.

items.text: Conduct water penetration testing (AAMA 501/ASTM E1105) on representative wall areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: No water penetration observed past the air barrier plane at specified test pressure and duration.

items.text: Conduct whole-building or representative-area air leakage test.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured air leakage rate meets code maximum (e.g., 0.40 cfm/sf at 75 Pa per IECC/ASTM E779/E1827).

items.text: Perform smoke test or infrared scan to identify leakage paths (if specified).
items.acceptance_criteria: No significant thermal anomalies or smoke escape observed at tested transitions.

items.text: Verify any identified leakage paths are remediated and retested.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corrective sealing applied to flagged locations, retest confirms no continued leakage.

items.text: Photograph completed air barrier at each transition and penetration type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log includes window/door transitions, roof tie-in, foundation tie-in, and penetrations.

items.text: Record DFT/WFT readings and test locations on QC log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1 measurement per 500 sf logged with gauge type and location.

items.text: File air/water penetration test reports with project documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed third-party or manufacturer test reports on file before cladding installation.

items.text: Obtain manufacturer or design team acceptance of installed air barrier.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written acceptance on file confirming continuity meets ASTM E2357 assembly requirements.

templates.name: Flashing Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies through-wall, head/sill, kick-out, and roof-to-wall flashings are properly integrated with the drainage plane to shed water away from the building envelope.
prerequisites: Flashing shop drawings and details approved
Air/water-resistive barrier installed at flashing locations

items.text: Verify flashing material, gauge, and finish match approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material type (metal, membrane, composite), gauge, and finish match approved shop drawings.

items.text: Confirm flashing material is compatible with adjacent dissimilar metals/materials.
items.acceptance_criteria: No direct contact between galvanically incompatible metals; isolation membrane/tape used where required.

items.text: Inspect flashing stock for damage, kinks, or finish defects before installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No dents, kinks, or coating damage that would compromise performance or appearance.

items.text: Verify flashing gauge/thickness meets minimum per wind load and span requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Metal thickness matches structural/wind design (e.g., minimum 24 gauge or 0.032 in. aluminum per SPRI ES-1 calc).

items.text: Verify sill pan flashing is installed at window/door rough openings with end dams.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sloped sill pan with end dams minimum 1/2 in. high, sloped to exterior, per AAMA 711 or approved detail.

items.text: Inspect head flashing extension and drip edge beyond opening.
items.acceptance_criteria: Head flashing extends minimum 1 in. beyond jambs each side with drip leg minimum 3/8 in.

items.text: Verify head flashing laps behind water-resistive barrier (shingle fashion).
items.acceptance_criteria: Upper WRB laps over head flashing minimum 2 in.; flashing laps over WRB below opening.

items.text: Confirm jamb flashing integration with sill and head flashing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Jamb flashing overlaps sill pan and is overlapped by head flashing to maintain shingle-lap drainage.

items.text: Verify through-wall flashing location and continuity above grade and at shelf angles.
items.acceptance_criteria: Through-wall flashing continuous with end dams at terminations, minimum 4 in. up back wall.

items.text: Inspect weep holes/vents above through-wall flashing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Weeps spaced maximum 24 in. o.c. (or per design), clear and unobstructed.

items.text: Verify flashing extends beyond face of wall to form drip.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flashing projects minimum 1/4 in. to 1/2 in. beyond finished wall face with hemmed drip edge.

items.text: Inspect end dams and end laps at flashing terminations and corners.
items.acceptance_criteria: End dams minimum 2 in. high at flashing terminations; end laps minimum 4 in. sealed watertight.

items.text: Verify step flashing installation at sloped roof-to-wall intersections.
items.acceptance_criteria: Step flashing pieces minimum 2 in. up wall, 2 in. onto roof, lapped shingle-fashion with each course.

items.text: Inspect kick-out flashing at roof-to-wall terminations at gutter lines.
items.acceptance_criteria: Kick-out flashing diverts water away from wall into gutter; no gaps allowing water behind cladding.

items.text: Verify counterflashing/reglet installation over base flashing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Counterflashing embedded in reglet minimum 1 in., sealed, overlapping base flashing minimum 4 in.

items.text: Inspect chimney, skylight, and equipment curb flashing integration.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flashing continuous around all four sides with corner pieces soldered or sealed watertight.

items.text: Verify parapet cap flashing/coping slope and joint design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Coping sloped to interior (roof side) minimum 1/4 in. per ft, or per design; joints have concealed splice plates.

items.text: Inspect coping joint spacing and expansion joint provisions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint spacing per manufacturer thermal movement calculation, typically 10-12 ft with expansion joints as detailed.

items.text: Verify continuous cleat engagement at coping and edge metal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cleat engages coping minimum 3/4 in. with positive lock, fastened per SPRI ES-1 wind design.

items.text: Inspect coping end caps and corner units for factory-mitered fabrication and seal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corners and end caps factory-formed or shop-fabricated, sealed watertight, no field-bent patches.

items.text: Inspect sealant joints at flashing terminations for proper width/depth ratio.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sealant joint width-to-depth ratio approximately 2:1, backer rod installed where joint exceeds 1/4 in. depth.

items.text: Verify sealant adhesion and tooling at flashing edges.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sealant fully adhered to both substrates, tooled smooth, no voids or air entrapment.

items.text: Confirm sealant type is compatible with flashing metal and adjacent materials.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sealant chemistry approved for substrate per manufacturer compatibility chart; no staining or reaction observed.

items.text: Verify sealant applied within manufacturer's temperature and cure window.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ambient and substrate temperature within sealant manufacturer's application range at time of installation.

items.text: Photograph flashing installation at each condition type before concealment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log covers head/sill, through-wall, roof-to-wall, and coping conditions for each elevation.

items.text: Verify flashing installation matches approved mockup (if constructed).
items.acceptance_criteria: Field installation consistent with approved mockup detail and materials.

items.text: Obtain design team/envelope consultant acceptance of flashing installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written acceptance on file prior to concealment by cladding or insulation.

items.text: Record flashing material lot/batch numbers for warranty traceability.
items.acceptance_criteria: Batch/lot numbers logged against installed locations for warranty documentation.

templates.name: Cladding System Installation Checklist (Brick, Siding, Metal Panels, etc.)
templates.description: Verifies exterior cladding attachment, drainage cavity, flashing integration, and alignment tolerances for brick veneer, siding, and metal panel systems.
prerequisites: Air/water-resistive barrier and flashings installed and inspected
Approved cladding shop drawings and attachment details on site

items.text: Verify air/water-resistive barrier and flashings are complete and accepted before cladding starts.
items.acceptance_criteria: Prior envelope inspection sign-off on file for area to be clad.

items.text: Inspect drainage cavity width behind cladding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cavity width matches design, minimum 1 in. clear for brick veneer or per manufacturer for rainscreen systems.

items.text: Verify cavity is free of mortar droppings, debris, and obstructions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cavity clear at weep locations; mortar collection device installed at base where specified.

items.text: Confirm vertical furring/girts are plumb and at correct spacing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Furring plumb within 1/8 in. in 8 ft, spacing matches structural/attachment design (typically 16-24 in. o.c.).

items.text: Verify fastener type, spacing, and embedment match approved attachment schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fasteners match specified type/length; spacing matches engineered attachment schedule and wind load design.

items.text: Inspect brick veneer ties for type, spacing, and embedment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corrugated or adjustable ties spaced maximum 16 in. o.c. vertically, 32 in. o.c. horizontally (24 sf max per tie), embedded minimum 1.5 in. into mortar joint.

items.text: Verify metal panel clip/attachment spacing matches wind load calculations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Clip spacing and fastener count match structural design pressure per manufacturer engineering.

items.text: Inspect siding fastener penetration into structural framing/sheathing.
