items.acceptance_criteria: Fasteners penetrate framing minimum 1.5 in. or per manufacturer, not overdriven or underdriven.

items.text: Verify cladding plumb, level, and alignment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plumb within 1/4 in. in 10 ft (max 3/4 in. over building height); level within 1/4 in. in 10 ft.

items.text: Inspect panel/course reveal and joint width consistency.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reveal/joint width consistent within +/- 1/16 in. of specified dimension across elevation.

items.text: Verify coursing/panel lines align at corners and across control joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Coursing continuous and level across building corners within 1/4 in.; no visible stepping.

items.text: Check for oil-canning or waviness on flat metal panels.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible oil-canning under raking light exceeding manufacturer's acceptable flatness tolerance.

items.text: Verify expansion/control joint locations and spacing match design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint spacing matches engineered thermal movement calculation, typically 20-25 ft horizontal for brick veneer.

items.text: Inspect soft joints at shelf angles and structural support points.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous soft (compressible) joint minimum 3/8 in. provided below shelf angles, unobstructed by mortar.

items.text: Verify sealant backer rod and joint sizing at movement joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint width sized for anticipated movement, backer rod installed at correct depth, sealant per ASTM C1193.

items.text: Inspect corner and termination movement joints for continuity with field joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corner joints align with and continue the movement joint pattern; no discontinuity at returns.

items.text: Verify weep holes are open, spaced correctly, and unobstructed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Weeps spaced maximum 24 in. o.c. at flashing lines, open and free of mortar/debris.

items.text: Inspect cladding integration with flashings at openings, base, and top of wall.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cladding laps or terminates correctly at all flashing lines per approved details; no reverse laps.

items.text: Verify penetrations through cladding are properly flashed and sealed.
items.acceptance_criteria: All utility penetrations sealed with compatible sealant/boot, no gaps allowing water entry.

items.text: Inspect base-of-wall flashing and clearance above finished grade/paving.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cladding base terminates minimum 4-8 in. above grade or per code/design with clear weep path.

items.text: Conduct field water penetration test (AAMA 501.2/ASTM E1105) on representative wall area.
items.acceptance_criteria: No water penetration past drainage plane observed at specified test pressure/duration.

items.text: Verify mockup wall was constructed and approved prior to full-scale installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Approved mockup on file matching materials, coursing, and joint treatment used in field.

items.text: Inspect wind uplift/pull test results for mechanically attached panel systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field pull test results meet or exceed design load with adequate safety factor per manufacturer protocol.

items.text: Verify any deficiencies identified during testing are corrected and retested.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corrective action documented and retest confirms no water penetration or attachment failure.

items.text: Photograph completed cladding elevations and representative details.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log of each elevation plus close-ups of joints, weeps, and flashing integration.

items.text: Record alignment and tolerance measurements at spot-check locations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measurement log with minimum 3 locations per elevation for plumb/level checks.

items.text: Obtain design team/envelope consultant acceptance of installed cladding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written acceptance on file for each elevation before scaffold/lift removal.

items.text: File material certifications and installer qualifications with closeout documents.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer material certs and installer certifications on file for warranty support.

templates.name: Masonry Joint Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Verifies mortar joint tooling, width, tuckpointing, and weep/movement joint conditions meet TMS 402/602 tolerances for weathertightness and durability.
prerequisites: Mortar mix design/submittal approved
Masonry mockup panel approved (if required)

items.text: Verify mortar type matches specification (Type N, S, M, O).
items.acceptance_criteria: Mortar type matches structural/exposure requirement per approved submittal.

items.text: Confirm mortar batching and retempering practices comply with limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mortar used within 2.5 hours of initial mixing; retempering limited to within working time, no retemper after that.

items.text: Inspect mortar color and consistency for uniformity across the wall.
items.acceptance_criteria: Consistent color and texture across elevation with no visible batch-to-batch variation.

items.text: Verify sand and cement/lime proportions match approved mix design or proportion spec.
items.acceptance_criteria: Materials batched per approved proportion or property specification; no unauthorized field additions.

items.text: Measure bed joint thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bed joints 3/8 in. nominal, tolerance +/- 1/8 in.

items.text: Measure head joint thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: Head joints 3/8 in. nominal, tolerance +/- 1/8 in.

items.text: Inspect joint tooling profile (concave, V, weathered, etc.) matches specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tooling profile consistent across elevation, matches approved sample/mockup.

items.text: Verify joints are tooled when mortar is thumbprint hard.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joints tooled at proper mortar hardness to compact surface and shed water, no tearing or smearing.

items.text: Inspect for full head and bed joint mortar coverage (no voids).
items.acceptance_criteria: Joints fully filled with no visible voids/furrowing gaps greater than 1/4 in. on face.

items.text: Verify wall plumb and coursing alignment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plumb within 1/4 in. in 10 ft, maximum 3/8 in. in a story height, per TMS 602 tolerances.

items.text: Check course height consistency.
items.acceptance_criteria: Course-to-course height variation not exceeding 1/8 in. in 3 ft, 1/4 in. in 10 ft.

items.text: Inspect for consistent bond pattern per elevation drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bond pattern (running, common, Flemish, etc.) matches approved drawings with no unintended breaks.

items.text: Verify masonry unit alignment across window/door heads and sills.
items.acceptance_criteria: Coursing lines up level and continuous across openings within 1/4 in.; no visible jog at jambs.

items.text: Verify weep hole spacing and type at flashing lines.
items.acceptance_criteria: Weeps spaced maximum 24 in. o.c., open and unobstructed by mortar droppings.

items.text: Inspect vertical expansion joint width and sealant installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint width sized per thermal movement calc (typically 3/8-1/2 in.), sealant tooled with backer rod at correct depth.

items.text: Verify horizontal soft joints below shelf angles are unobstructed by mortar.
items.acceptance_criteria: Compressible joint material continuous, minimum 3/8 in., free of mortar bridging.

items.text: Inspect control joints in CMU walls for location and spacing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Control joint spacing per TMS 602 guidance (typically 20-25 ft or per design), located at stress concentration points.

items.text: Verify deteriorated mortar removed to proper depth before repointing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mortar raked to minimum depth of 2x joint width or 3/4 in., whichever is greater, with square joint edges.

items.text: Inspect joint cleaning and dampening before repointing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joints brushed clean of debris and dampened (not saturated) prior to new mortar placement.

items.text: Verify repointing mortar matches original in strength, color, and joint profile.
items.acceptance_criteria: New mortar compatible in strength (not harder than original units) and visually matched per approved sample.

items.text: Inspect tooled repointed joints for proper compaction and profile match.
items.acceptance_criteria: Repointed joints tooled to same profile as surrounding original joints, fully compacted with no voids.

items.text: Inspect masonry surface for mortar smears and efflorescence after cleaning.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface free of mortar smears, stains, or visible efflorescence after final cleaning.

items.text: Verify appropriate cleaning method/chemical used per masonry type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cleaning solution and dilution match manufacturer/masonry association recommendation; no acid damage to units.

items.text: Confirm fresh masonry protected from freezing and rapid drying per cold/hot weather requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cold weather: covered/heated per TMS 602 cold weather provisions; hot weather: moist-cured as required.

items.text: Verify wall is protected from mortar splash and construction traffic damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Base of wall covered/protected until construction activity in the area is complete.

items.text: Photograph representative joint conditions and any defects identified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log of typical joints, weeps, movement joints, and any repair areas.

items.text: Record joint width measurements at sample locations across elevation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 5 measurement locations per elevation logged with results.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming masonry joint work meets TMS 402/602 tolerances.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection report on file for each elevation/phase.

items.text: File mortar test/prism test results if quality assurance testing was performed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Compressive strength or prism test reports on file matching required verification level.

templates.name: Window & Door Installation Alignment Checklist
templates.description: Verifies fenestration units are set plumb, level, and square within tolerance, properly shimmed, fastened, and flashed per ASTM E2112 installation practice.
prerequisites: Rough opening dimensions verified against unit schedule
Sill pan flashing installed and inspected

items.text: Verify rough opening dimensions match window/door schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Opening width and height within manufacturer's tolerance, typically +1/4 in./-0 to +1/2 in. of unit dimension.

items.text: Inspect rough opening for square (diagonal measurement).
items.acceptance_criteria: Diagonal measurements differ by no more than 1/8 in. per 4 ft (out-of-square tolerance).

items.text: Verify sill pan flashing and sloped sill condition complete before unit set.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sill pan installed with end dams and slope to exterior per approved detail; inspection sign-off on file.

items.text: Confirm rough opening framing is structurally sound and free of damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: No split, rotted, or damaged framing members at jambs, head, or sill; header sized per structural drawings.

items.text: Verify unit is set plumb in both planes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plumb within 1/8 in. in 6 ft measured on both jamb faces.

items.text: Verify unit is level at head and sill.
items.acceptance_criteria: Level within 1/8 in. over the width of the unit.

items.text: Check unit for square by comparing diagonal measurements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Diagonal measurements within 1/8 in. of each other for units up to 6 ft; proportionally greater allowance for larger units.

items.text: Inspect shim placement at jambs, sill, and head.
items.acceptance_criteria: Shims located at each anchor point and at midspan of jambs, spaced maximum 24 in. o.c., no shim gaps exceeding manufacturer limit.

items.text: Verify unit reveal/margin is consistent around perimeter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gap between unit frame and rough opening consistent within 1/8 in. on all sides for uniform sealant joint.

items.text: Verify anchor/fastener type, spacing, and embedment match manufacturer instructions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fasteners per manufacturer's installation instructions, spaced maximum 16-24 in. o.c. (per unit size), embedded into structural framing.

items.text: Inspect for proper fastener torque (not over- or under-driven).
items.acceptance_criteria: Fasteners seated snug without distorting frame or compressing weatherstripping.

items.text: Verify operable sash/panel operates smoothly after anchoring.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sash/door opens, closes, and latches smoothly with no binding or excessive force.

items.text: Check that shims remain in place and are not displaced during fastening.
items.acceptance_criteria: Shims fixed in position, no gaps opened during final fastener torque.

items.text: Verify perimeter gap is insulated per specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gap filled with low-expansion foam or backer rod/sealant per manufacturer; foam not overfilled causing frame bow.

items.text: Inspect for frame bowing caused by excessive foam expansion.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible bowing of jambs; reveal remains consistent after insulation cures.

items.text: Verify continuity of building air barrier tie-in around full perimeter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Air barrier/flashing tape continuous around head, jambs, and sill with no gaps or fishmouths.

items.text: Confirm interior perimeter sealant/backer rod installed where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Interior air seal joint continuous with backer rod and sealant per detail, no gaps.

items.text: Test operable units for smooth operation through full range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unit opens/closes/locks without binding, sticking, or excessive force across full range of motion.

items.text: Verify hardware (locks, hinges, closers) functions and aligns correctly.
items.acceptance_criteria: All hardware operates as designed, strike plates aligned, no forced engagement.

items.text: Inspect glazing for damage (cracks, scratches, seal failure) after installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No cracked glass, visible scratches, or fogged/failed insulated glass units.

items.text: Verify unit closes and latches without requiring excessive force on frame.
items.acceptance_criteria: Door/window latches fully with normal hand pressure; no frame racking required to engage hardware.

items.text: Conduct field water penetration test on representative units.
items.acceptance_criteria: No water penetration observed at specified test pressure per AAMA 502/511 or ASTM E1105 protocol.

items.text: Conduct air infiltration spot check where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured air leakage meets code/design maximum (e.g., 0.3 cfm/sf at 75 Pa for fixed, 0.5 cfm/lf for operable per NFRC/AAMA).

items.text: Verify structural/deflection test performed for large or curtain-wall-scale units where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deflection under design load meets L/175 or specified limit with no permanent set after test.

items.text: Confirm any failed test units are corrected and retested before acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corrective action documented, and retest results meet acceptance criteria.

items.text: Photograph installed unit exterior and interior with reveal visible.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo taken of each unit type showing perimeter shim/anchor condition before trim/sealant cover.

items.text: Record plumb/level/square measurements for each unit or representative sample.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measurement log completed per unit or per approved sampling plan.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming alignment tolerances met before sealant/trim installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection record on file prior to concealment of anchors.

items.text: File unit identification schedule cross-referenced to floor plan location.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unit tag/serial numbers logged against plan location for warranty and maintenance records.

templates.name: Window & Door Weatherstripping Checklist
templates.description: Verifies weatherstripping, gaskets, sweeps, and perimeter sealant are properly installed and functioning to meet air and water infiltration performance requirements.
prerequisites: Window & Door Installation Alignment Checklist complete and approved

items.text: Verify weatherstripping type matches manufacturer specification for the unit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material (compression gasket, bulb seal, brush pile, fin seal) matches approved unit submittal.

items.text: Inspect weatherstripping for continuous coverage around full perimeter.
items.acceptance_criteria: No gaps in weatherstripping run; corners mitered or continuously wrapped with no breaks.

items.text: Verify weatherstripping is properly seated in frame channel/kerf.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gasket fully seated in channel, not twisted, pulled, or partially dislodged.

items.text: Check door sweep/threshold seal installation and adjustment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sweep contacts threshold uniformly along full width with no daylight gaps exceeding 1/16 in.

items.text: Perform visual daylight test at closed unit perimeter.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible daylight gaps at jambs, head, sill, or meeting rail when unit is closed and locked.

items.text: Test weatherstripping compression using feeler gauge or paper-pull test.
items.acceptance_criteria: Consistent resistance felt when pulling paper strip through closed contact points around full perimeter; no zones with zero resistance.

items.text: Inspect meeting rail/astragal seal on double units and French doors.
items.acceptance_criteria: Astragal seal provides continuous contact with no gaps at meeting point.

items.text: Verify weatherstripping does not prevent full hardware engagement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Locks/latches fully engage without excessive force despite weatherstripping compression.

items.text: Verify backer rod is installed at perimeter joint before sealant.
items.acceptance_criteria: Backer rod sized 25% larger than joint width, installed at consistent depth for proper hourglass sealant profile.

items.text: Inspect sealant joint width-to-depth ratio.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sealant joint approximately 2:1 width-to-depth ratio, minimum depth 1/4 in.

items.text: Verify sealant tooling, adhesion, and continuity around perimeter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sealant tooled smooth, fully adhered to both substrates with no voids, gaps, or air entrapment.

items.text: Confirm sealant is compatible with frame material and adjacent finishes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sealant type approved for substrate per manufacturer compatibility chart (e.g., no acid-cure silicone on masonry/metal).

items.text: Test operable sash/door for smooth operation and full latching.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unit opens, closes, and latches without binding across full range with weatherstripping engaged.

items.text: Verify multi-point locking hardware engages all strike points.
items.acceptance_criteria: All lock points fully engage with consistent compression on weatherstripping.

items.text: Check auto-closing/self-latching hardware (where specified) engages weatherstripping fully.
items.acceptance_criteria: Closer/latch mechanism draws unit fully closed with even compression, no gap at final position.

items.text: Verify weatherstripping does not excessively increase operating force.
items.acceptance_criteria: Operable force to open/close remains within manufacturer's normal range despite added seal friction.

items.text: Conduct air infiltration test on representative units.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured infiltration meets code/design maximum, e.g., 0.3 cfm/sf (fixed) or 0.5 cfm/lf (operable) at 75 Pa.

items.text: Conduct water penetration test on representative units.
items.acceptance_criteria: No water penetration observed at specified pressure/duration per AAMA 502/511.

items.text: Verify test sample size meets specified percentage of installed units.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum sample tested per specification (typically 2-5% of units or per contract requirement).

items.text: Confirm any units failing test are re-sealed/adjusted and retested.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corrective action documented and retest confirms compliance before acceptance.

items.text: Photograph weatherstripping condition at each jamb, head, and sill.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log covers full perimeter of representative sample of units by type.

items.text: Record air/water test results and unit identification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test log includes unit ID, location, and pass/fail result for each test.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming weatherstripping and sealant meet performance requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection record on file before final trim/interior finish.

items.text: File warranty documentation for weatherstripping and sealant products used.
items.acceptance_criteria: Product data sheets and warranty terms filed with closeout documents.

templates.name: Insulation Installation Checklist (Thermal and Acoustic)
templates.description: Verifies thermal and acoustic insulation type, R-value, coverage, and installation quality in walls, roofs, and floor/ceiling assemblies meet code and specification.
prerequisites: Framing/rough-in and air barrier work complete and inspected
Insulation submittal approved

items.text: Verify insulation type and R-value match specification and code requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: R-value per unit thickness matches approved submittal and meets IECC prescriptive/performance minimum for climate zone.

items.text: Confirm insulation is undamaged, dry, and free of mold/contamination before installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible moisture damage, compression, or contamination on material as installed.

items.text: Verify acoustic insulation (where specified) meets STC/NRC design requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Product type and density match specified acoustic performance rating.

items.text: Confirm insulation facing/flame-spread rating is acceptable for exposed applications.
items.acceptance_criteria: Facing meets flame spread/smoke developed rating required by code where left exposed (e.g., 25/450 per ASTM E84).

items.text: Verify cavity is clean and free of debris, wiring conflicts, and blocking obstructions before installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cavity clear of construction debris; electrical/plumbing rough-in complete and inspected.

items.text: Confirm air barrier and vapor retarder are installed and inspected before insulation cover (where applicable).
items.acceptance_criteria: Air/vapor barrier inspection sign-off on file for area to be insulated.

items.text: Verify cavity depth matches insulation thickness to avoid compression or gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Framing/furring depth matches specified insulation thickness within manufacturer tolerance.

items.text: Inspect for moisture intrusion or condensation in cavity before enclosing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cavity dry with no active water intrusion, condensation, or visible mold prior to insulation installation.

items.text: Verify batt insulation fills cavity fully without compression or gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Batt fills full cavity depth and width, no visible gaps greater than 1/4 in. at edges, no compression reducing rated thickness.

items.text: Inspect for proper fit around electrical boxes, blocking, and penetrations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Insulation split and fitted around obstructions with no voids or compressed sections; batts behind wiring/boxes.

items.text: Verify facing (kraft/foil) orientation matches vapor retarder design intent.
items.acceptance_criteria: Facing installed toward conditioned/warm-in-winter side per climate zone design, stapled without excessive compression.

items.text: Inspect friction-fit or stapled attachment for secure, sag-free installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Batts held firmly in place with no sagging or gapping at top of cavity after installation.

items.text: Verify spray foam thickness/lift meets specified R-value.
items.acceptance_criteria: Applied thickness meets minimum for specified R-value per manufacturer's coverage chart; measured with probe/gauge.

items.text: Inspect spray foam for full cavity coverage without voids.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible voids, delamination from substrate, or missed areas; probe test confirms adhesion.

items.text: Verify blown-in insulation density and depth meet specified R-value.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed density and depth match manufacturer's coverage chart for specified R-value; depth markers installed in attics.

items.text: Confirm open-cell/closed-cell foam trimmed flush and not obstructing required clearances.
items.acceptance_criteria: Foam trimmed flush to framing, does not encroach on required electrical/mechanical clearances or fire-blocking.

items.text: Verify continuous insulation board thickness and R-value match specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Board thickness and type match submittal; total assembly R-value meets IECC continuous insulation requirement.

items.text: Inspect board joints for tight fit and taping/sealing where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joints butted tight, staggered, and taped/sealed per manufacturer to maintain thermal and air control continuity.

items.text: Verify fastener/clip penetrations through continuous insulation are minimized and sealed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Thermal bridging penetrations limited to structural clips per design; any gaps sealed to maintain air barrier continuity.

items.text: Inspect exposed edges of continuous insulation at openings and terminations for protection/trim.
items.acceptance_criteria: Exposed edges trimmed, capped, or protected per detail to prevent damage and moisture entry.

items.text: Verify insulation does not obstruct required fire-stopping or draft-stopping.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fire-rated assemblies maintain listed insulation type/thickness; no substitution compromising rating.

items.text: Inspect clearance from insulation to heat-producing equipment (flues, recessed lighting).
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum clearance maintained per manufacturer/code (e.g., 3 in. from non-IC recessed fixtures) with no insulation contact.

items.text: Verify acoustic sealant/gasketing at top and bottom plates of rated partitions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous acoustic sealant bead at perimeter of partition per STC design detail, no gaps.

items.text: Confirm insulation batts are not compressed to route wiring or plumbing through cavity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wiring/piping routed through bored holes or furring space, not by compressing insulation loft.

items.text: Measure installed R-value/thickness at sample locations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sample measurements meet or exceed specified R-value within acceptable tolerance.

items.text: Verify no compression of insulation behind wiring, pipes, or blocking.
items.acceptance_criteria: Insulation maintains full loft/thickness around all in-cavity obstructions.

items.text: Conduct infrared scan or visual survey to identify missing/thin insulation areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: No thermal anomalies indicating voids or thin coverage across scanned assembly.

items.text: Verify insulation installation matches energy code compliance path (prescriptive or performance).
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed R-values and continuity documented match the compliance path filed with the building permit.

items.text: Photograph installed insulation before wall/ceiling cover (drywall, sheathing).
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log of each area/room documenting coverage and R-value marking/labeling.

items.text: Verify insulation certificate/label posted per code requirement (attic/crawlspace).
items.acceptance_criteria: R-value certificate posted in attic access or electrical panel area per code.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming insulation installation before concealment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection record on file prior to drywall/sheathing cover.

items.text: File product data sheets and coverage charts used to verify installed R-value.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer coverage chart referenced for depth/density verification filed with closeout documents.

templates.name: Exterior Painting/Staining Checklist
templates.description: Verifies surface preparation, environmental conditions, and coating application (wet/dry film thickness, coats, coverage) for exterior painting and staining work.
prerequisites: Coating submittal and color/finish approved
Substrate construction complete and cured per material requirement

items.text: Verify substrate surface profile/cleanliness meets coating manufacturer requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface prepared to specified SSPC standard (e.g., SSPC-SP2/SP3 hand/power tool, SP6 commercial blast) as applicable.

items.text: Inspect substrate for loose paint, rust, mildew, and contamination before coating.
items.acceptance_criteria: No loose/peeling paint, active corrosion, mildew, or visible contamination remaining on surface.

items.text: Test substrate moisture content before coating (wood/masonry).
items.acceptance_criteria: Wood substrate moisture content 15% or less (12-15% typical); masonry/stucco cured minimum 28-30 days.

items.text: Verify masonry/stucco surface pH is acceptable for coating (if applicable).
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface pH between 7-10 (neutral to slightly alkaline) or per manufacturer maximum for coating chemistry.

items.text: Confirm caulking/sealant of joints and gaps complete before painting.
items.acceptance_criteria: All joints, cracks, and nail holes filled and cured per manufacturer's paint-over time before coating.

items.text: Verify surfaces are dry and dust-free immediately before coating application.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible moisture, dust, or debris on surface at time of application.

items.text: Record ambient air temperature during application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Temperature within manufacturer's application range, typically 50-90°F, and rising (not falling) through cure window.

items.text: Verify surface temperature is within manufacturer range and above dew point.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface temperature minimum 5°F above dew point and within manufacturer's min/max range.

items.text: Confirm relative humidity is within acceptable range for application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Relative humidity below manufacturer's maximum, typically 85% or less at time of application.

items.text: Verify no rain is forecast before minimum cure/recoat time elapses.
items.acceptance_criteria: No precipitation expected within manufacturer's minimum dry-to-rain-resistant time after application.

items.text: Confirm wind conditions do not cause overspray or dust contamination.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wind speed within safe spray application limits; containment/screening used where required.

items.text: Verify primer type and compatibility with substrate and topcoat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Primer matches manufacturer's system recommendation for substrate type; no incompatible tie-coats used.

items.text: Measure wet film thickness during application of each coat.
items.acceptance_criteria: WFT meets manufacturer's data sheet value to achieve specified dry mil thickness (commonly 4-8 wet mils per coat for field-applied paints).

items.text: Measure cured dry film thickness after final coat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Total DFT meets or exceeds manufacturer's minimum system thickness (product-specific, commonly 3-5 dry mils for paint systems).

items.text: Verify minimum number of coats applied per specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Number of coats (typically primer plus 2 finish coats) matches specification; each coat fully cured before next application.

items.text: Inspect coating for holidays, runs, sags, and uniform coverage/hide.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible holidays, runs, sags, or thin spots showing substrate; uniform sheen and color across surface.

items.text: Verify recoat/cure time between coats meets manufacturer minimum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum recoat window observed per manufacturer's data sheet based on ambient conditions.

items.text: Verify application method (brush, roll, spray) matches specification for substrate/texture.
items.acceptance_criteria: Method matches spec requirement; back-rolling performed on sprayed surfaces where required for penetration.

items.text: Inspect coverage rate against manufacturer's spread rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Actual coverage (sf/gal) consistent with manufacturer's published spread rate within 10-15%.

items.text: Verify edges, corners, and trim receive full, even coverage.
items.acceptance_criteria: No skipped or thin coverage at edges, corners, fasteners, or trim details.

items.text: Confirm masking and protection of adjacent surfaces prior to application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Glass, hardware, roofing, and landscaping protected/masked before coating begins.

items.text: Inspect final finish for color and sheen consistency across elevations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Color and sheen match approved sample/mockup with no visible batch variation or lap marks.

items.text: Verify no overspray or drips on adjacent surfaces (glass, hardware, roofing).
items.acceptance_criteria: Adjacent surfaces free of overspray, drips, or masking residue.

items.text: Document punch list items for touch-up or recoat.
items.acceptance_criteria: All identified defects logged with location and corrective action assigned.

items.text: Verify touch-up work matches surrounding finish with no visible patching.
items.acceptance_criteria: Touch-up areas blend seamlessly with adjacent coating in color, sheen, and texture.

items.text: Photograph completed elevations and representative surface detail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo log of each elevation and any repaired/touch-up areas.

items.text: Record WFT/DFT measurements and environmental conditions log.
items.acceptance_criteria: QC log includes measurements, ambient conditions, and batch/lot numbers used.

items.text: Obtain sign-off confirming coating system meets specification before scaffold/lift removal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection record on file for each elevation.

items.text: File manufacturer product data sheets and warranty documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Product data sheets, batch numbers, and applicable warranty terms filed with closeout documents.

templates.name: HVAC Ductwork Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies HVAC ductwork is fabricated, supported, sealed, and installed in accordance with SMACNA duct construction standards prior to insulation and system startup.
prerequisites: Approved HVAC shop drawings and duct layout on site
Duct pressure/seal class schedule available
Fabrication shop tickets or mill certs for duct material

items.text: Verify installed duct routing matches approved shop drawings and coordination model.
items.acceptance_criteria: Routing, elevation, and fitting locations match approved drawings within field-fit tolerance.

items.text: Confirm duct material matches specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material (galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, fiberglass duct board) matches submittal.

items.text: Verify duct gauge/thickness matches SMACNA table for duct dimension and pressure class.
items.acceptance_criteria: Metal thickness meets or exceeds SMACNA minimum gauge for the duct's largest dimension and pressure class.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Ch. 1

items.text: Confirm design pressure classification is documented for each duct system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Positive/negative pressure class (in. w.g.) is labeled or recorded for each system segment.

items.text: Inspect ductwork and fittings for shipping damage, crushed sections, or debris before installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No dents, crushed corners, or foreign debris present inside duct sections.

items.text: Confirm transverse joint type matches duct gauge and pressure class requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slip, drive-cleat, or flanged joint type matches SMACNA requirement for gauge/pressure class used.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Ch. 2

items.text: Verify longitudinal seams (Pittsburgh lock, snap lock) are fully engaged with no gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Seam fully closed and crimped along entire length; no visible daylight through seam.

items.text: Confirm duct reinforcement (cross-breaking, beading, standing seam) is provided per SMACNA table.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reinforcement type/spacing matches SMACNA table for duct dimension and pressure class.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Ch. 2

items.text: Verify turning vanes are installed in square-throat rectangular elbows.
items.acceptance_criteria: Turning vanes present, evenly spaced, and securely fastened in all square-throat elbows.

items.text: Confirm branch and tap connections use manufactured fittings rather than field-cut saddle taps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Conical or 45-degree entry tap fittings used; no unapproved field-cut hole taps.

items.text: Verify SMACNA seal class assigned matches the design pressure classification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Seal Class A/B/C designation matches system's in. w.g. rating per SMACNA seal class table.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Ch. 1

items.text: Confirm all transverse joints are sealed with approved sealant, mastic, or tape for the assigned seal class.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of transverse joints sealed with listed sealant; no visible gaps.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Ch. 1

items.text: Confirm longitudinal seams are sealed for Seal Class A or B systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: All longitudinal seams sealed where seal class requires; sealant fully cured and continuous.

items.text: Confirm duct wall penetrations (hangers, sensor probes) are sealed for Seal Class A systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: All penetrations caulked or gasketed; no unsealed openings in Class A ductwork.

items.text: Perform duct leakage test on representative duct section per SMACNA leakage test manual.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured leakage rate does not exceed assigned SMACNA leakage class at test pressure.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Air Duct Leakage Test Manual

items.text: Verify test pressure is held for a minimum of 5 minutes without excessive drop.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pressure drop during hold period does not exceed 10% of initial test pressure.

items.text: Verify hanger/support spacing does not exceed SMACNA maximum for duct size and type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Support spacing at or below SMACNA maximum interval table value.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Ch. 5

items.text: Confirm hangers are sized and rated for duct weight plus insulation and trapeze load.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hanger strap/rod size meets or exceeds SMACNA minimum for calculated load.
items.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Ch. 5

items.text: Verify duct is level and pitched as required for condensate-producing systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1/8 in. per ft slope toward drain point on condensate-producing duct runs.

items.text: Confirm minimum clearance is maintained from structure, sprinkler piping, and electrical.
items.acceptance_criteria: Clearances match coordination drawing with no conflicts or contact points.

items.text: Verify flexible duct runs do not exceed 5 ft in length and are free of kinks or compression.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flex duct fully extended, supported at max 4 ft intervals, length ≤ 5 ft, no sharp bends.

items.text: Verify fire dampers are installed at all fire-rated wall/floor penetrations per approved schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fire damper present at every scheduled fire-rated penetration; none omitted.

items.text: Confirm fire damper sleeve, breakaway connection, and access door are installed per UL listing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installation matches manufacturer's UL-listed installation instructions exactly.

items.text: Verify fusible link rating matches the application.
items.acceptance_criteria: 165°F standard duty locations; 212°F for kitchen exhaust or elevated ambient locations.

items.text: Confirm smoke damper wiring is terminated and tested for a full open/close cycle.
items.acceptance_criteria: Damper fully strokes open and closed on command with no binding.

items.text: Verify annular space at fire-rated penetrations is fire-stopped per a listed system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Firestop material and installation match a tested/listed UL system assembly.

items.text: Confirm duct insulation R-value/thickness matches energy code and specification prior to enclosure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Insulation thickness and R-value match specified/code-minimum value for duct location.

items.text: Verify vapor barrier jacket is continuous with all seams taped on ductwork subject to condensation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No breaks in vapor barrier; all seams and staples taped on cold-duct/unconditioned space runs.

items.text: Confirm insulation is not compressed at hanger/support points.
items.acceptance_criteria: Full insulation thickness maintained at hanger straps; saddles or shields used where required.

items.text: Verify exposed duct insulation meets required flame spread/smoke developed rating.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flame spread ≤ 25 and smoke developed ≤ 50 per code.

items.text: Record leakage test results with test pressure, duration, and measured leakage rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test log completed with date, technician, section tested, and readings.

items.text: Attach photos of sealed joints and fire-rated penetrations prior to insulation cover-up.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum photo set covering all Seal Class A joints and fire/smoke damper installations.

items.text: Verify punch list items from this inspection are resolved before ceiling/wall closure.
items.acceptance_criteria: All noted deficiencies corrected and re-verified prior to concealment.

items.text: Inspector sign-off recorded prior to insulation and ceiling closure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file before next construction stage proceeds.

templates.name: Electrical Wiring Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Verifies branch circuit and feeder wiring, boxes, terminations, grounding/bonding, and overcurrent protection comply with NEC/NFPA 70 requirements prior to closing walls or energizing circuits.
prerequisites: Approved electrical plans and panel schedules on site
Electrical permit posted
Rough-in framing complete for area under inspection

items.text: Verify electrical permit and approved plans on site match installed conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permit posted/available; installed circuiting matches approved plan set.

items.text: Confirm panel schedules are available and updated to reflect any circuit changes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Panel schedule legible and matches as-built circuit assignments.

items.text: Verify wiring devices and equipment carry appropriate listing marks.
items.acceptance_criteria: UL/ETL or equivalent NRTL listing mark present and matches specification.

items.text: Confirm arc-flash and equipment labeling requirements are identified for later application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Equipment requiring arc-flash labels is noted on inspection log for follow-up.

items.text: Verify conductor type and insulation rating matches application and location.
items.acceptance_criteria: Conductor type (NM-B, THHN/THWN, etc.) rated for location (wet, damp, dry) per schedule.

items.text: Confirm cable/conduit support spacing does not exceed NEC maximum intervals for the method used.
items.acceptance_criteria: Support intervals at or below NEC maximum for cable/raceway type and size.

items.text: Verify conductors are protected from physical damage where passing through framing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 1-1/4 in. edge distance maintained, or 1/16 in. steel plate installed where less.

items.text: Confirm raceway/cable fill does not exceed NEC allowable percentage for conductor count.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calculated fill percentage does not exceed NEC Chapter 9, Table 1 maximum.

items.text: Verify separation is maintained between low-voltage and line-voltage wiring.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum separation or barrier maintained per code and manufacturer requirements.

items.text: Verify outlet/junction box fill does not exceed allowable volume for conductor and device count.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calculated box fill (conductors, devices, clamps, fittings) does not exceed box cubic-inch capacity.

items.text: Confirm boxes are secured and set flush with finished surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: Box front edge set flush, or recessed no more than 1/4 in. on combustible surfaces.

items.text: Verify boxes are accessible and not concealed without an approved cover.
items.acceptance_criteria: All junction/pull boxes remain accessible or have an approved access panel.

items.text: Confirm unused box openings are closed with approved fittings.
items.acceptance_criteria: No open knockouts or unused cable entries left unsealed.

items.text: Verify conductor ampacity matches the overcurrent protection device rating.
items.acceptance_criteria: Conductor ampacity per NEC Table 310.16 equals or exceeds the OCPD rating for the circuit.

items.text: Confirm terminations are torqued to the manufacturer's listed value using a calibrated torque tool.
items.acceptance_criteria: Torque applied matches equipment nameplate/listing value; verified with calibrated tool.

items.text: Verify no more than one conductor is installed under a single-wire binding screw unless listed for multiple.
items.acceptance_criteria: One conductor per terminal unless terminal is listed and marked for multiple conductors.

items.text: Confirm conductor color coding is consistent throughout the installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ungrounded conductors, neutral (white/gray), and equipment ground (green/bare) correctly identified.

items.text: Verify splices are made only within accessible boxes using listed connectors.
items.acceptance_criteria: No splices buried in walls/ceilings outside an accessible box; listed wire connectors used.

items.text: Verify equipment grounding conductor is sized per NEC Table 250.122 for the OCPD rating.
items.acceptance_criteria: EGC size meets or exceeds NEC Table 250.122 minimum for the circuit's overcurrent device.

items.text: Confirm the grounding electrode system is bonded per NEC 250 Part III.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ground rod, rebar (Ufer), and/or water pipe electrodes bonded with correctly sized GEC.

items.text: Verify ground rod resistance to earth does not exceed 25 ohms, or a supplemental rod is installed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured resistance ≤ 25 ohms for a single rod, or second rod installed per code.

items.text: Confirm metal enclosures, raceways, and equipment are bonded to the equipment grounding conductor.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous low-impedance bonding path verified for all metallic enclosures/raceways.

items.text: Verify neutral and ground are bonded only at the service disconnect, not at subpanels.
items.acceptance_criteria: No neutral-ground bonding jumper present in downstream panelboards; isolated neutral bus used.

items.text: Verify GFCI protection is provided for receptacles in required locations.
items.acceptance_criteria: GFCI protection present at bathrooms, kitchens, garages, outdoors, and other required locations.

items.text: Confirm AFCI protection is provided for required dwelling unit branch circuits.
items.acceptance_criteria: AFCI breaker/device installed for bedrooms, living areas, and other required spaces.

items.text: Verify GFCI devices trip within rated time when tested.
items.acceptance_criteria: Device trips when tested with integral test button and handheld GFCI tester.

items.text: Confirm AFCI breakers pass self-test with no nuisance tripping under normal load.
items.acceptance_criteria: Breaker holds under normal load and trips correctly on integral test function.

items.text: Verify panel is installed with required working clearance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3 ft deep by 30 in. wide dedicated working space maintained in front of panel.

items.text: Confirm breaker/fuse ratings match conductor ampacity and equipment schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: OCPD rating does not exceed conductor ampacity or equipment schedule value.

items.text: Verify panel directory is complete, legible, and accurately identifies each circuit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every circuit labeled with accurate room/load description.

items.text: Confirm double-tapped breakers are not present unless listed for multiple conductors.
items.acceptance_criteria: No more than one conductor per breaker terminal unless terminal is listed for two.

items.text: Verify panel enclosure is properly grounded with cover installed and no open knockouts.
items.acceptance_criteria: Panel cover secured, all knockouts closed, enclosure bonded to EGC.

items.text: Record torque values and grounding resistance test results on inspection log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log includes measured values, instrument used, and technician name.

items.text: Attach photos of panel labeling, grounding connections, and any deficiencies found.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo set documents panel directory, grounding electrode connection, and corrected items.

items.text: Verify all deficiencies noted during inspection are corrected and re-checked.
items.acceptance_criteria: Punch list items closed with re-inspection initials before cover-up or energization.

items.text: Inspector sign-off recorded prior to wall closure or circuit energization.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file before next construction stage proceeds.

templates.name: Plumbing Pipe Pressure Testing Checklist
templates.description: Verifies drain-waste-vent, domestic water supply, and fuel gas piping systems are pressure/water tested and free of leaks in accordance with IPC/UPC requirements prior to concealment.
prerequisites: Piping system complete and accessible for inspection
Approved plumbing isometric/riser drawings on site
Calibrated test gauges available

items.text: Verify piping system is complete and accessible for inspection prior to concealment.
items.acceptance_criteria: All joints, fittings, and connections visible; no sections buried or enclosed before test.

items.text: Confirm all open ends, fixtures, and cleanouts are properly capped or plugged for the test.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unplugged openings; test plugs rated for anticipated test pressure.

items.text: Verify test plugs/caps are rated for the test pressure to be applied.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plug/cap manufacturer rating equals or exceeds planned test pressure.

items.text: Confirm piping is braced/supported to resist test pressure thrust forces.
items.acceptance_criteria: Blocking or restraint provided at changes in direction and dead ends before pressurizing.

items.text: Verify pipe material and joint type match the approved specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed material (copper, PEX, CPVC, cast iron, PVC/ABS) and joining method match spec.

items.text: Fill DWV system with water to point of overflow or minimum 10 ft head at the lowest point.
items.acceptance_criteria: Water column maintained at minimum 10 ft head above the highest fitting in the section tested.

items.text: Verify water level is maintained for a minimum of 15 minutes with no visible drop.
items.acceptance_criteria: No measurable drop in water level over the 15-minute hold period.

items.text: Inspect all joints, fittings, and cleanouts for leakage during the test hold period.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible leakage, weeping, or moisture at any joint or fitting.

items.text: Confirm vent piping is included in the test and shows no leakage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Vent stacks and branches pressurized as part of the test with no leaks observed.

items.text: Verify test water is drained and the system flushed after a successful test.
items.acceptance_criteria: System fully drained and flushed; no standing water left in traps beyond normal seal.

items.text: Confirm water supply piping is hydrostatically tested at the code-specified pressure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test pressure equals at least 1.5x working pressure, or per local code minimum.

items.text: Alternatively, verify air test performed at minimum 100 psi where permitted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Air test pressure of at least 100 psi applied where hydrostatic test is not used.

items.text: Verify test pressure is held for a minimum of 15 minutes with no pressure loss.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gauge reading unchanged (within instrument tolerance) over the 15-minute hold period.

items.text: Inspect all joints and connections for leaks or pressure drop during the hold period.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible leaks, weeping, or gauge pressure drop observed at any connection.

items.text: Confirm the pressure gauge used for the test is calibrated and rated for the test pressure range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gauge calibration current and full-scale range appropriate for the applied test pressure.

items.text: Verify fuel gas piping is tested at minimum 1.5x proposed maximum working pressure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test pressure at least 1.5x working pressure, not less than 3 psi.

items.text: Confirm test duration is held for the code-required minimum period.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 10-minute hold for systems tested at 3 psi or less, or per AHJ requirement.

items.text: Verify no perceptible pressure drop is observed on the gauge during the hold period.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gauge reading remains stable within instrument tolerance for entire hold period.

items.text: Confirm gas piping is purged of air and properly odorized prior to placing in service.
items.acceptance_criteria: Purge performed to outdoor safe location; odorant present at point of use before service.

items.text: Verify test gauge range and accuracy are appropriate for the test pressure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gauge full-scale reading no more than approximately 2x the applied test pressure.

items.text: Confirm the test area is barricaded and signage posted during pressurized testing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warning signage and barricades in place around pressurized piping during test.

items.text: Verify a relief valve or pressure-limiting device is in place for air/pneumatic tests.
items.acceptance_criteria: Relief device set below the rating of the weakest system component.

items.text: Confirm personnel remain clear of pipe ends and joints during initial pressurization.
items.acceptance_criteria: No personnel positioned in line with end caps/plugs while pressure is being applied.

items.text: Document test pressure, hold time, and start/end gauge readings on the test log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log includes system tested, pressure applied, duration, and readings.

items.text: Verify any leaks identified are repaired and the system is re-tested from the start.
items.acceptance_criteria: Repaired section retested at full duration and pressure with passing result.

items.text: Confirm a witness observes and signs test results where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspector or owner's representative signature present on test log where required.

items.text: Verify test results are recorded with date, time, ambient temperature, and technician name.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete test record retained in project documentation.

items.text: Attach photos of pressure gauge readings at start and end of hold period.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos clearly show gauge face, pressure value, and timestamp.

items.text: Verify punch list items from failed sections are resolved and re-tested.
items.acceptance_criteria: All noted deficiencies corrected and re-verified before concealment.

items.text: Confirm test certificate is signed by technician and, where required, by inspector of record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Completed and signed test certificate filed with project closeout records.

items.text: Inspector sign-off recorded prior to concealment of piping.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file before pipe is enclosed or covered.

templates.name: Fixture Installation Checklist (Sinks, Toilets, etc.)
templates.description: Verifies plumbing fixtures are set, connected, and finished correctly, including accessibility mounting heights and clearances, before substantial completion.
prerequisites: Rough-in inspection approved
Approved fixture submittals on site
Finish flooring/countertops installed at fixture locations

items.text: Verify fixture model, color, and trim match the approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fixture model number and finish match approved submittal/schedule.

items.text: Confirm rough-in dimensions match fixture requirements before setting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drain and supply locations within fixture manufacturer's rough-in tolerance.

items.text: Inspect fixture for damage, cracks, or chips prior to installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible cracks, chips, or crazing on fixture surface before setting.

items.text: Confirm supply stops and shutoff valves are accessible per code.
items.acceptance_criteria: Shutoff valve reachable without removing fixed cabinetry or finishes.

items.text: Verify water closet is set on a wax ring or approved gasket with no rock or movement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fixture sits flat and stable with no rocking when pressure applied at rim.

items.text: Confirm closet bolts are capped and the fixture is secured to the floor flange.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bolts snug (not overtightened), caps installed, fixture firmly anchored.

items.text: Verify flush volume complies with water-efficiency requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Maximum 1.28 gal/flush for water closets; 0.5 gal/flush for urinals.

items.text: Confirm seat height and clearances meet requirements for accessible fixtures where designated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Accessible-designated fixtures meet required seat height and clear floor space.

items.text: Verify no leakage at the base or supply connection after fixture is set and pressurized.
items.acceptance_criteria: No water observed at base, supply connection, or flush valve under operating pressure.

items.text: Verify lavatory/sink is level and securely mounted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fixture level within 1/8 in. across the rim; no movement when load applied.

items.text: Confirm P-trap and tailpiece connections are properly sized and sealed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trap size matches fixture drain outlet; slip joints hand-tight plus 1/4 turn, no leaks.

items.text: Verify sink overflow, where provided, is unobstructed and functional.
items.acceptance_criteria: Overflow channel clear of obstruction and drains freely when tested.

items.text: Confirm fixture drain and supply connections show no leaks under operating pressure.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible leakage at any connection point after running fixture for 2 minutes.

items.text: Verify countertop cutout and fixture edge are properly sealed against moisture intrusion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous sealant bead with no gaps around fixture-to-countertop joint.

items.text: Verify faucet aerator flow rate matches specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Maximum 1.2 gpm at lavatories; 1.8 gpm at kitchen faucets per WaterSense requirement.

items.text: Confirm supply stops are the specified type and operate freely.
items.acceptance_criteria: Quarter-turn ball-type stops open/close smoothly with no leaks at packing nut.

items.text: Verify trim is installed with no gaps at wall/floor penetrations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Escutcheons, handles, and covers seated flush with no visible gap or sharp edge.

items.text: Confirm hot water supply is piped to the correct side per standard convention.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hot water on the left, cold water on the right, when facing the fixture.

items.text: Verify accessible water closet centerline distance from adjacent wall.
items.acceptance_criteria: Centerline located 16-18 in. from the adjacent side wall.

items.text: Confirm accessible water closet seat height above finished floor.
items.acceptance_criteria: Seat height 17-19 in. AFF, including seat.

items.text: Verify grab bars are installed at the rated height and anchored to structural blocking.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grab bar centerline 33-36 in. AFF, anchored to blocking capable of resisting 250 lb load.

items.text: Confirm accessible lavatory rim height and knee clearance below.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rim/counter height max 34 in. AFF with minimum 27 in. knee clearance underneath.

items.text: Verify faucet controls are operable with one hand without tight grasping or twisting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lever, push-type, or electronic sensor control operable with a closed fist.

items.text: Confirm exposed hot water and drain pipes under accessible lavatories are insulated or configured to prevent contact.
items.acceptance_criteria: Supply and drain piping insulated or otherwise protected against inadvertent contact.

items.text: Verify perimeter caulking is continuous and free of gaps at fixture joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Smooth, continuous bead at all fixture-to-wall and fixture-to-floor joints.

items.text: Confirm caulking/sealant color matches specification and is fully cured before use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sealant color per finish schedule; cure time per manufacturer data sheet observed.

items.text: Verify no scratches, chips, or finish defects on visible fixture surfaces.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible surface defects under normal lighting at close inspection distance.

items.text: Confirm protective coverings remain in place on new fixtures until substantial completion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer protective film/covering intact and undamaged.

items.text: Verify fixture flushes/drains completely with no clogging or slow drainage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Full flush/drain cycle completes with no standing water after 30 seconds.

items.text: Confirm hot water reaches the fixture at design temperature within acceptable time.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hot water temperature at fixture does not exceed 120°F.

items.text: Verify no cross-connection or backflow issue is observed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Air gap or approved backflow prevention device present and functioning at each fixture requiring it.

items.text: Confirm all fixture operations function smoothly through a full cycle.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flush valve, faucet, and drain stopper operate without sticking or excess force.

items.text: Record fixture serial/model numbers and installation date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log includes fixture location, model number, and date installed.

items.text: Attach photos of installed fixtures, accessible clearances, and any deficiencies.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo set documents final condition and accessibility compliance measurements.

items.text: Verify all punch list items from this inspection are corrected and re-checked.
items.acceptance_criteria: Noted deficiencies resolved and re-verified before turnover.

items.text: Inspector sign-off recorded prior to substantial completion walkthrough.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file.

templates.name: Fire Sprinkler System Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies fire sprinkler piping, head spacing, hangers, and system components are installed per NFPA 13 and successfully hydrostatically tested prior to concealment and system acceptance.
prerequisites: Approved hydraulic calculations and shop drawings on site
Water supply flow test data available
AHJ notified of scheduled acceptance test

items.text: Verify approved hydraulic calculations and shop drawings are on site and match the installed layout.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed pipe routing, sizing, and head layout match the approved hydraulic calc package.

items.text: Confirm sprinkler system design occupancy hazard classification matches building use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hazard classification (light, ordinary, extra) matches actual occupancy/use of each area.

items.text: Verify water supply flow test data used for hydraulic design is documented and current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flow test data dated and referenced on hydraulic calculation title page.

items.text: Confirm all sprinkler components are listed and labeled for fire protection service.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sprinkler heads, pipe, and fittings carry UL/FM listing appropriate for the application.

items.text: Verify pipe material and schedule/wall thickness match the hydraulic design and listing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed pipe schedule matches the hydraulic calculation and manufacturer listing.

items.text: Confirm pipe joints are made per manufacturer listing and NFPA 13 requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Threaded, grooved, or welded joints made per listed installation instructions.

items.text: Verify branch line and cross main sizing matches the hydraulic calculation sheet.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed pipe diameters match the sizing shown on the hydraulic calc printout.

items.text: Confirm piping is flushed clear of debris prior to sprinkler head installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flush water runs clear with no visible debris before heads are installed.

items.text: Inspect pipe for corrosion, dents, or damage prior to closing in.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible corrosion, dents, or coating damage on installed pipe.

items.text: Verify maximum sprinkler coverage area does not exceed the hazard classification limit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Coverage per head ≤ 225 sq ft for light hazard, standard spray, or per applicable hazard table.

items.text: Confirm maximum spacing between sprinklers does not exceed the applicable table limit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sprinkler-to-sprinkler spacing ≤ 15 ft for light hazard, standard spray, or per table.

items.text: Verify sprinkler deflector distance below ceiling is within the listed range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deflector positioned 1-12 in. below ceiling for standard upright/pendent heads, per listing.

items.text: Confirm distance from sprinkler to wall does not exceed one-half the allowable spacing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wall-to-head distance ≤ 1/2 of the maximum allowable sprinkler spacing.

items.text: Verify obstructions below sprinklers meet minimum clearance requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 18 in. clearance maintained below sprinkler deflector, or per obstruction formula.

items.text: Confirm sprinkler heads are the correct temperature rating and type for the design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Head type (upright, pendent, sidewall) and temperature rating match design schedule.

items.text: Verify hanger spacing does not exceed the maximum interval for pipe size.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hanger spacing at or below NFPA 13 maximum interval for the pipe size installed.

items.text: Confirm each length of pipe has at least one hanger unless exempted.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unsupported pipe lengths exceeding code exemption criteria.

items.text: Verify seismic bracing is installed per design at required intervals.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lateral and longitudinal sway bracing installed at spacing shown on approved drawings.

items.text: Confirm flexible couplings and clearance are provided at building expansion/seismic joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flex coupling or sleeve provided where piping crosses a building seismic/expansion joint.

items.text: Verify system is hydrostatically tested at 200 psi or 50 psi above working pressure, whichever is greater.
items.acceptance_criteria: Applied test pressure meets or exceeds 200 psi (or working pressure + 50 psi if higher).

items.text: Confirm test pressure is held for a minimum of 2 hours with no leakage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pressure maintained for 2 continuous hours with no drop and no visible leakage.

items.text: Verify gauge readings are recorded at start and end of test.
items.acceptance_criteria: Start and end pressure readings logged; no unexplained drop.

items.text: Inspect all joints, fittings, and sprinkler connections for leaks during the test.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible leakage at any joint, fitting, or head connection.

items.text: Verify test results are documented on the material and test certificate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Contractor's material and test certificate completed and signed.

items.text: Verify the main control valve is supervised per code.
items.acceptance_criteria: Electronic tamper switch or approved chain-and-lock supervision installed on control valve.

items.text: Confirm the alarm check valve/flow switch is installed and wired to the fire alarm panel.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flow switch wired and confirmed to annunciate at the fire alarm control panel.

items.text: Verify the fire department connection is accessible, identified, and has a check valve installed.
items.acceptance_criteria: FDC unobstructed, marked with sign, and equipped with listed check valve.

items.text: Confirm the inspector's test connection is installed at the hydraulically most remote point.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test connection located at the system's most remote/hydraulically demanding sprinkler.

items.text: Verify a backflow preventer is installed and tested per local water authority requirements, where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Backflow device installed, tested, and results submitted to the water authority.

items.text: Attach the completed contractor's material and test certificate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certificate includes test pressure, duration, flush results, and signatures.

items.text: Verify punch list items identified during testing are corrected and re-tested.
items.acceptance_criteria: All noted deficiencies resolved with passing re-test before concealment.

items.text: Confirm AHJ or third-party witness sign-off is obtained where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature of AHJ/witness present on test certificate where required by code.

items.text: Inspector sign-off recorded prior to ceiling closure or system acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file before next construction stage proceeds.

templates.name: System Functional Testing Checklist (MEP Systems)
templates.description: Verifies mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems respond correctly to normal, alarm, and failure conditions through structured functional performance testing, per the commissioning process.
prerequisites: Prefunctional checklists complete for all systems under test
Approved sequence of operations and test scripts available
Systems started up and stable in automatic mode

items.text: Verify prefunctional checklists for all systems under test are complete and signed off.
items.acceptance_criteria: Startup and prefunctional checklists on file with no outstanding open items.

items.text: Confirm systems have completed startup and are stable prior to functional testing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Systems running in normal automatic mode with no active fault alarms.

items.text: Verify test procedures and pass/fail criteria are reviewed with all participating trades.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pre-test briefing conducted; trades acknowledge test script and criteria.

items.text: Confirm test instrumentation is calibrated with current calibration dates.
items.acceptance_criteria: All test meters/gauges show calibration sticker dated within the last 12 months.

items.text: Verify safety precautions and lockout/tagout procedures are in place for testing energized/pressurized systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: LOTO and PPE requirements confirmed before simulating fault/failure conditions.

items.text: Verify air handling unit responds correctly to occupied/unoccupied schedule changes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unit starts/stops and resets setpoints per programmed schedule within 5 minutes of change.

items.text: Confirm supply air temperature reset sequence operates within design setpoints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured discharge temperature tracks reset schedule within ±2°F of setpoint.

items.text: Verify economizer/outdoor air damper modulates correctly with changing outdoor conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Damper position responds correctly to simulated outdoor air temperature/enthalpy changes.

items.text: Confirm safety interlocks trip equipment as designed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Freeze stat, high/low pressure, and smoke detector inputs correctly shut down associated equipment.

items.text: Verify air balance readings are within tolerance of design airflow at test points.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured airflow within ±10% of design cfm at spot-checked terminals.

items.text: Verify emergency/standby generator starts and transfers load within the code-required time.
items.acceptance_criteria: Generator assumes life-safety load within 10 seconds of simulated utility loss.

items.text: Confirm the automatic transfer switch operates correctly on simulated utility loss and restoration.
items.acceptance_criteria: ATS transfers to emergency source and retransfers to normal source without interruption to load.

items.text: Verify lighting control sequences function as programmed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Occupancy sensors, daylight harvesting, and schedules operate per sequence of operations.

items.text: Confirm emergency lighting and exit signage activate on power loss for the required duration.
items.acceptance_criteria: Emergency lighting remains illuminated for a minimum of 90 minutes on battery/generator power.

items.text: Verify panel/equipment load readings are within the expected range under normal operation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured load consistent with design load calculations, no unexpected overload.

items.text: Verify domestic water booster pump cycles correctly between lead/lag setpoints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pump staging matches programmed lead/lag pressure setpoints during simulated demand.

items.text: Confirm sump/sewage ejector pumps activate and deactivate at the correct float levels.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pump on/off levels match design float settings; alarm float triggers as designed.

items.text: Verify backflow preventers hold test pressure with no leakage past check valves.
items.acceptance_criteria: No pressure drop indicating check valve leakage during field test.

items.text: Confirm hot water recirculation system maintains setpoint temperature at the farthest fixture.
items.acceptance_criteria: Return water temperature at farthest fixture within design range.

items.text: Verify fire alarm activation shuts down associated air handling units per sequence.
items.acceptance_criteria: AHUs serving the alarmed zone shut down within the programmed response time.

items.text: Confirm smoke dampers close and stairwell pressurization fans activate on alarm signal.
items.acceptance_criteria: All associated smoke dampers close and pressurization fans start on simulated alarm.

items.text: Verify elevator recall sequence functions correctly on smoke detector activation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevators recall to designated floor and doors open per sequence on simulated alarm.

items.text: Confirm door hold-open devices release on fire alarm signal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Magnetic hold-opens release doors within seconds of alarm activation.

items.text: Verify mass notification/voice evacuation audio is intelligible at test locations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Audio message clear and understandable at all spot-checked locations.

items.text: Verify the building automation system correctly displays real-time status of all tested points.
items.acceptance_criteria: BAS graphics update to reflect actual field conditions within expected refresh interval.

items.text: Confirm alarms generated during functional tests are correctly logged and annunciated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Simulated fault conditions generate corresponding alarms in the BAS alarm log.

items.text: Verify systems return to normal operating mode automatically after test/override is cleared.
items.acceptance_criteria: All overridden points return to automatic control without manual intervention.

items.text: Confirm functional test results are compared against the design sequence of operations with deviations logged.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deviation report generated for any test result not matching the design sequence.

items.text: Record all functional test results, deviations, and corrective actions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test report includes point-by-point results and disposition of any failures.

items.text: Attach photos/screenshots of BAS trend data supporting test results.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trend graphs attached showing setpoint response during each functional test.

items.text: Verify all failed tests are corrected and successfully re-tested.
items.acceptance_criteria: Retest results documented and passing before test is marked complete.

items.text: Commissioning agent sign-off recorded prior to system acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file.

templates.name: Building Automation System (BAS) Configuration Checklist
templates.description: Verifies BAS controllers, points, control sequences, graphics, alarming, and cybersecurity settings are correctly configured and validated before system turnover.
prerequisites: Approved points list and sequence of operations on site
Network/IT coordination with owner completed
Controllers powered and physically installed

items.text: Verify all controllers are addressed and communicating on the network per the points list.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every controller on the points list is online and reporting to the front end.

items.text: Confirm controller firmware/software versions match the approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed firmware/software version matches the approved submittal revision.

items.text: Verify network wiring is installed per manufacturer standards.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bus topology followed, end-of-line termination resistors installed at both ends only.

items.text: Confirm backup power maintains controller configuration through power loss.
items.acceptance_criteria: Controller retains program and setpoints after simulated power interruption.

items.text: Verify controller programming is backed up and archived off the device.
