items.acceptance_criteria: Current program file saved to project archive location separate from the controller.

items.text: Verify each physical input point reads an accurate value compared to a calibrated reference instrument.
items.acceptance_criteria: Point value matches calibrated reference reading within manufacturer accuracy tolerance.

items.text: Confirm each physical output point commands the correct field device through its full range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Output point drives connected device through 0-100% range without error.

items.text: Verify point naming convention matches the approved points list and BAS standard.
items.acceptance_criteria: Point names match approved naming convention exactly, no abbleviations deviations.

items.text: Confirm analog sensor calibration is within tolerance of span.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sensor reading within ±2% of span compared to calibrated reference.

items.text: Verify all points on the approved list are mapped and visible in the BAS front end.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of points list items present and displaying live values in the front end.

items.text: Verify occupied/unoccupied scheduling matches the approved sequence of operations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Schedule start/stop times and setback setpoints match approved sequence document.

items.text: Confirm supply air temperature reset sequence is configured per approved setpoints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reset schedule and reset limits match the design sequence of operations.

items.text: Verify static pressure reset (trim and respond) logic is programmed per specified sequence.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trim/respond parameters (timers, increments, limits) match Guideline 36 sequence where specified.

items.text: Confirm economizer high-limit lockout setpoints are configured for the climate zone.
items.acceptance_criteria: High-limit switchover setpoint matches climate zone requirement in the sequence.

items.text: Verify optimal start/stop routine adjusts based on zone temperature and outdoor conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Start time varies logically with measured zone temperature deviation and outdoor conditions.

items.text: Confirm demand control ventilation sequence modulates outdoor air per CO2 setpoint.
items.acceptance_criteria: Outdoor air damper position responds to CO2 sensor readings per programmed setpoint curve.

items.text: Verify system graphics accurately represent equipment layout with real-time point updates.
items.acceptance_criteria: Graphic layout matches physical equipment arrangement; values refresh within expected interval.

items.text: Confirm navigation between graphics functions without errors.
items.acceptance_criteria: Links between floor plans, equipment detail, and trend screens work without broken links.

items.text: Verify color conventions for alarms/status are consistent across all graphics.
items.acceptance_criteria: Alarm, override, and normal status colors applied consistently per project standard.

items.text: Confirm operators can manually override points from graphics with appropriate access level.
items.acceptance_criteria: Override function available to authorized operator roles and correctly commands the point.

items.text: Verify critical alarms are configured and route to designated recipients.
items.acceptance_criteria: High/low temp, equipment failure, and freeze protection alarms route to correct contact list.

items.text: Confirm alarm priority levels and escalation timing match owner's requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Priority classification and escalation delay match owner's approved alarm matrix.

items.text: Verify trend logs are configured for key points with an appropriate sample interval.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trend sample interval set between 5 and 15 minutes for key performance points.

items.text: Confirm trend data storage duration meets commissioning and owner requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 12 months of rolling trend data retained per owner requirement.

items.text: Verify a test alarm is generated and confirmed received by the designated recipient.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test alarm successfully received via email/text/BAS notification within expected time.

items.text: Verify default passwords on all controllers and front-end software have been changed.
items.acceptance_criteria: No controller or workstation login remains at factory-default credentials.

items.text: Confirm user access levels are configured per role.
items.acceptance_criteria: View-only, operator, and administrator roles assigned per owner's access matrix.

items.text: Verify the BAS network is segmented from the general IT network per owner's policy.
items.acceptance_criteria: BAS traffic isolated on a dedicated VLAN or network segment per IT security policy.

items.text: Confirm remote access to the BAS is secured where enabled.
items.acceptance_criteria: VPN and multi-factor authentication required for any remote BAS access.

items.text: Record final points list, sequence configuration, and any approved deviations.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-configured points list and sequence document archived in project record.

items.text: Attach screenshots of key graphics, alarm configuration, and trend setup.
items.acceptance_criteria: Screenshot set documents final front-end configuration for closeout package.

items.text: Verify all punch list items from configuration review are resolved.
items.acceptance_criteria: Noted deficiencies corrected and re-verified before turnover.

items.text: Controls technician and commissioning agent sign-off recorded prior to turnover.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file.

templates.name: Performance Testing Checklist
templates.description: Verifies measured air, water, electrical, and comfort performance of installed MEP systems meets design intent through test and balance and field measurement, per ASHRAE 111 and the commissioning process.
prerequisites: Systems started up and operating in automatic mode
Approved design airflow/waterflow schedules on site
Calibrated test instruments available

items.text: Verify all systems have completed startup and TAB pre-checks and are in normal automatic operation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No open startup deficiencies; systems running in normal automatic control mode.

items.text: Confirm test instruments are calibrated within the last 12 months with certificates available.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calibration certificates on file dated within the past 12 months for all test instruments.

items.text: Verify outdoor air and building conditions are within acceptable range for valid testing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Testing not conducted during extreme weather events or unrepresentative conditions.

items.text: Confirm design documents and approved test report format are available for recording results.
items.acceptance_criteria: Design airflow/waterflow schedules and standard TAB report forms available on site.

items.text: Verify total system airflow is within tolerance of design cfm at the air handling unit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Total measured supply airflow within ±10% of scheduled design cfm.

items.text: Confirm individual terminal/diffuser airflow is within tolerance of design cfm.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured terminal airflow within ±10% of design cfm for each outlet tested.

items.text: Verify building/zone pressurization relationships match design intent.
items.acceptance_criteria: Positive/negative pressure relationships between adjacent zones match design (e.g., clean rooms positive, restrooms negative).

items.text: Confirm fan motor amperage does not exceed nameplate full load amps during balancing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured amperage at or below motor nameplate FLA at final balanced condition.

items.text: Verify outdoor air ventilation rate meets or exceeds code minimum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured outdoor air intake meets or exceeds ASHRAE 62.1 minimum ventilation rate.

items.text: Verify hydronic system flow rates are within tolerance of design gpm at each terminal unit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured flow within ±10% of design gpm at each balanced terminal.

items.text: Confirm pump differential pressure matches the design curve at the measured flow rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured pump head consistent with manufacturer's pump curve at operating flow.

items.text: Verify chilled/hot water supply and return temperature differential matches design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured delta-T within design range, typically 10-20°F.

items.text: Confirm balancing valves are set and locked/marked at final position.
items.acceptance_criteria: Valve position marked/memory-stopped and locked at final balanced setting.

items.text: Verify no air is present in the hydronic system affecting flow readings.
items.acceptance_criteria: System fully vented with no air noise or erratic flow readings at test points.

items.text: Verify measured equipment amperage draw is within nameplate rating under full operating load.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured amperage does not exceed equipment nameplate full load amps.

items.text: Confirm voltage at equipment terminals is within tolerance of nameplate rated voltage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured voltage within ±10% of nameplate rated voltage.

items.text: Verify three-phase voltage/current imbalance does not exceed tolerance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Phase-to-phase imbalance does not exceed 2%.

items.text: Confirm power factor and harmonic distortion readings are recorded for major equipment where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Readings logged for VFDs and large motor loads per project requirements.

items.text: Verify space temperature is maintained within tolerance of setpoint during occupied hours.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured space temperature within ±2°F of setpoint at spot-checked locations.

items.text: Confirm space relative humidity is maintained within the design range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured relative humidity between 30% and 60% at spot-checked locations.

items.text: Verify sound levels in occupied spaces do not exceed design criteria.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured sound level at or below design NC/RC criteria for the space type.

items.text: Confirm lighting levels meet design footcandle targets at task surfaces.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured illuminance meets or exceeds design footcandle target at representative points.

items.text: Verify no drafts, hot/cold spots, or stratification are reported during walkthrough.
items.acceptance_criteria: No occupant-noticeable draft, temperature stratification, or dead zones observed.

items.text: Verify chiller/boiler efficiency is measured and compared to rated performance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured kW/ton or combustion efficiency within acceptable range of rated performance.

items.text: Confirm economizer operation reduces mechanical cooling energy use when outdoor conditions allow.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mechanical cooling stages lock out or reduce when economizer conditions are favorable.

items.text: Verify variable frequency drives modulate speed correctly in response to load.
items.acceptance_criteria: VFD speed varies with measured load rather than running continuously at full speed.

items.text: Confirm overall system performance data is compared against the basis-of-design energy model where available.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured performance data reviewed against energy model assumptions with variances noted.

items.text: Record all measured readings on the standard TAB/performance test report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete report includes location, design value, measured value, and instrument used.

items.text: Attach photos of test instrument readings at key measurement points.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo set documents gauge/meter readings supporting recorded values.

items.text: Verify all out-of-tolerance readings are corrected and re-tested.
items.acceptance_criteria: Adjustments made and re-measured values fall within tolerance before report is finalized.

items.text: TAB technician/commissioning agent sign-off recorded on final performance report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file.

templates.name: Operation and Functionality Checklist
templates.description: Verifies installed MEP equipment operates correctly through its full range, safety interlocks function, and O&M documentation and owner training are complete prior to final closeout.
prerequisites: Functional performance testing complete
Equipment run-in period completed
Draft O&M manuals submitted

items.text: Verify all MEP equipment starts, runs, and stops without abnormal noise, vibration, or alarms.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unusual noise, vibration, or fault alarms during a full start/run/stop cycle.

items.text: Confirm equipment operates through its full range of modulation without binding.
items.acceptance_criteria: VFDs, dampers, and valves travel through full 0-100% range smoothly with no binding.

items.text: Verify equipment nameplate data matches the approved schedule and submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Model, serial number, voltage, and capacity match approved equipment schedule.

items.text: Confirm rotation direction of motors, fans, and pumps is correct.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rotation matches directional arrow on housing; airflow/waterflow direction confirmed correct.

items.text: Verify vibration and bearing temperatures are within manufacturer's acceptable limits after run-in.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured vibration and bearing temperature within manufacturer's published limits.

items.text: Verify equipment responds correctly to BAS commands.
items.acceptance_criteria: Start/stop, setpoint change, and staging commands from BAS produce correct equipment response.

items.text: Confirm manual hand-off-auto switches function correctly in each position.
items.acceptance_criteria: Equipment responds correctly in Hand, Off, and Auto switch positions.

items.text: Verify local control panel displays match actual operating conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Displayed values on local panel match independently measured field conditions.

items.text: Confirm interlocks between associated equipment function per sequence.
items.acceptance_criteria: Interlocked equipment (e.g., exhaust fan/makeup air unit) starts and stops together as designed.

items.text: Verify high/low pressure cutouts, freeze stats, and safeties trip within setpoint tolerance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Safety device trips within manufacturer's stated tolerance of its setpoint when tested.

items.text: Confirm emergency stop devices are accessible, labeled, and function correctly.
items.acceptance_criteria: E-stop button reachable, clearly labeled, and immediately de-energizes equipment when pressed.

items.text: Verify equipment guards and access panels are installed and secured.
items.acceptance_criteria: All belt guards, fan guards, and access panels in place and fastened.

items.text: Confirm lockout/tagout points are identified and accessible for maintenance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Disconnects and LOTO points labeled and reachable without special tools.

items.text: Verify overload protection and disconnect switches are within sight of the equipment served.
items.acceptance_criteria: Disconnecting means located within sight of, or lockable at, the equipment it serves.

items.text: Verify complete O&M manuals are submitted for all major equipment.
items.acceptance_criteria: O&M manuals include installation, operation, maintenance, and parts data for each major unit.

items.text: Confirm as-built drawings reflect final installed conditions and are submitted to the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Redline/as-built drawing set matches field-verified installed conditions.

items.text: Verify equipment warranty start dates and terms are documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty documentation lists start date, duration, and covered scope for each major system.

items.text: Confirm preventive maintenance schedules and service intervals are included in the O&M manual.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer-recommended PM tasks and intervals documented for each piece of equipment.

items.text: Verify TAB, commissioning, and startup reports are included in the closeout package.
items.acceptance_criteria: All test/startup reports referenced in the closeout package index are present and complete.

items.text: Verify manufacturer warranty documentation includes contact information for service.
items.acceptance_criteria: Service contact name, phone, and claim procedure included with warranty documents.

items.text: Confirm required spare parts are delivered to the owner per specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Specified spare filters, belts, fuses, and similar items delivered and itemized on a receipt.

items.text: Verify extra stock material quantities match contract requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Quantity of attic stock (filters, ceiling tiles, etc.) matches specification section.

items.text: Confirm attic stock and spare parts are labeled and stored in a designated location.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spare parts labeled by system/equipment and stored in an owner-accessible, designated area.

items.text: Verify owner's operating staff receives hands-on training on system operation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Training session conducted covering normal operation, alarms, and basic troubleshooting.

items.text: Confirm training session is recorded and provided to the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Video recording or attendance log with topics covered delivered to owner.

items.text: Verify system access credentials are transferred to the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: BAS logins, equipment passwords, and access credentials documented and handed over securely.

items.text: Confirm MEP-related punch list items are resolved and verified closed prior to final handover.
items.acceptance_criteria: All punch list items closed with sign-off before certificate of occupancy/final acceptance.

items.text: Record final equipment operating parameters and training attendance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log includes equipment readings at handover and list of trained personnel.

items.text: Attach photos of nameplate data and final equipment condition at handover.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo set documents as-installed condition and nameplate data for closeout record.

items.text: Verify owner acknowledges receipt of O&M manuals, spare parts, and training.
items.acceptance_criteria: Owner representative signature confirms receipt of closeout deliverables.

items.text: Commissioning agent and owner sign-off recorded at final system handover.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated approval on file marking system acceptance.

templates.name: Drywall Installation and Fastening Checklist
templates.description: Verifies substrate readiness, board selection, fastener pattern/spacing, and joint layout for gypsum board application in accordance with ASTM C840 and GA-216 prior to release for taping.
prerequisites: Approved framing inspection or rough-in sign-off on file
Gypsum board submittal/shop drawings approved
Building enclosed and weathertight (or temporary heat/humidity control in place)

items.text: Verify framing spacing matches board thickness/orientation requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stud/joist spacing does not exceed ASTM C840 Table 1 max spacing for the board thickness and application (e.g., 1/2 in board perpendicular max 24 in o.c.).

items.text: Check framing members for plane/alignment (no bowed or twisted studs).
items.acceptance_criteria: Framing face variance not exceeding 1/8 in over any 4 ft measured with a straightedge.

items.text: Confirm building is enclosed with temporary heat/ventilation if ambient conditions require it.
items.acceptance_criteria: Interior temperature maintained at minimum 40 deg F (55 deg F for adhesive application) for 48 hr before, during, and after board installation.

items.text: Verify moisture-sensitive areas (baths, mechanical rooms) are designated for moisture/mold-resistant board.
items.acceptance_criteria: Water-resistant or fiberglass-mat board specified within 12 in of shower/tub enclosures per drawings.

items.text: Confirm insulation, vapor retarder, and blocking are installed and inspected before boarding.
items.acceptance_criteria: All required backing, blocking, and insulation visible in inspection photos are in place and covered by prior sign-off.

items.text: Verify MEP rough-in is complete and inspected in areas to be boarded.
items.acceptance_criteria: Electrical, plumbing, and mechanical rough-in inspection approved for the area prior to board hang.

items.text: Inspect delivered board for damage (broken corners, water stains, crushed edges).
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible core damage, delamination, or water staining on boards to be installed.

items.text: Verify board is stored flat, off the ground, and protected from moisture.
items.acceptance_criteria: Board stacked flat on a minimum two 2x4 dunnage rails, covered, and not exposed to precipitation.

items.text: Confirm fastener type/length matches framing gauge and board thickness per schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener penetration into wood framing minimum 5/8 in; into steel framing minimum 3/8 in through the far side.

items.text: Verify screw gun depth-sensing setters are calibrated and functioning.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener heads seat slightly below board surface without breaking face paper.

items.text: Confirm board orientation (perpendicular vs. parallel) matches design/fire-rating requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Orientation matches approved shop drawings and any listed fire-rated assembly design.

items.text: Verify end joints are staggered and not aligned on adjacent courses.
items.acceptance_criteria: End joints offset minimum 1 stud/joist cavity (approx. 16-24 in) from adjacent course joints.

items.text: Check board-to-board gap at butt and edge joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gap not exceeding 1/8 in at abutting joints; boards not forced together.

items.text: Verify clearance gap at floor and where board meets dissimilar materials.
items.acceptance_criteria: 1/4 in to 3/8 in gap maintained at floor line and at masonry/concrete abutments.

items.text: Confirm double-layer or laminated assemblies have staggered joints between layers where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Base layer and face layer joints offset a minimum of 10 in, and not aligned with same-layer joints on opposite side.

items.text: Verify fastener spacing on ceilings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Screws spaced maximum 12 in o.c. field and edges for ceiling applications (7 in o.c. field for water-resistant/tile backer per manufacturer).

items.text: Verify fastener spacing on walls.
items.acceptance_criteria: Screws spaced maximum 16 in o.c. field and edges for wall applications on studs at 24 in o.c. or less.

items.text: Confirm fasteners are set back a minimum distance from board edges/ends.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fasteners located no closer than 3/8 in from edges and ends of board.

items.text: Check for over-driven or under-driven fasteners along a sample run.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fewer than 2 defective (broken paper, proud head, or missed framing) fasteners per 32 sf sampled area.

items.text: Verify adhesive application where laminating or adhesive-assisted attachment is specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Adhesive bead continuous per manufacturer pattern, supplemented with fasteners per ASTM C840 Table 5 spacing.

items.text: Confirm fastening at abutting panel edges is not omitted (no unsupported edges).
items.acceptance_criteria: All board edges bear on and are fastened to framing or blocking; no floating/unsupported edges beyond code limit.

items.text: Verify control joints are installed at required intervals.
items.acceptance_criteria: Control joints provided at maximum 30 ft spacing in walls and 50 ft in ceilings, or per design.

items.text: Confirm control joints are provided at partition intersections and long corridor runs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Control joint or relief detail present where partition length changes direction or exceeds 30 ft without a break.

items.text: Verify fire-rated assemblies match listed design (layers, fastener spacing, board type).
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed assembly matches UL/GA listed design number referenced on drawings with no deviations.

items.text: Check penetrations (outlets, ducts, pipes) are properly cut and fire-stopped where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Openings cut within 1/2 in of device/penetration with no oversized gaps; fire-rated penetrations sealed per listed system.

items.text: Verify openings for doors/windows are framed and boarded per detail, with corner reinforcement provided.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reinforcing strip or additional fastening provided at door/window corners to resist cracking.

items.text: Verify corner bead is installed at all exterior (outside) corners prior to release.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corner bead fastened or clinched at maximum 9 in o.c., straight and true.

items.text: Confirm curved or radius wall board is properly scored/wetted per manufacturer method where used.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible cracking or telegraphing along curved surfaces after installation.

items.text: Check that sound/acoustic-rated partitions have continuous board with sealed perimeter per assembly.
items.acceptance_criteria: Acoustic sealant bead continuous at top and bottom track with no gaps exceeding 1/4 in.

items.text: Photograph representative fastening pattern and any fire-rated assembly prior to closure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3 photos per area showing fastener spacing, joint stagger, and rated assembly layers if applicable.

items.text: Record board type, thickness, and manufacturer lot/batch used in the area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material data recorded matches approved submittal.

items.text: Note any deviations, rework items, or punch list items generated during this inspection.
items.acceptance_criteria: All deviations documented with location and corrective action assigned.

items.text: Inspector and superintendent sign off releasing area for taping and finishing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures and dates recorded before taping crew is mobilized.

templates.name: Taping & Mudding Inspection Checklist
templates.description: Verifies environmental conditions, joint treatment procedure, and finish level of gypsum board joint compound work against GA-214 Levels of Finish prior to priming.
prerequisites: Drywall installation checklist passed and area released for taping
Specified level of finish (0-5) identified per drawings/finish schedule

items.text: Verify ambient temperature and ventilation are within compound manufacturer's range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Temperature maintained at minimum 55 deg F (65 deg F recommended) continuously during application and cure.

items.text: Confirm relative humidity is controlled to allow proper compound cure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Relative humidity below 70% with adequate air movement across finished surfaces.

items.text: Verify board surface is free of dust, drywall shavings, and construction debris before taping.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible dust film on board face at time of first coat application.

items.text: Check that all fastener heads are properly seated (not proud, not broken paper).
items.acceptance_criteria: No fastener heads project above board plane or show ruptured face paper.

items.text: Confirm joint compound and tape are within shelf life and stored per manufacturer requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Compound not frozen, not past manufacturer expiration date, and mixed per label instructions.

items.text: Verify embedding coat is applied before tape placement (bedding coat).
items.acceptance_criteria: Embedding compound applied continuously over full joint length before tape is set.

items.text: Check tape is centered over joints with no wrinkles, bubbles, or blisters.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tape fully embedded with no visible air pockets when checked by light raking angle.

items.text: Confirm sufficient compound is squeezed from under tape to bond properly, without starving the joint.
items.acceptance_criteria: Thin, even compound bead visible along both tape edges; no dry/starved sections.

items.text: Verify inside corners are taped with a clean, uniform crease.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tape folded and bedded tight into corner with no visible gap or lifted edge.

items.text: Check mesh (self-adhesive) tape usage is limited to setting-type compound applications where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mesh tape used only with setting-type (chemical hardening) compound, not standard joint compound, per manufacturer.

items.text: Verify fill (second) coat is applied after first coat is fully dry/cured.
items.acceptance_criteria: First coat dry to the touch and uniform in color before second coat is applied.

items.text: Check fill coat width feathers evenly beyond tape edges.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fill coat extends approximately 2 in beyond each edge of the embedding coat with smooth taper.

items.text: Verify finish (third) coat is applied and feathered to eliminate ridges.
items.acceptance_criteria: Finish coat extends approximately 4-6 in beyond fill coat edge, leaving no visible ridge under a 4 ft straightedge.

items.text: Confirm each coat is allowed to dry fully before sanding or subsequent coat.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible soft/damp compound; moisture sheen absent before recoat or sanding.

items.text: Check flat/butt joints for crowning or dishing across the joint.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface deviation not exceeding 1/32 in measured with a straightedge across the joint width.

items.text: Verify fastener head compound coats (minimum 3 coats) are complete and flush.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fastener dimples filled flush to plane with no visible depression under raking light.

items.text: Verify outside corner bead is coated in minimum 2-3 coats and feathered smooth.
items.acceptance_criteria: Corner bead nose covered with no exposed metal and compound feathered 6-8 in from corner.

items.text: Check trim/reveal beads (J-bead, L-bead) are bedded and finished per detail.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trim edges free of gaps and compound cleanly finished to trim reveal line.

items.text: Verify control joints are finished per manufacturer detail without bridging the joint with rigid compound.
items.acceptance_criteria: Compound does not span the control joint's flexible center strip, preserving intended movement.

items.text: Confirm expansion/casing beads at dissimilar material transitions are properly finished.
items.acceptance_criteria: Clean, straight finish line with no compound overlap onto adjacent material.

items.text: Confirm specified finish level for the area matches drawings/finish schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Level (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5) recorded matches finish schedule for the room/area.

items.text: For Level 4 (standard paint/light texture), verify joints and fasteners are smooth with no visible ridges under flat paint lighting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tool marks and ridges not visible when viewed under critical/grazing light after prime coat.

items.text: For Level 5 (skim coat, gloss/critical lighting areas), verify a skim coat of joint compound is applied over the entire surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: Thin skim coat (or equivalent primer-surfacer) applied full-wall/ceiling with no texture variation visible under raking light.

items.text: For Level 1 (plenum/concealed areas), verify tape is embedded with no finish coats but surface is smooth enough to control dust.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tape embedded in joint compound with tool marks and ridges acceptable; no loose material present.

items.text: Verify areas requiring Level 3 (heavy texture, wallcovering) receive tape coat plus one additional coat over joints/fasteners only.
items.acceptance_criteria: One additional coat of compound applied over tape and fasteners, not a full skim.

items.text: Inspect for visible seams, ridges, or joint photographing under raking light.
items.acceptance_criteria: No joint 'ghosting' visible when inspected with a handheld light at a low grazing angle.

items.text: Check for tool marks, gouges, or trowel chatter left in finish coat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface free of gouges deeper than 1/32 in prior to sanding.

items.text: Verify sanding does not expose or fray paper face or tape edges.
items.acceptance_criteria: No fuzzy paper nap, exposed tape edge, or core exposure after final sanding.

items.text: Confirm dust from sanding is fully removed prior to primer application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface wiped/vacuumed with no visible dust film remaining.

items.text: Photograph raking-light inspection of representative walls/ceilings per room.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 2 raking-light photos per typical room documenting joint and fastener finish quality.

items.text: Record finish level achieved and compound product/lot used.
items.acceptance_criteria: Data recorded matches specification and manufacturer submittal.

items.text: List punch items requiring rework before primer release.
items.acceptance_criteria: All rework items logged with location and required corrective action.

items.text: Foreman and inspector sign off releasing surface for priming.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures and dates recorded prior to primer mobilization.

templates.name: Ceiling Tile Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies suspended ceiling grid layout, leveling, seismic bracing, and acoustic tile installation against ASTM C636 and applicable seismic requirements before area closeout.
prerequisites: Above-ceiling MEP rough-in inspected and approved
Reflected ceiling plan (RCP) and grid layout approved
Finish floor elevation benchmark established

items.text: Confirm above-ceiling work (ductwork, sprinkler, electrical, cabling) is complete and inspected.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed rough-in inspections on file for all trades penetrating the ceiling plenum.

items.text: Verify layout centerlines are struck matching the reflected ceiling plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grid layout centered in room with balanced border tile width on opposing walls, per RCP.

items.text: Confirm perimeter wall angle elevation is marked and consistent around the room.
items.acceptance_criteria: Laser level reference line marked at consistent height with variance not exceeding 1/8 in over 12 ft.

items.text: Verify structural deck/joists above have adequate independent attachment points for hangers (not attached to ductwork or other ceiling components).
items.acceptance_criteria: Every hanger wire attached directly to structure, not to mechanical, electrical, or plumbing supports.

items.text: Confirm ceiling tile and grid material submittal (type, class, fire rating) is approved and matches delivered material.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delivered material matches approved submittal for fire rating, NRC/CAC, and reveal profile.

sections.name: Grid Suspension System — Hangers & Main Runners

items.text: Verify hanger wire spacing does not exceed code/standard maximum.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hanger wires spaced maximum 4 ft o.c. along main runners, with a hanger within 8 in of each end.

items.text: Confirm hanger wire gauge meets minimum size and is wrapped with minimum 3 tight turns.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 12-gauge galvanized wire, wrapped a minimum of 3 turns within 1-1/2 in.

items.text: Verify hanger wires are plumb (not more than 1 in 6 out of plumb).
items.acceptance_criteria: Wire deviation from vertical does not exceed 1 in horizontal per 6 in of vertical rise; if exceeded, wire is counter-splayed.

items.text: Check main runner spacing matches design (typically 4 ft o.c.).
items.acceptance_criteria: Main tee runners spaced per manufacturer/design, not exceeding 4 ft o.c.

items.text: Confirm additional hangers are provided at light fixtures, diffusers, and other heavy attachments not independently supported.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trapeze or additional hanger wire provided within 6 in of each corner of fixtures over 10 lb not independently hung.

items.text: Verify perimeter wall angle/molding is fastened at maximum spacing with proper fastener type for substrate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wall angle fastened at maximum 16 in o.c., with a fastener within 3 in of each end.

items.text: Verify overall grid level tolerance across the ceiling plane.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grid level within 1/8 in over any 12 ft measured with a straightedge or laser, no more than 1/4 in in 40 ft total.

items.text: Check grid intersections are square and cross tees lock securely into main runners.
items.acceptance_criteria: All cross tee connections fully seated and locked with no visible gaps at intersections.

items.text: Verify grid is free of twist, waviness, or visible sag between hangers.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible sag or wave when sighted down runner length under raking light.

items.text: Confirm expansion provisions are made where grid abuts rigid construction (walls, columns) on long runs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grid not rigidly fixed on all four sides where runs exceed manufacturer's expansion limits (commonly 30-50 ft).

items.text: Verify grid finish (color, profile) is consistent throughout visible ceiling area with no mixed lots.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible color or profile variation across the ceiling plane.

items.text: Confirm seismic design category and whether lateral bracing is required for this ceiling area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Bracing requirement determined from structural/architectural drawings and applicable building code seismic design category.

items.text: Verify compression posts (struts) are installed at required spacing where specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Compression struts installed at maximum 12 ft o.c. each way, within 6 ft of each wall, per design.

items.text: Check horizontal restraint wires (4-way bracing) are installed at required spacing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Splayed bracing wires installed at maximum 12 ft o.c. each way with 4 wires spread at 90 degrees from a common point.

items.text: Verify perimeter closure/clearance meets seismic requirements (oversized wall angle or clips).
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 2 in wide wall angle or supplemental restraint clips provided at perimeter per seismic design category, with required clearance for movement.

items.text: Inspect tiles for damage, staining, or warping prior to installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible chips, water stains, sag, or delamination on tiles selected for installation.

items.text: Verify tile orientation (directional pattern/texture) is consistent across the ceiling.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pattern direction arrows (if present) all oriented the same way across the visible field.

items.text: Confirm border tiles are cut accurately and fit tight to wall angle without excessive gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Border tile gap at wall angle not exceeding 1/8 in with no visible light gaps.

items.text: Verify tiles are seated fully in grid with no visible lippage between adjacent tiles.
items.acceptance_criteria: No perceptible height difference between adjacent tile faces when checked by hand.

items.text: Check fire-rated ceiling assemblies match the listed design (tile type, grid type, hold-down clips).
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed components match UL/manufacturer listed fire-rated assembly number, including required hold-down clips.

items.text: Confirm access tiles are identified and function properly for future maintenance access.
items.acceptance_criteria: Designated access tiles lift/remove without binding and are clearly indicated on as-built RCP.

items.text: Verify light fixtures, diffusers, and sprinklers are centered within tile modules per RCP.
items.acceptance_criteria: Device centered within tile field with deviation not exceeding 1/2 in from plan location.

items.text: Confirm sprinkler heads maintain required clearance from ceiling grid and tile per NFPA 13.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sprinkler deflector distance below ceiling and clearance from obstructions meets NFPA 13 requirements.

items.text: Check tile cuts around penetrations are clean with no oversized gaps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cutout gap around penetration not exceeding 1/4 in, with no cracked or crumbled tile edges.

items.text: Verify recessed fixtures are independently supported and not resting solely on grid.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fixtures over code weight threshold supported by independent hangers per ASTM C636, not by grid alone.

items.text: Confirm above-ceiling fire/smoke damper access panels and required labels remain accessible.
items.acceptance_criteria: Access panels and identification labels visible and unobstructed after tile installation.

items.text: Photograph grid level check and seismic bracing installation where applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3 photos documenting level check reading, hanger wire attachment, and seismic bracing if installed.

items.text: Record grid and tile material data (manufacturer, type, fire rating, lot).
items.acceptance_criteria: Recorded data matches approved submittal.

items.text: List punch items and access tile locations for the as-built record.
items.acceptance_criteria: All open items and access points logged with location.

items.text: Inspector and superintendent sign off accepting the ceiling installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures and dates recorded before area is turned over.

templates.name: Flooring Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies subfloor flatness, moisture testing, material acclimation, and installation practices for resilient, wood, tile, and carpet flooring systems prior to and during installation.
prerequisites: Concrete slab minimum cure time met (typically 28 days) or per mix design
Building enclosed with permanent HVAC operating or temporary conditioning in place
Flooring material submittal and installation method approved

items.text: Verify subfloor is clean, free of curing compounds, sealers, paint, and debris.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible contamination, ridges of debris, or residue that would impede adhesive bond.

items.text: Measure floor flatness (FF) per ACI 302 requirements for the specified finish.
items.acceptance_criteria: Composite FF number meets or exceeds specified value (commonly FF 35 minimum for flooring receiving surfaces).

items.text: Measure floor levelness (FL) where specified for the flooring type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Composite FL number meets specified value per ACI 302 (commonly FL 25 minimum, project-specific).

items.text: Check for cracks, spalls, or joints requiring repair prior to flooring installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unfilled cracks wider than 1/16 in or spalled areas deeper than 1/8 in in areas to receive flooring.

items.text: Verify localized flatness with a 10 ft straightedge at bond-critical/resilient flooring areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gap under a 10 ft straightedge not exceeding 3/16 in, or per manufacturer's stricter requirement (often 1/8 in in 6 ft for resilient).

items.text: Confirm underlayment/patch compound has cured per manufacturer minimum time before flooring.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer-specified cure time elapsed and surface dry to the touch with no soft spots.

items.text: Perform calcium chloride moisture vapor emission rate (MVER) test per ASTM F1869.
items.acceptance_criteria: MVER does not exceed 3 lb per 1,000 sf per 24 hr (or stricter manufacturer limit, e.g. 3-5 lb depending on product), tested after minimum 60-72 hr conditioning.

items.text: Perform in-situ relative humidity (RH) probe testing per ASTM F2170.
items.acceptance_criteria: In-situ RH does not exceed 75% (some manufacturers allow up to 85% with mitigation); probes at 40% of slab depth (or per slab drying condition).

items.text: Verify minimum number of test locations per manufacturer/ASTM guidance for the area size.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3 tests for first 1,000 sf plus 1 additional test per additional 1,000 sf, per ASTM F2170 Annex.

items.text: Confirm slab pH is tested where alkalinity affects adhesive selection.
items.acceptance_criteria: Slab surface pH between 7 and 9 (alkaline salt/efflorescence issues flagged if outside range).

items.text: Verify test results are documented with date, location, and ambient conditions at time of test.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test log includes ambient temperature, RH, and slab temperature recorded at each test location.

items.text: Confirm moisture mitigation system is installed and cured if test results exceeded flooring manufacturer limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mitigation system installed per manufacturer instructions with documented cure time before flooring proceeds.

items.text: Verify flooring material is acclimated in the installation space per manufacturer duration.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material stored unopened/loose-stacked in conditioned space for manufacturer-specified period, typically 48-72 hr minimum (longer for solid wood).

items.text: Confirm ambient temperature and humidity are within manufacturer range during acclimation and installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Space maintained between 65-75 deg F and 35-55% RH (verify against specific manufacturer range) for 48 hr before, during, and after installation.

items.text: Inspect material for damage, color variation, or defects prior to installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible warping, damaged edges, or out-of-lot color variation in material to be installed.

items.text: Verify permanent HVAC system is operational, or temporary conditioning is equivalent, prior to installation start.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permanent HVAC operating and balanced, or temporary system providing equivalent temperature/humidity control, documented before install.

items.text: Verify layout is dry-fit or chalked to balance border widths and avoid slivers.
items.acceptance_criteria: Border width at opposing walls does not vary by more than manufacturer tolerance, no slivers narrower than 2 in.

items.text: Confirm expansion gap is provided at perimeter walls and fixed vertical obstructions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Expansion gap of 1/4 in to 1/2 in maintained at perimeter (per manufacturer), to be covered by base/trim.

items.text: Verify direction/orientation of flooring pattern matches design intent (light source, room shape).
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed orientation matches approved layout drawing or design direction.

items.text: Check transition strips/thresholds are planned at all material and elevation changes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Transition strip or reducer specified and staged for every doorway and material change shown on plan.

items.text: Verify correct adhesive/trowel notch size is used per manufacturer for the flooring type.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trowel notch size matches manufacturer data sheet for the specific product and substrate condition.

items.text: Confirm adhesive open time and working time are respected during installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flooring set within manufacturer's stated open time window (avoiding skinned-over or flash-dried adhesive).

items.text: Check adhesive transfer/coverage by lifting a sample piece during installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 95% adhesive transfer coverage on back of material observed during spot check.

items.text: Verify mechanically fastened flooring (nail/staple down) meets fastener spacing schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fasteners spaced per manufacturer schedule, typically 6-8 in o.c. along tongue, with no missed rows.

items.text: Confirm floating floor systems have proper underlayment and locking joints fully engaged.
items.acceptance_criteria: Underlayment continuous with no gaps or overlaps exceeding manufacturer allowance; all locking joints fully seated.

items.text: Verify seams (resilient sheet, carpet) are properly sealed or seamed per method specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Heat-welded or chemically seamed joints show no visible gap and pass a seam-pull check by hand.

items.text: Measure wood flooring moisture content prior to installation per ASTM D4442.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wood flooring moisture content within manufacturer range, typically 6-9%, and within 4% of subfloor moisture content.

items.text: Measure subfloor/substrate wood moisture content for comparison.
items.acceptance_criteria: Difference between flooring and subfloor moisture content does not exceed manufacturer limit, typically 2-4%.

items.text: Verify wood species/grade delivered matches approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delivered species, grade, and finish match approved submittal documentation.

items.text: Confirm expansion gaps at wood flooring perimeter account for seasonal movement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Expansion gap of 3/4 in typical (verify per manufacturer/board width) maintained at all fixed perimeter surfaces.

items.text: Inspect finished floor surface for gaps, lippage, or peaking between units.
items.acceptance_criteria: No lippage exceeding 1/32 in between adjacent units and no visible open gaps at joints.

items.text: Verify base/quarter-round or trim is installed covering the expansion gap without restricting movement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trim fastened to wall/base, not through the flooring, allowing floor to float/move as designed.

items.text: Check transition strips are securely fastened and flush at doorways/material changes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Transition strip flush with no trip hazard exceeding 1/4 in height differential (or per ADA where applicable).

items.text: Confirm floor is cleaned and protected (temporary covering) after installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Walk-off protection or covering installed in high-traffic areas within same day of installation.

items.text: Photograph moisture test locations, readings, and finished floor condition.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photos document each moisture test setup/reading plus representative finished areas.

items.text: Record all moisture test results, material lot numbers, and adhesive/underlayment used.
items.acceptance_criteria: Data recorded matches field test logs and approved submittals.

items.text: List punch items and areas requiring rework or re-testing.
items.acceptance_criteria: All open items logged with location and corrective action assigned.

items.text: Inspector and superintendent sign off accepting the flooring installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures and dates recorded before area is turned over or furniture placed.

templates.name: Interior Painting Checklist
templates.description: Verifies surface preparation, environmental conditions, coating application, and dry film thickness for interior painting work in accordance with SSPC surface-prep standards and manufacturer product data.
prerequisites: Gypsum board finish level and taping inspection passed
Approved paint schedule/color and finish submittal on file
Surface substrate cured per manufacturer minimum (e.g., new plaster/concrete cure time)

items.text: Verify substrate is clean, dry, and free of dust, grease, and loose material.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible dust, oil, or loose debris on surface immediately prior to prime coat.

items.text: Check drywall surfaces meet the specified finish level and are free of sanding dust.
items.acceptance_criteria: Finish level matches specification (typically Level 4 or 5) with no visible dust film.

items.text: Verify nail/screw pops, cracks, and holes are filled and sanded smooth.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible surface defects greater than 1/32 in deep remain after filler sanding.

items.text: Confirm previously painted surfaces are properly deglossed/scuff-sanded where recoating.
items.acceptance_criteria: Existing gloss surfaces uniformly dulled with no shiny/burnished spots remaining.

items.text: Verify mildew, efflorescence, or water stains are treated/sealed before painting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stained or affected areas cleaned and sealed with stain-blocking primer prior to topcoat.

items.text: Check masking and protection of adjacent surfaces, fixtures, and flooring is complete.
items.acceptance_criteria: All adjacent finished surfaces, hardware, and floors masked or protected before spraying/rolling begins.

items.text: Verify ambient air temperature is within manufacturer's application range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Air and surface temperature between 50 deg F and 90 deg F during application (verify against specific product data sheet).

items.text: Confirm relative humidity is within manufacturer's application range.
items.acceptance_criteria: Relative humidity below 85% during application and cure, or per manufacturer data sheet.

items.text: Verify surface temperature is at least 5 deg F above dew point.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface temperature exceeds dew point by a minimum of 5 deg F to prevent condensation/blushing.

items.text: Confirm adequate ventilation/air movement is provided for cure and worker safety.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mechanical or natural ventilation maintains air exchange sufficient for coating cure and VOC exposure limits.

items.text: Verify paint is within shelf life and properly mixed/boxed for color consistency.
items.acceptance_criteria: Product date-coded within shelf life; multiple cans of same color boxed together to eliminate batch variation.

items.text: Confirm correct primer/topcoat system matches approved paint schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: Primer and topcoat product numbers match approved submittal for the substrate and area.

items.text: Check thinning, if any, does not exceed manufacturer maximum percentage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Thinner added does not exceed manufacturer's stated maximum (commonly 5-10% by volume).

items.text: Verify materials are stored within manufacturer temperature range prior to use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stored paint not exposed to freezing or temperatures above 95 deg F prior to application.

items.text: Verify primer is applied to all bare/patched substrate areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% coverage of bare drywall, filler, and patched areas with no holidays (skips) visible.

items.text: Check primer wet film thickness/spread rate matches manufacturer coverage rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Applied at manufacturer's specified spread rate (commonly 350-450 sf/gal, verify per product), no excessive thinning.

items.text: Confirm primer is fully cured/dry before topcoat application.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum manufacturer dry/recoat time elapsed (commonly 1-4 hr for latex primer) before next coat.

items.text: Verify stain-blocking or specialty primer is used where required (water stains, wood knots, MDF).
items.acceptance_criteria: Specialty primer applied over all identified problem substrates prior to standard primer/topcoat.

items.text: Check spot-priming of repairs shows no flashing (sheen difference) through the topcoat.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible flashing or sheen variation at repaired areas after topcoat application.

items.text: Verify minimum number of finish coats specified is achieved (typically 2 coats over primer).
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 2 topcoats applied over primer, or per manufacturer/specification for the sheen and color.

items.text: Check for uniform sheen and color across walls/ceilings with no roller/spray lap marks.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible lap marks, roller stipple variation, or sheen difference under normal room lighting.

items.text: Verify cut-in lines at ceilings, trim, and corners are straight and free of bleed-through.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cut lines straight within 1/16 in deviation with no bleed onto adjacent surfaces/colors.

items.text: Confirm adequate dry time is provided between coats per manufacturer data.
items.acceptance_criteria: Recoat time elapsed per manufacturer product data sheet (commonly 2-4 hr for latex, longer for alkyd/epoxy).

items.text: Check for holidays, drips, runs, sags, or overspray on adjacent surfaces.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible drips, sags, or overspray on finished surfaces or adjacent protected materials.

items.text: Verify special coatings (epoxy, high-performance) are applied within pot life and recoat window.
items.acceptance_criteria: Application completed within manufacturer-stated pot life; recoat performed within specified window to ensure intercoat adhesion.

items.text: Measure dry film thickness (DFT) at representative locations using a calibrated gauge.
items.acceptance_criteria: Total system DFT meets specification minimum, commonly 3.0-5.0 mils total dry (verify against product data sheet).

items.text: Verify DFT measurements are taken at minimum frequency per SSPC-PA 2 sampling plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3 spot measurements per 100 sf area, with 3 gauge readings averaged per spot.

items.text: Check coverage rate used against theoretical spread rate to confirm adequate material was applied.
items.acceptance_criteria: Actual gallons used per area consistent with manufacturer theoretical spread rate within reasonable loss allowance (10-15%).

items.text: Confirm high-visibility/critical lighting areas receive additional inspection for texture/roller stipple uniformity.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible texture inconsistency under raking or critical light in designated high-visibility areas.

items.text: Verify all touch-up items from punch walk are completed and blend with surrounding finish.
items.acceptance_criteria: Touch-up areas indistinguishable from surrounding finish under normal lighting.

items.text: Confirm masking and protective materials are removed without damaging finish.
items.acceptance_criteria: No tape residue, paint bleed, or surface damage remaining after masking removal.

items.text: Check floors, fixtures, and hardware are clean of paint overspray/spatter.
items.acceptance_criteria: No paint spatter or overspray visible on floors, glass, or hardware after final cleanup.

items.text: Verify adequate cure time is allowed before furniture/equipment placement against painted surfaces.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum manufacturer full-cure time observed (commonly 7-30 days for full hardness) before heavy contact.

items.text: Photograph representative finished walls/ceilings and any DFT gauge readings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3 photos per area documenting finish quality and DFT verification.

items.text: Record paint system, color, sheen, and batch/lot numbers used per area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Data recorded matches approved paint schedule and manufacturer submittal.

items.text: List punch items and touch-up locations requiring further attention.
items.acceptance_criteria: All open items logged with location and corrective action assigned.

items.text: Inspector and superintendent sign off accepting the painting work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures and dates recorded before area is turned over.

templates.name: Paving Material Placement Checklist
templates.description: Verifies hot-mix asphalt delivery, temperature, laydown, joint construction, rolling, and finished surface tolerance during mainline paving operations.
prerequisites: Approved mix design (JMF) on file
Base/binder course accepted and proof-rolled
Paver, rollers, and thermometers inspected and calibrated
Weather forecast reviewed for minimum ambient temperature

items.text: Confirm base or binder course surface is clean, dry, and free of loose material before paving.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible dust, mud, standing water, or debris on the surface to be paved.

items.text: Verify base course has been proof-rolled and accepted by the engineer.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible rutting, pumping, deflection, or soft spots observed under proof-roll.

items.text: Confirm tack coat applied to existing pavement, curb, and structure interfaces at the specified rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Uniform tack coat coverage, no puddling or dry (uncoated) streaks.

items.text: Verify ambient air temperature meets the minimum required before paving begins.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ambient air temperature at or above the mix-specific minimum (commonly 40 F for thin lifts, lower thresholds allowed for thicker lifts).

items.text: Confirm base or existing pavement surface temperature is above the minimum laydown threshold.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface temperature at or above the minimum specified for the lift thickness and mix type.

items.text: Verify paver hopper, screed, and augers are clean and screed heaters are functioning.
items.acceptance_criteria: No hardened asphalt buildup in hopper or on augers; screed plates heat evenly before placement.

items.text: Confirm the mix design (JMF) approved for the lift being placed matches the material being delivered.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mix ID on delivery tickets matches the approved JMF for the lift and location.

items.text: Verify a delivery ticket is present for each truck, showing plant, mix ID, quantity, and batch time.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ticket data complete and matches the approved JMF; ticket retained for the daily record.

items.text: Measure and record HMA temperature at the point of discharge into the paver hopper.
items.acceptance_criteria: Discharge temperature within the mix producer's specified delivery range, typically 275-300 F.

items.text: Reject any truckload showing visible segregation, excess flushing, or a crusted/cold surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: No load with visible segregation, flushing, or a hardened crust is discharged into the paver.

items.text: Confirm trucks are tarped during transport to minimize heat loss.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tarp covers the load fully from plant to discharge, except during active discharge.

items.text: Verify haul time from plant to point of discharge does not exceed the maximum allowed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elapsed haul time within the project-specified maximum, typically 60-90 minutes.

items.text: Confirm truck beds are treated only with an approved release agent, not diesel fuel or petroleum-based products.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible sheen or odor of petroleum-based release agent on discharged mix.

items.text: Record the running tonnage of loads placed against the estimated quantity for the section.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cumulative tonnage tracked and reconciled against planned quantity for the day's placement.

items.text: Confirm paver travel speed is held constant to avoid tearing, shoving, or stop marks.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible tearing or transverse ripples attributable to inconsistent paver speed.

items.text: Verify uncompacted (loose) mat thickness is set to achieve the design compacted thickness after rolling.
items.acceptance_criteria: Loose lift thickness matches target based on typical compaction shrinkage for the mix.

items.text: Confirm mat is placed continuously without unnecessary paver stops that create cold transverse joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unplanned paver stoppage exceeding the time limit that would require a cold joint cut.

items.text: Verify a constant head of material is maintained in the auger chamber to prevent segregation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Augers remain covered with material across the full paving width at all times.

items.text: Confirm hand-work areas around structures and curbs are raked and luted to match mainline texture.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible coarse-aggregate raking marks or texture mismatch at hand-worked areas.

items.text: Verify screed crown and cross-slope match the design grade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured cross-slope within tolerance of the design percentage, typically 1.5%-2.5%.

items.text: Confirm no visible segregation (coarse aggregate streaking) behind the screed.
items.acceptance_criteria: No streaking, coarse-aggregate concentration, or open-textured streaks visible behind the screed.

items.text: Verify longitudinal joint overlap onto the previously placed lane meets specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Overlap of 1 in to 2 in onto the previous lane, without excessive double-coverage.

items.text: Confirm transverse (cold) joints are cut back to a full-depth, vertical face before resuming paving.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cut face is vertical, full depth, and free of feathered or raveled edges.

items.text: Verify joint faces are tack-coated before the adjacent lane or lift is placed against them.
items.acceptance_criteria: Visible, uniform tack applied to the full joint face prior to adjacent placement.

items.text: Confirm echelon or hot (same-day) joint construction is used where practical to minimize cold joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Adjacent lanes paved same-day/hot joint where the paving plan allows.

items.text: Verify joint density meets the minimum requirement relative to mat interior density.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint density meets or exceeds the specified minimum percent of Gmm at the joint.
items.reference: State DOT HMA joint density specification

items.text: Confirm joints are rolled immediately behind the screed using the specified joint (echelon) rolling pattern.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint roller follows within the specified distance/time of the screed before the mat cools.

items.text: Confirm breakdown rolling begins while mat temperature is within the effective compaction window.
items.acceptance_criteria: Breakdown roller engages while mat temperature is above the minimum effective compaction temperature.

items.text: Verify the roller pattern (breakdown, intermediate, finish) established in the paving plan is followed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Roller sequence, pass count, and offset match the approved rolling pattern.

items.text: Confirm vibratory rollers are switched to static mode below the minimum vibratory compaction temperature.
items.acceptance_criteria: Vibratory compaction discontinued once mat temperature drops below the threshold that risks checking or cracking.

items.text: Verify finish rolling is completed before the mat cools below the workable rolling temperature.
items.acceptance_criteria: Finish rolling completed while mat temperature remains above the minimum workable threshold.

items.text: Confirm roller drums are kept adequately wetted to prevent pickup without over-wetting the mat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Drums show consistent light water film; no pooling or excess water on the mat surface.

items.text: Verify no roller marks, checking, or displacement remain visible in the finished mat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surface free of roller checking, hairline cracking, or displacement waves after final rolling.

items.text: Check finished surface smoothness with a 10-ft straightedge in both longitudinal and transverse directions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Maximum deviation of 1/4 in in 10 ft under the straightedge.
items.reference: ASTM D6433 / typical DOT smoothness tolerance

items.text: Verify finished surface is free of tears, drag marks, and open-textured areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible tearing, dragging, or raveled/open-textured patches across the placed area.

items.text: Confirm pavement cross-slope and drainage grade verified by survey after paving.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured slope within tolerance of design grade, typically 1.0%-2.5%, with no reverse-fall areas.

items.text: Verify finished mat thickness meets design thickness by core or nondestructive method.
items.acceptance_criteria: Measured thickness meets or exceeds design thickness within the allowable tolerance.

items.text: Confirm no ponding areas identified during a test-flood or first rain event after paving.
items.acceptance_criteria: No standing water observed beyond 1/2 in depth after a normal rain event.

items.text: Verify pavement markings and utility structure inlays are coordinated and clear prior to opening to traffic.
items.acceptance_criteria: Layout for markings and structure adjustments reviewed and free of conflicts before opening.

items.text: Attach all delivery tickets and mat temperature logs to the daily paving report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delivery tickets and temperature readings for each load filed with the daily report.

items.text: Record total tonnage placed and compare against estimated quantity and yield.
items.acceptance_criteria: Placed tonnage reconciled with planned quantity within the allowed variance.

items.text: Document any reworked, rejected, or removed material and its disposition.
items.acceptance_criteria: Quantity, location, and disposition of any rejected/removed material recorded.

items.text: Confirm as-built lift thicknesses and paving stationing are recorded.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-built thickness and station/offset data logged for the placed section.

items.text: Obtain inspector and contractor signatures confirming acceptance of the placed pavement section.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained and dated before the section is considered accepted.

templates.name: Compaction Verification Checklist (for pavement)
templates.description: Verifies nuclear density gauge calibration, test location selection, and in-place density results for hot-mix asphalt pavement against the specified percent of maximum theoretical or control-strip density.
prerequisites: Nuclear density gauge calibrated and standardized
Control strip established (if used)
Mix design maximum theoretical specific gravity (Gmm) on file
Test location/frequency plan approved

items.text: Verify the nuclear density gauge has a current calibration certificate on file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calibration certificate dated within the manufacturer/regulatory required interval.

items.text: Confirm the gauge is standardized on its reference block per manufacturer procedure at the start of the shift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Standardization count within the manufacturer's acceptable range before testing begins.

items.text: Verify the gauge operator holds a current radiation safety license/certification.
items.acceptance_criteria: License current and matches the gauge's licensing jurisdiction.

items.text: Confirm the gauge source leak test is current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Leak test certificate dated within the last 6 months.

items.text: Verify the test method (backscatter vs. direct transmission) selected is appropriate for the lift thickness.
items.acceptance_criteria: Direct transmission used for lifts where probe depth can be set to the full lift thickness; backscatter used only where direct transmission is impractical.

items.text: Confirm the maximum theoretical specific gravity (Gmm) value for the mix is on file and current.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gmm value from an approved test within the current mix design verification period.

items.text: Verify the control strip location is representative of the production paving section.
items.acceptance_criteria: Control strip placed on the same mix, lift thickness, and base condition as production paving.

items.text: Confirm the control strip is rolled with the same equipment and pattern intended for production paving.
items.acceptance_criteria: Roller types, pass counts, and sequence match the intended production rolling plan.

items.text: Record roller pass counts and density readings until density no longer increases (roll to refusal).
items.acceptance_criteria: Density curve plotted showing the point of diminishing return in additional roller passes.

items.text: Establish the control strip average density as the target (100%) reference for production density.
items.acceptance_criteria: Average of qualifying control strip test readings recorded as the reference density.

items.text: Confirm control strip results are reviewed and approved by the engineer before production paving proceeds.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written or documented approval obtained before production rolling begins on the represented section.

items.text: Verify test locations are selected per the random or stratified-random sampling plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test locations generated by the approved random sampling method, not selected by inspection.

items.text: Confirm minimum test frequency is maintained for the lot or tonnage placed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test frequency meets or exceeds the project QC/QA plan minimum (commonly 1 test per 500-1,000 tons or per defined lot).

items.text: Verify test locations are offset the minimum distance from unsupported pavement edges and joints.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test location at least 6 in from an unsupported edge or longitudinal joint unless testing the joint specifically.

items.text: Confirm longitudinal joint density is tested separately from mat interior density.
items.acceptance_criteria: Separate joint-density test results recorded distinct from mainline mat tests.

items.text: Verify each test location is documented with station, offset, and lot/lift identification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Station, offset, and lift ID recorded for every density test result.

items.text: Confirm test surface is free of loose material, water, and surface voids before gauge placement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test spot swept clean and dry, with no gauge-seating gaps from surface debris.

items.text: Verify the gauge is seated firmly and in full contact with the pavement surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible rocking or gap between gauge base plate and pavement surface.

items.text: Confirm the correct probe depth is selected matching the lift thickness (direct transmission mode).
items.acceptance_criteria: Probe depth set equal to the measured or specified lift thickness.

items.text: Record in-place density and percent compaction (percent of Gmm) at each test location.
items.acceptance_criteria: Percent compaction within the specified range, typically 92%-97% of Gmm.

items.text: Verify no single test result falls below the specified minimum threshold.
items.acceptance_criteria: No individual test result below the specified minimum, typically 90% of Gmm.

items.text: Confirm two readings offset 90 degrees are taken and averaged per test location per standard practice.
items.acceptance_criteria: Two offset readings averaged to produce the reported density value.

items.text: Cross-check nuclear gauge results against core sample density at the specified correlation frequency.
items.acceptance_criteria: Core density results correlate with gauge readings within the allowed tolerance.

items.text: Calculate lot average percent compaction and compare to specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lot average meets or exceeds the specified minimum average percent compaction.

items.text: Verify pay-factor or incentive/disincentive calculation is performed per specification, where applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pay factor calculated using the approved statistical formula from the contract documents.

items.text: Confirm low test results are flagged for evaluation, re-rolling, or core verification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any result below the minimum threshold triggers a documented follow-up action.

items.text: Record ambient and mat temperature at the time of each density test.
items.acceptance_criteria: Temperature logged alongside each density result for the test record.

items.text: Verify density test results are plotted or logged against station for trend review.
items.acceptance_criteria: Density-vs-station log maintained and reviewed for areas of concern.

items.text: Document areas failing the density requirement and the corrective action taken.
items.acceptance_criteria: Location, extent, and corrective method (additional rolling, removal/replacement) recorded for each failed area.

items.text: Verify re-testing is performed after corrective rolling and results meet specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Re-test result meets or exceeds the minimum required percent compaction.

items.text: Confirm core holes are patched and sealed after coring.
items.acceptance_criteria: Core hole filled flush with an approved patch material and sealed against water intrusion.

items.text: Verify the engineer is notified and concurrence obtained for any accepted below-spec areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written concurrence from the engineer on file for any accepted deficient area.

items.text: Attach the density test report including gauge serial number and calibration reference.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report includes gauge ID, calibration date, and all individual test results.

items.text: Attach control strip data and approval documentation, if applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Control strip density curve and engineer approval attached to the lot record.

items.text: Record the final lot acceptance or rejection determination.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lot status recorded and consistent with the statistical/pay-factor evaluation.

items.text: Obtain QC and QA representative signatures on the density summary report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained and dated on the final density report.

templates.name: Planting Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies plant material quality, layout, pit preparation, and installation technique for trees, shrubs, and groundcover against nursery stock and planting practice standards.
prerequisites: Approved planting plan and plant list on site
Soil test results reviewed
Plant material inspected/tagged at nursery or upon delivery
Irrigation or temporary watering plan in place

items.text: Verify delivered plant species, size, and quantity match the approved plant list.
items.acceptance_criteria: Species, container/caliper size, and quantities match the approved plant schedule.

items.text: Inspect plant material for compliance with grading standards for size and form.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plants meet the grading standard's minimum size, height-to-caliper ratio, and form requirements for the species.

items.text: Confirm root ball diameter and depth meet the minimum standard for the plant's caliper or height size.
items.acceptance_criteria: Root ball dimensions meet or exceed the minimum diameter/depth for the plant's size classification.

items.text: Reject plants showing girdling, kinked, or circling roots visible at the container edge or root ball surface.
items.acceptance_criteria: No accepted plant shows visible girdling or circling roots at time of installation.

items.text: Inspect plant material for pests, disease, mechanical damage, or sunscald.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible insect infestation, disease symptoms, bark wounds, or sunscald on accepted stock.

items.text: Verify balled-and-burlapped root balls are firm, intact, and not cracked or loose.
items.acceptance_criteria: Root ball remains firm and unbroken when lifted; no cracking or separation from the trunk.
