items.text: Confirm plants not installed within 48 hours of delivery are properly watered, shaded, and heeled-in.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stored plant material shows no wilting, and root balls remain moist and protected from sun/wind.

items.text: Verify plant layout staked in the field matches the approved planting plan spacing and quantities.
items.acceptance_criteria: Staked locations match plan spacing within the allowed field tolerance.

items.text: Confirm plant locations are cleared of underground utility conflicts prior to excavation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility locate completed and no marked utilities conflict with planting pit locations.

items.text: Verify field adjustments to plant layout for visibility, clearance, or mature spread are approved by the designer.
items.acceptance_criteria: Any layout deviation documented with landscape architect/designer approval.

items.text: Confirm any species substitutions are approved in writing before installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Substitution approval on file prior to the substituted species being planted.

items.text: Verify minimum offset distances from structures, utilities, and pavement are maintained per plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plant setback distances meet or exceed the plan-specified minimums.

items.text: Verify planting pit is excavated to the proper width relative to root ball diameter.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pit width equal to 2 to 3 times the root ball diameter.

items.text: Confirm planting pit depth is set so the root flare will sit at or slightly above finished grade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pit depth equals root ball height so the root flare is level with or up to 2 in above finish grade after settling.

items.text: Verify pit sides are scarified or roughened, not glazed or compacted smooth.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pit walls show visible scarification; no smooth, glazed (auger-polished) surface remaining.

items.text: Confirm a drainage percolation check is performed in problem soils prior to planting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Water level in a test-filled pit drops at an acceptable rate, or drainage remediation is specified where it does not.

items.text: Verify amended backfill soil mix matches the specification (native soil-to-compost ratio, etc.).
items.acceptance_criteria: Backfill mix composition matches the specified ratio and material sources.

items.text: Confirm soil test results (pH, drainage, nutrients) are reviewed and recommended amendments applied.
items.acceptance_criteria: Amendment application matches the soil test recommendations for the planting area.

items.text: Verify root flare is exposed and set at or up to 2 in above finished grade after settling.
items.acceptance_criteria: Root flare visible and positioned within 0-2 in above finish grade.

items.text: Confirm all synthetic burlap, wire baskets, twine, and straps are removed or cut back from the top third of the root ball.
items.acceptance_criteria: No synthetic material, wire, or twine remains around the trunk or upper root ball after backfilling.

items.text: Verify container-grown stock had circling or girdling roots teased out, scored, or butterfly-cut before planting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Visible circling roots corrected by teasing, scoring, or cutting prior to backfill.

items.text: Confirm tree/shrub is set plumb and oriented for its best face prior to backfilling.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trunk vertical within visual tolerance from all viewing angles; best face oriented per plan intent.

items.text: Verify backfill is placed in lifts and lightly watered/tamped to eliminate air pockets without over-compacting.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible voids or settling after initial watering; backfill not compacted hard enough to impede root growth.

items.text: Confirm no fertilizer is placed in direct contact with roots at time of planting unless specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fertilizer, where used, is placed per specification and not in direct root contact.

items.text: Verify a water ring or saucer is formed around the planting pit perimeter for irrigation retention.
items.acceptance_criteria: Berm/saucer formed around the pit edge sufficient to hold irrigation water over the root zone.

items.text: Confirm the plant is watered thoroughly immediately after installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Root ball and backfill soil saturated at time of initial watering.

items.text: Verify staking/guying is installed only where needed for stability, using flexible ties that avoid trunk damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stakes/ties used only for genuinely unstable plants; ties allow slight trunk movement without abrasion.

items.text: Confirm stakes and guys allow trunk movement and are scheduled for removal within one growing season.
items.acceptance_criteria: Removal date/reminder documented; ties not girdling the trunk at time of inspection.

items.text: Verify mulch ring is applied at the correct depth and kept clear of trunk/stem contact.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mulch depth between 2 in and 4 in, with a gap maintained around the trunk/stem base.

items.text: Confirm tree trunk protection (guards) is installed where exposed to mower, trimmer, or wildlife damage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trunk guards installed on all trees identified as at-risk in mowed or high-traffic areas.

items.text: Verify no mulch volcanoes or excessive mulch depth exist against stems or trunks.
items.acceptance_criteria: No mulch mounded against the trunk/stem; mulch depth tapers to zero at the stem.

items.text: Verify pruning is limited to removal of dead, damaged, or crossing branches per standard practice.
items.acceptance_criteria: Only dead, diseased, damaged, or structurally conflicting branches removed at installation.

items.text: Confirm no excessive crown reduction or topping is performed.
items.acceptance_criteria: No topping cuts or removal exceeding the recommended percentage of live crown.

items.text: Verify initial post-planting watering schedule is established and communicated to the maintenance crew.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written watering schedule provided and acknowledged by the party responsible for maintenance.

items.text: Confirm plant establishment/warranty period start date is recorded.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty start date logged and matches substantial completion or owner acceptance date.

items.text: Record plant counts installed by species against the approved plant list/quantity takeoff.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed quantities reconciled with the approved plant schedule by species.

items.text: Attach nursery tags, delivery tickets, and inspection photos to the punch list record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tags, tickets, and photo documentation filed with the installation record.

items.text: Document any substitutions, rejections, or dead-on-arrival stock and the replacement plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rejected/DOA plant material and its replacement plan recorded with dates.

items.text: Obtain landscape architect or owner representative signature accepting the installation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature and date obtained confirming acceptance of the planting installation.

templates.name: Irrigation System Installation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies point-of-connection backflow prevention, mainline pressure testing, zoning, sprinkler head coverage, and controller programming for a new or renovated irrigation system.
prerequisites: Approved irrigation plan and hydrozone layout
Static water pressure and flow test completed
Backflow preventer model approved by local water authority
Point of connection located and verified

items.text: Verify point of connection location and pipe size match the approved irrigation plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: POC location, tap size, and pipe diameter match the design drawings.

items.text: Confirm static water pressure is measured and recorded at the point of connection.
items.acceptance_criteria: Static pressure recorded and within the range assumed in the irrigation design.

items.text: Verify the backflow prevention device type is approved for the application by the local water authority.
items.acceptance_criteria: Device type (RPZ, PVB, DCVA) matches the local cross-connection control requirement for the hazard level.

items.text: Confirm the backflow preventer is installed at the correct height and clearance above grade.
items.acceptance_criteria: Device installed at or above the minimum height with required clearance for testing and maintenance access.

items.text: Verify the backflow preventer is field-tested by a certified tester and passes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test report shows a passing result signed by a certified backflow tester.
items.reference: Local cross-connection control program / ASSE 5000 series

items.text: Confirm shut-off (isolation) valves are installed upstream and downstream of the backflow assembly.
items.acceptance_criteria: Isolation valves present and operable on both sides of the backflow device.

items.text: Verify a pressure-reducing valve is installed where static pressure exceeds the system's design limit.
items.acceptance_criteria: PRV installed and set correctly where static pressure exceeds component or head pressure ratings.

items.text: Verify mainline pipe material, class/schedule, and diameter match the specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed pipe matches specified material, pressure class, and diameter for each run.

items.text: Confirm mainline trench depth meets the minimum cover requirement.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cover over the top of the mainline pipe meets or exceeds the specified minimum.

items.text: Verify solvent-welded or threaded joints are cured for the manufacturer's minimum time before pressurization.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint cure time meets or exceeds manufacturer's minimum before the mainline is pressure tested.

items.text: Confirm thrust blocking or mechanical restraint is provided at mainline fittings and direction changes where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Thrust blocks or restraints installed at all tees, elbows, and dead ends per design.

items.text: Verify mainline is hydrostatically pressure tested with no visible leaks.
items.acceptance_criteria: Mainline holds test pressure of 120-150 psi with no visible leaks at joints or fittings.
items.reference: Typical irrigation mainline test practice: 120-150 psi for 2 hours

items.text: Confirm test duration is held for the minimum required time with no significant pressure drop.
items.acceptance_criteria: Test pressure sustained for at least 2 hours with pressure drop within the allowed tolerance.

items.text: Verify lateral line pipe sizing matches the design flow/velocity criteria for each zone.
items.acceptance_criteria: Pipe diameter matches design flow rate without exceeding recommended velocity limits.

items.text: Confirm zone valves are installed per hydrozone grouping, matching plant water needs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Zone boundaries match hydrozones grouping plants with similar water requirements.

items.text: Verify each remote control valve is installed in an accessible valve box with an identification tag.
items.acceptance_criteria: Valve box accessible without obstruction; zone number tag legible and correct.

items.text: Confirm valve boxes are set flush with finish grade and labeled by zone number.
items.acceptance_criteria: Box lid level with surrounding grade and correctly labeled.

items.text: Verify a flow sensor and master valve are installed where specified for leak detection.
items.acceptance_criteria: Flow sensor and master valve installed and wired to the controller per design.

items.text: Confirm wire connections at valves are made with waterproof connectors.
items.acceptance_criteria: All control wire splices use waterproof connectors/sealant per manufacturer requirement.

items.text: Verify pipe trenches are backfilled with clean fill free of sharp debris before compaction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Backfill material free of rocks, construction debris, or sharp objects that could damage pipe.

items.text: Verify sprinkler heads are set plumb and flush with finish grade in turf areas.
items.acceptance_criteria: Heads vertical and level with surrounding turf grade, no sunken or leaning heads.

items.text: Confirm nozzle selection (precipitation rate, arc, radius) matches the zone design.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed nozzle model/arc/radius matches the irrigation design for each head location.

items.text: Verify head-to-head coverage is achieved for each zone with no dry spots.
items.acceptance_criteria: Adjacent head spray patterns overlap to reach neighboring heads with no visible dry areas during test run.

items.text: Confirm matched precipitation rate nozzles are used within each zone.
items.acceptance_criteria: All nozzles within a zone share a compatible precipitation rate to avoid over/under watering.

items.text: Verify drip/micro-irrigation emitters are spaced per plant water requirements and manufacturer flow rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Emitter spacing and flow rate match the design for the plant species and soil type.

items.text: Confirm check valves are installed in heads at low points to prevent low-head drainage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Low-elevation heads equipped with check valves; no drainage observed after zone shutoff.

items.text: Verify swing joints or flexible risers are used at all heads to reduce breakage risk.
items.acceptance_criteria: Swing joint/flex riser installed at every head connection to the lateral line.

items.text: Verify the controller is mounted in the approved location with a weatherproof enclosure if exterior.
items.acceptance_criteria: Controller location matches plan; exterior units housed in a weatherproof/lockable enclosure.

items.text: Confirm the controller is programmed with correct zone run times, start times, and seasonal adjustment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Programmed schedule matches the approved watering schedule and seasonal adjustment settings.

items.text: Verify a rain/freeze sensor or soil moisture sensor is installed and functional.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sensor interrupts irrigation cycles when triggered during a functional test.

items.text: Confirm controller wiring is labeled and matches the as-built valve numbering.
items.acceptance_criteria: Wire labels at the controller match valve box zone numbers.

items.text: Verify remote/smart controller connectivity is tested, if applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Remote access, weather-based adjustment, or app connectivity confirmed functional.

items.text: Confirm surge protection/grounding is installed for the controller per manufacturer requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grounding rod and surge protection installed per manufacturer's installation instructions.

items.text: Perform a dynamic (operating) pressure test at the furthest head in each zone.
items.acceptance_criteria: Operating pressure at the furthest head falls within the nozzle manufacturer's recommended range.

items.text: Verify each zone operates independently without cross-activation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Activating one zone does not energize or spray from another zone.

items.text: Conduct a catch-can test to verify distribution uniformity in representative zones.
items.acceptance_criteria: Distribution uniformity (DU) meets or exceeds the project target, typically 70% or higher.

items.text: Confirm no leaks, misting, or broken heads are observed during a full system run-through.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible leaks, fogging/misting at fittings, or broken/missing heads during the full-system test.

items.text: Verify low-head drainage does not create runoff onto pavement or structures.
items.acceptance_criteria: No water discharge onto hardscape or building foundations after zone shutoff.

items.text: Attach the backflow preventer test report and mainline pressure test log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both reports on file and reflect passing results prior to system acceptance.

items.text: Record as-built valve/zone layout and controller programming schedule.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-built drawing and controller schedule documented and filed with the project record.

items.text: Provide owner or maintenance staff training on controller operation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Training session completed and acknowledged by owner/maintenance representative.

items.text: Obtain irrigation contractor and owner representative sign-off on system acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Both signatures obtained and dated confirming system acceptance.

templates.name: Construction Material Inventory Checklist Template
templates.description: A point-in-time physical inventory count and receiving/storage inspection used to verify quantity, identity, condition, and storage compliance of materials delivered to a project site or laydown yard.
prerequisites: Approved submittals and purchase orders on file
Delivery tickets or bills of lading available for the count period
Laydown yard or storage area accessible for physical count

items.text: Verify delivery ticket/bill of lading matches the purchase order number and line items.
items.acceptance_criteria: All line-item descriptions, quantities, and PO number on the ticket match the issued PO with zero unresolved discrepancies.

items.text: Confirm carrier delivery documentation is signed, dated, and retained with a legible copy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed delivery ticket on file with date, carrier name, and receiver's printed name/signature.

items.text: Cross-check material submittal/approval status prior to accepting delivery.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material matches an approved submittal or shop drawing on record; unapproved materials are tagged 'received pending approval' and held.

items.text: Verify mill certificates, COAs, or material test reports accompany applicable materials (rebar, structural steel, concrete mix).
items.acceptance_criteria: Certification documents present and legible for every lot requiring certification; missing certs logged and escalated.

items.text: Record quantity received against purchase order quantity for each line item.
items.acceptance_criteria: Received quantity documented to the nearest countable unit; variance from PO quantity noted.

items.text: Perform physical piece count or measured count (linear/square/cubic) of each material lot.
items.acceptance_criteria: Counted quantity recorded and reconciled to within +/-1% of receiving documentation.

items.text: Verify material identification tags, labels, or heat/lot numbers are legible and match documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of tagged items have legible, traceable identification matching the delivery record.

items.text: Confirm material grade, size, and specification markings match the approved submittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stamped/printed grade and dimension markings match specified values with no substitutions present.

items.text: Assign and apply a unique inventory tracking number or barcode to each lot or pallet.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every countable lot has a legible unique identifier applied and logged in the inventory record.

items.text: Photograph each material lot at receipt for the visual inventory record.
items.acceptance_criteria: One or more photographs on file per lot showing quantity, tag, and condition.

items.text: Verify storage location provides manufacturer-required protection from moisture, sun, and temperature extremes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Storage conditions meet manufacturer/spec storage requirements (e.g., covered, elevated off grade, temperature range).

items.text: Confirm moisture-sensitive materials (gypsum, insulation, wood, cementitious bags) are elevated off grade and covered.
items.acceptance_criteria: Materials stored on dunnage/pallets a minimum of 4 inches off grade and covered with waterproof tarping or under roof.

items.text: Verify hazardous or flammable materials are stored in a segregated, properly ventilated, and labeled area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Segregated storage area present with correct hazard labeling and no incompatible materials co-stored.

items.text: Confirm stacking height and pallet stability meet safe storage limits.
items.acceptance_criteria: Stack height does not exceed manufacturer or site safety plan limit; no leaning or unstable stacks observed.

items.text: Verify laydown area is level, drained, and clear of debris that could damage stored materials.
items.acceptance_criteria: Storage surface free of standing water, mud infiltration, or debris contact with stored materials.

items.text: Confirm shelf-life-limited materials (adhesives, sealants, admixtures) display legible expiration dates.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of shelf-life-limited items have a legible, unexpired date code at time of inventory.

items.text: Inspect each material lot for shipping damage, corrosion, or manufacturing defects.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible cracking, corrosion, deformation, or contamination beyond manufacturer's acceptable tolerance.

items.text: Verify packaging integrity for moisture-sensitive or fragile materials.
items.acceptance_criteria: Original packaging/wrap intact and unbreached at time of inspection.

items.text: Segregate and tag damaged or rejected material for return, replacement, or disposition.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rejected material physically separated and tagged 'hold/rejected' within the same work shift as identification.

items.text: Document damage claims with carrier or supplier within the required notification window.
items.acceptance_criteria: Damage claim filed and logged within 48 hours of discovery, or per contract notice period if shorter.

sections.name: Quantity Reconciliation Against Submittals & Purchase Orders

items.text: Reconcile total received quantity against approved submittal takeoff quantity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Received quantity is within the project's approved waste/overage allowance of the takeoff quantity.

items.text: Reconcile received quantity against outstanding purchase order balance.
items.acceptance_criteria: PO balance updated to reflect received quantity with zero unexplained variance carried forward.

items.text: Flag and route quantity shortages or overages to procurement for resolution.
items.acceptance_criteria: Variance report generated and routed to procurement within 24 hours of count completion.

items.text: Verify inventory valuation/unit cost data is recorded for cost-tracking purposes.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unit cost and extended value recorded for each lot in the inventory system.

items.text: Compile physical inventory count sheet with all lots, quantities, and locations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Count sheet complete for 100% of lots inspected, with no blank required fields.

items.text: Attach all supporting delivery tickets, mill certs, and photographs to the inventory record.
items.acceptance_criteria: All required supporting documents scanned/attached and cross-referenced to inventory line items.

items.text: Materials coordinator reviews and signs the completed inventory record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated by the responsible materials coordinator prior to distribution.

items.text: Superintendent countersigns inventory record acknowledging count and storage conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Countersignature obtained within 3 business days of count completion.

templates.name: Construction Material Inventory Tracking Checklist
templates.description: Verifies the ongoing controls, system configuration, and process discipline used to track material stock levels, reorder points, cycle counts, custody, and variance reconciliation over the life of a project.
prerequisites: Inventory tracking system or spreadsheet in active use
ABC classification or criticality ranking of material items completed
Prior period tracking reports available for trend comparison

items.text: Verify each material category has a designated master item code in the inventory tracking system.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of active material categories have a unique, non-duplicated item code before tracking begins.

items.text: Confirm unit of measure and unit cost fields are configured consistently across the system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unit of measure matches procurement and estimating units for every tracked item, with no mixed-unit entries.

items.text: Verify access permissions restrict inventory record edits to authorized personnel.
items.acceptance_criteria: Edit/write access limited to named, authorized users; view-only access available to field staff.

items.text: Confirm the system generates a timestamped audit trail for all quantity adjustments.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every quantity change logs user, timestamp, prior value, and new value automatically.

items.text: Verify minimum stock (reorder point) is defined for each critical or long-lead material.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reorder point set and documented for 100% of items flagged as critical or long-lead.

items.text: Confirm reorder point accounts for supplier lead time and average consumption rate.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reorder point equals or exceeds (lead time in days x average daily usage) plus safety stock.

items.text: Verify automated or manual reorder alerts trigger when stock crosses the reorder point.
items.acceptance_criteria: Alert generated and routed to procurement within 24 hours of threshold breach.

items.text: Confirm maximum stock levels are set to prevent overordering and excess laydown congestion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Maximum on-hand quantity defined for high-volume or space-constrained items.

items.text: Verify safety stock levels for critical items are reviewed and adjusted at least monthly.
items.acceptance_criteria: Safety stock review documented monthly with adjustment rationale recorded.

items.text: Confirm a cycle count schedule is established covering all material categories within the count cycle.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written cycle count schedule assigns every SKU a count frequency based on value/criticality (ABC classification).

items.text: Verify cycle counts are performed independently of the person responsible for issuing materials.
items.acceptance_criteria: Counter is not the same individual who logs issuances for the counted items, or a second reviewer verifies the count.

items.text: Confirm cycle count accuracy rate meets the program target.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cycle count accuracy of 95% or greater (counted quantity matches system quantity) for A-class items.

items.text: Verify count discrepancies are investigated and root-caused before adjusting system quantities.
items.acceptance_criteria: Root cause documented for every discrepancy exceeding the variance threshold prior to adjustment.

items.text: Confirm cycle count results are logged with counter name, date, and variance percentage.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log entry complete for 100% of counts performed in the current cycle.

items.text: Verify material issuance requires a signed pick ticket or work order reference.
items.acceptance_criteria: No material leaves controlled storage without a signed issuance record tied to a work order or cost code.

items.text: Confirm custody transfer between storage, subcontractors, and installation crews is logged at each handoff.
items.acceptance_criteria: Each transfer records receiving party, quantity, date, and location with no gaps in custody chain.

items.text: Verify high-value or theft-prone materials are stored in a secured, access-controlled area.
items.acceptance_criteria: Secured storage with restricted key/badge access for items exceeding the site's high-value threshold.

items.text: Confirm returned or unused material is logged back into inventory with condition noted.
items.acceptance_criteria: Return transaction recorded same-day with quantity, condition, and originating work order referenced.

items.text: Verify variance threshold for automatic investigation is defined and documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written variance threshold (e.g., greater of 2% or 10 units) established and communicated to staff.

items.text: Confirm variances exceeding threshold are reported to project management within the required window.
items.acceptance_criteria: Variance report submitted to project management within 48 hours of discovery.

items.text: Verify monthly reconciliation between physical counts and system book quantities is completed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation completed and signed off monthly with all open variances tracked to closure.

items.text: Confirm write-offs for lost, stolen, or damaged material are approved by an authorized manager.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every write-off entry carries a manager approval signature and documented justification.

items.text: Verify inventory shrinkage rate is tracked and trended against the project budget allowance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cumulative shrinkage tracked and compared monthly to the estimated waste/shrinkage allowance.

items.text: Compile current inventory tracking report showing on-hand quantities, reorder status, and open variances.
items.acceptance_criteria: Report generated and dated, reflecting system status as of the reporting date.

items.text: Attach cycle count logs and variance investigation records for the reporting period.
items.acceptance_criteria: All logs for the period attached with no missing count cycles.

items.text: Materials/inventory control manager reviews and signs the tracking report.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated by the responsible inventory control manager.

items.text: Project manager acknowledges open variances and corrective action plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Acknowledgment signature obtained within 5 business days of report issuance.

templates.name: Renovation Project Checklist
templates.description: Guides a renovation project from baseline condition assessment and hazardous materials screening through demolition, construction execution, and closeout, with emphasis on occupant safety and regulatory compliance.
prerequisites: Baseline property condition assessment scheduled
Pre-1978 structure history known for lead assessment applicability
Approved permit set and scope drawings available

items.text: Conduct and document a baseline property condition assessment prior to starting work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Assessment covers structure, envelope, and major systems and is completed before mobilization.

items.text: Photograph existing conditions of all areas adjacent to and within the renovation scope.
items.acceptance_criteria: Dated photographs cover 100% of adjacent finishes, floors, and fixtures prior to any demolition.

items.text: Document pre-existing defects, cracks, or damage to avoid disputed liability.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written punch-style log of pre-existing conditions signed by owner or owner's representative.

items.text: Verify existing structural elements to be reused are assessed for adequacy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Structural assessment by qualified party on file for any load-bearing element affected by scope.

items.text: Confirm utility locations (electrical, gas, water, data) are identified and marked before work begins.
items.acceptance_criteria: All active utilities within work area marked and verified with local utility locate service or as-builts.

items.text: Verify a lead-based paint assessment is completed for structures built before 1978.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lead assessment on file for any pre-1978 structure prior to disturbing painted surfaces.

items.text: Confirm certified renovator credentials and firm certification are current for lead-safe work practices.
items.acceptance_criteria: Valid EPA RRP firm certification and certified renovator documentation on site.

items.text: Verify containment, signage, and work-area isolation are in place before lead-disturbing activity.
items.acceptance_criteria: Work area containment (plastic sheeting, warning signs) installed and inspected before cutting/sanding/demolition begins.

items.text: Confirm asbestos survey is completed for materials suspected to contain asbestos prior to disturbance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Asbestos survey report on file identifying ACM/suspect ACM before any disturbance of the material.

items.text: Verify abatement of confirmed ACM is performed by a licensed abatement contractor before renovation proceeds.
items.acceptance_criteria: Abatement clearance documentation and licensed contractor certificate on file prior to renovation work in the area.

items.text: Confirm waste from lead or asbestos work is bagged, labeled, and disposed of per regulation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Waste containerized, labeled, and manifested per applicable hazardous waste disposal requirements.

items.text: Verify all required renovation/building permits are obtained and posted on site.
items.acceptance_criteria: Permits posted and visible, matching the approved scope of work, before work commences.

items.text: Confirm plans on site match the permitted/approved drawing set.
items.acceptance_criteria: Field copy of drawings matches the jurisdiction-approved and stamped set with no unapproved deviations.

items.text: Verify historic preservation or landmark review approval is on file if applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Approval letter from historic review authority on file prior to exterior or character-defining feature work.

items.text: Confirm required inspections are scheduled at applicable milestones (rough-in, framing, final).
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspection schedule aligned with jurisdiction requirements with no milestone skipped.

items.text: Verify dust and debris containment barriers are installed at the work zone boundary.
items.acceptance_criteria: Continuous barrier separates work zone from occupied or public areas with no visible gaps.

items.text: Confirm negative air/HEPA filtration is operating where required for containment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Negative air units running and verified functional prior to daily work start in containment areas.

items.text: Verify occupant or public egress paths remain clear and code-compliant during renovation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum egress width maintained per code with no obstruction by materials or equipment.

items.text: Confirm temporary utilities (power, water, HVAC) are safely routed and do not create trip or shock hazards.
items.acceptance_criteria: Temporary utility runs elevated, covered, or GFCI-protected per OSHA electrical requirements.

items.text: Verify daily work-area cleanup and debris removal occurs to maintain safe occupied-space conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Work area cleaned and debris removed at end of each shift with no material left blocking access.

items.text: Verify selective demolition scope is marked and confirmed against drawings before cutting.
items.acceptance_criteria: Demolition limits marked in field and verified against approved drawings prior to first cut.

items.text: Confirm structural shoring or bracing is installed before removing load-bearing elements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Shoring installed and inspected by qualified person before any load-bearing removal begins.

items.text: Verify salvage items identified for reuse or owner retention are protected and stored separately.
items.acceptance_criteria: Salvage items tagged, removed intact, and stored in a protected area with no damage during removal.

items.text: Confirm demolition debris is sorted for recycling/disposal per waste management plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Debris streams separated per project waste management plan with disposal tickets retained.

items.text: Verify new work ties into existing construction meet code and manufacturer transition requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tie-in details match approved drawings; no unapproved field deviations at existing-to-new interfaces.

items.text: Confirm existing systems remaining in service are protected and functional throughout construction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Retained systems tested functional at defined checkpoints with no unplanned outages.

items.text: Verify finish materials match approved selections and samples.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installed finishes match approved sample board/submittal for color, texture, and pattern.

items.text: Confirm in-progress inspections are documented at each major renovation milestone.
items.acceptance_criteria: Milestone inspection record completed and signed for framing, rough-in, and finish stages.

items.text: Verify final jurisdictional inspection and certificate of occupancy/completion are obtained where required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certificate issued by authority having jurisdiction prior to occupancy or use of renovated space.

items.text: Confirm post-renovation clearance testing (lead dust wipe, air clearance) meets applicable standards.
items.acceptance_criteria: Clearance results below regulatory threshold before area is returned to occupant use.

items.text: Verify final walkthrough with owner/occupant is completed and punch items documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Walkthrough completed with owner signature and punch list issued within 3 business days.

items.text: Confirm restored areas are cleaned to a move-in-ready condition.
items.acceptance_criteria: Final clean completed with no construction dust, labels, or debris remaining.

items.text: Compile permit closeout documents, inspection reports, and clearance test results.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete closeout package assembled with no missing required document.

items.text: Attach before/after photo documentation for the full renovation scope.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo set covers 100% of renovated areas in matched before/after pairs.

items.text: Project manager or renovation lead signs closeout package.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and dated by the responsible project manager prior to owner handover.

items.text: Owner or owner's representative signs acceptance of completed renovation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Owner signature obtained on acceptance form at or before final walkthrough close.

templates.name: As-Built Drawings Verification Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that as-built/record drawings accurately capture field-constructed architectural, structural, MEP, and site conditions before transmittal to the owner at project closeout.
prerequisites: Approved change orders and RFIs compiled
Trade redline markups collected from all subcontractors
Field survey data available for verification spot-checks

items.text: Verify all approved change orders, RFIs, and field directives are compiled for as-built incorporation.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of approved changes affecting the drawing set are collected and cross-referenced before markup begins.

items.text: Confirm the base drawing set used for as-built markup is the latest issued-for-construction revision.
items.acceptance_criteria: Base set revision matches the current IFC set with no superseded sheets in use.

items.text: Verify redline markups from each trade are collected and legible.
items.acceptance_criteria: Redlines received from every trade with scope in the project, legible and dated.

items.text: Confirm the as-built drawing numbering and sheet index match the contract document structure.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sheet index matches CSI/contract organization with no unreferenced or orphaned sheets.

items.text: Verify wall locations, dimensions, and room configurations match field-constructed conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Dimensional deviations from drawings greater than 2 inches are captured and noted on as-builts.

items.text: Confirm door, window, and opening locations and types match installed conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of openings verified against field survey with type/size discrepancies corrected on drawings.

items.text: Verify finish schedules reflect actual installed finishes by room.
items.acceptance_criteria: Finish schedule matches installed material, color, and manufacturer for each room.

items.text: Confirm ceiling heights and soffit/bulkhead locations match field conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Ceiling height deviations greater than 1 inch documented and reflected on as-builts.

items.text: Verify structural grid lines and column locations match field-installed positions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Column centerline deviation from drawings does not exceed AISC erection tolerance without documented exception.

items.text: Confirm foundation and footing elevations match as-constructed survey data.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation deviations greater than 0.5 inch are documented with as-built elevation noted.

items.text: Verify any structural design changes (reinforcement, connections) approved during construction are reflected.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every approved structural RFI/change is incorporated into the as-built structural sheets.

items.text: Confirm beam and slab elevations at critical bearing points match as-constructed survey data.
items.acceptance_criteria: Elevation deviations greater than 0.5 inch at bearing points are documented with as-built elevation noted.

items.text: Verify mechanical ductwork and equipment locations match field-installed routing.
items.acceptance_criteria: Duct routing and equipment locations verified against field GPS/measured survey with deviations noted.

items.text: Confirm electrical panel schedules, circuit routing, and device locations match installed conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Panel schedules match field labeling with 100% circuit accuracy verified.

items.text: Verify plumbing and piping routing, including buried lines, is accurately captured with invert elevations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Buried utility as-builts include depth and location survey data with accuracy within 6 inches horizontal.

items.text: Confirm fire protection system layout, including sprinkler heads and standpipes, matches installed conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Sprinkler head locations and pipe routing verified against field conditions with no unresolved discrepancies.

items.text: Verify low-voltage, data, and controls device locations are documented on as-builts.
items.acceptance_criteria: Device locations captured for 100% of low-voltage devices installed under contract scope.

items.text: Verify underground utility as-builts capture depth, material, and location for all buried lines.
items.acceptance_criteria: Utility survey data complete for water, sewer, storm, gas, electrical, and communications lines.

items.text: Confirm site grading and drainage as-builts reflect final constructed elevations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spot elevations match constructed grade within 0.1 foot at verification points.

items.text: Verify pavement, curb, and site feature locations match installed conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Site feature survey confirms location match within standard construction survey tolerance.

items.text: Confirm retaining walls, site structures, and easement boundaries match as-constructed survey.
items.acceptance_criteria: As-built location matches recorded easement/property boundary within standard survey tolerance.

items.text: Perform independent field measurement spot-checks against completed as-built drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 10% of dimensioned elements spot-checked in the field with results matching as-built within tolerance.

items.text: Verify survey control points used for as-built verification are tied to project benchmark/datum.
items.acceptance_criteria: All survey data referenced to the established project benchmark with documented datum.

items.text: Confirm digital as-built model (if BIM-based) matches surveyed field conditions within tolerance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Model-to-field deviation within the project's BIM execution plan accuracy requirement.

items.text: Verify a sample of dimensional discrepancies identified during field checks are corrected on the final drawing set.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of discrepancies exceeding tolerance are corrected on the drawing set before it is marked final.

items.text: Compile final as-built drawing set in the format required by contract (PDF, CAD, BIM).
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete set delivered in all contractually required formats with consistent file naming.

items.text: Verify as-built set is stamped/labeled 'As-Built' with completion date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every sheet bears the 'As-Built' label and issue date before transmittal.

items.text: Design professional or engineer of record reviews as-built set for structural/life-safety accuracy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Review documented and signed prior to final transmittal to owner.

items.text: Project manager and owner's representative sign off on as-built drawing acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed acceptance obtained prior to project closeout completion.

templates.name: Final Punch List Completion Checklist
templates.description: Verifies that all substantial-completion punch list items have been corrected, re-inspected, and formally closed prior to final project acceptance and certificate execution.
prerequisites: Initial joint punch list walkthrough completed with architect/owner
Life safety systems tested and operational
Draft Certificate of Substantial Completion (AIA G704) prepared

items.text: Verify the facility is sufficiently complete for the owner to occupy or utilize it for its intended use.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certificate of Substantial Completion criteria met per contract definition, with only minor items remaining.

items.text: Confirm all life safety systems are operational prior to generating the punch list.
items.acceptance_criteria: Fire alarm, sprinkler, and emergency egress systems tested functional before punch walk begins.

items.text: Verify a joint pre-punch walkthrough with architect/owner has established the punch list scope.
items.acceptance_criteria: Joint walkthrough completed and initial punch list issued with architect and owner representative present.

items.text: Confirm the Certificate of Substantial Completion (AIA G704) draft is prepared listing responsibilities and dates.
items.acceptance_criteria: Draft G704 includes substantial completion date, remaining work list, and responsibility allocation.

items.text: Verify wall, ceiling, and floor finishes are free of damage, stains, or installation defects.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible defects at normal viewing distance (5 feet) under standard lighting.

items.text: Confirm doors, hardware, and frames operate smoothly and latch/lock correctly.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of doors open, close, and latch without binding or excessive gap.

items.text: Verify millwork, casework, and trim are properly installed, aligned, and free of defects.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gaps and reveals within 1/8 inch tolerance with no visible damage or misalignment.

items.text: Confirm paint and wall covering finishes match approved color/sheen selections with no touch-up visible from normal viewing distance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Finish matches approved sample with no drips, holidays, or roller marks visible at 5 feet.

items.text: Verify flooring is properly seated, seamed, and free of trip hazards.
items.acceptance_criteria: No lippage exceeding 1/16 inch at transitions; no loose or lifting flooring material.

items.text: Verify HVAC systems achieve design temperature and airflow at all zones.
items.acceptance_criteria: Zone temperature within +/-2 degrees F of setpoint; airflow within 10% of design CFM.

items.text: Confirm all electrical devices, switches, and receptacles are functional and properly labeled.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of devices tested functional with panel/circuit labeling matching as-built.

items.text: Verify plumbing fixtures operate without leaks and drain properly.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible leaks at supply or drain connections after a minimum 5-minute run test.

items.text: Confirm lighting levels and controls (occupancy sensors, dimming) function as specified.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lighting control sequence matches specification with no non-functional fixtures.

items.text: Verify fire-rated assemblies (doors, walls, penetrations) are properly sealed and labeled.
items.acceptance_criteria: All fire-rated penetrations firestopped and labeled; no unsealed penetrations observed.

items.text: Confirm exit signage and emergency lighting are installed and functional at all required locations.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of exit signs illuminated and emergency lighting tested functional on battery backup.

items.text: Verify accessible route and ADA-required features meet code (ramps, clearances, signage).
items.acceptance_criteria: Accessible route and clearances meet ADA/ANSI A117.1 dimensional requirements with no obstructions.

items.text: Confirm final fire alarm and sprinkler inspection sign-off has been obtained from the AHJ.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection report from authority having jurisdiction on file before occupancy.

items.text: Verify exterior finishes, siding, and roofing are complete and free of visible defects.
items.acceptance_criteria: No visible damage, gaps, or incomplete flashing at exterior envelope penetrations.

items.text: Confirm site paving, striping, and signage match approved civil drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Striping and signage match approved plan with no missing accessible parking markings.

items.text: Verify landscaping and irrigation are installed per approved plan and functioning.
items.acceptance_criteria: Irrigation zones tested functional with plantings matching approved landscape plan quantity.

items.text: Confirm exterior lighting is functional and aimed per photometric plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of exterior fixtures functional with no unintended light spill beyond property line.

items.text: Verify each punch list item has a documented completion date and responsible party.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of punch items show completion date and responsible trade before closure.

items.text: Confirm corrected items are re-inspected and verified by the architect/owner's representative.
items.acceptance_criteria: Re-inspection sign-off obtained for every corrected item before it is marked closed.

items.text: Verify no new defects were introduced during punch item correction work.
items.acceptance_criteria: Surrounding finishes and systems inspected post-repair with no collateral damage found.

items.text: Confirm final punch list closure rate meets the threshold for final completion certification.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of punch items closed, or remaining items formally deferred with owner written consent.

items.text: Compile final punch list report with before/after photos for each corrected item.
items.acceptance_criteria: Photo documentation attached for 100% of items marked complete.

items.text: Verify Certificate of Substantial Completion is fully executed by owner, architect, and contractor.
items.acceptance_criteria: AIA G704 signed by all required parties with substantial completion date recorded.

items.text: Superintendent certifies punch list completion and readiness for final closeout.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed certification submitted prior to requesting final payment application.

items.text: Architect/owner's representative signs final acceptance of punch list completion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signature obtained within 10 business days of final re-inspection.

templates.name: Warranty Documentation Checklist
templates.description: Verifies collection, organization, and transmittal of all contractor, subcontractor, and manufacturer warranties—general, MEP, roofing, and specialty—to the owner at project closeout.
prerequisites: Substantial completion date established
Subcontractor closeout submittals received
Equipment serial number log compiled

items.text: Verify a warranty log is created listing every warrantable system, subcontractor, and start date.
items.acceptance_criteria: Log includes 100% of subcontracted scopes with warranty obligations per the contract.

items.text: Confirm each subcontractor has submitted written warranty documentation before final payment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written warranty received and logged for every subcontractor prior to release of final payment.

items.text: Verify warranty start date is defined consistently (substantial completion date unless noted otherwise).
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty start date matches the Certificate of Substantial Completion date for all general warranties.

items.text: Confirm warranty periods, exclusions, and conditions are summarized in a single owner-facing index.
items.acceptance_criteria: Index cross-references every warranty document with duration and key exclusions listed.

items.text: Verify the general contractor's one-year workmanship warranty letter is executed and dated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed warranty letter on file specifying 1-year duration from substantial completion.

items.text: Confirm scope and exclusions of the general warranty are clearly stated and match the contract.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty scope matches contract general conditions with no unauthorized exclusions added.

items.text: Verify the 11-month warranty inspection is scheduled prior to warranty expiration.
items.acceptance_criteria: Inspection scheduled between month 10 and month 11 of the 1-year warranty period.

items.text: Confirm process for owner warranty claim submission and response time is documented and communicated.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written claim process provided to owner with contractor response time commitment stated.

items.text: Verify HVAC equipment and installation warranty documentation covers a minimum 2-year period.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written MEP warranty on file covering parts and labor for not less than 2 years from substantial completion.

items.text: Confirm electrical system and equipment warranties are documented separately from general warranty.
items.acceptance_criteria: Electrical-specific warranty document received with equipment serial numbers referenced.

items.text: Verify plumbing system warranty covers piping, fixtures, and water heating equipment for the required term.
items.acceptance_criteria: Plumbing warranty document specifies coverage term and included components.

items.text: Confirm extended manufacturer warranties on MEP equipment are registered in the owner's name.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer warranty registration confirmation received showing owner as the registered party.

items.text: Verify MEP commissioning report is attached to support warranty baseline performance data.
items.acceptance_criteria: Commissioning report on file documenting baseline performance at time of turnover.

items.text: Verify manufacturer's material warranty for roofing system is issued and specifies duration.
items.acceptance_criteria: Material warranty document specifies a term of 10 to 20 years consistent with the specified system.

items.text: Confirm installer's workmanship warranty for roofing is separate from and complements the material warranty.
items.acceptance_criteria: Installer workmanship warranty on file with duration and scope stated, distinct from manufacturer warranty.

items.text: Verify roofing warranty conditions (maintenance requirements, inspection frequency) are documented for the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Maintenance requirements for warranty validity clearly stated and provided to facility management.

items.text: Confirm manufacturer inspection of completed roof installation was performed prior to warranty issuance, if required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manufacturer field inspection report on file dated prior to warranty certificate issuance, where required by the system.

items.text: Verify roof warranty registration is completed and confirmation documentation retained.
items.acceptance_criteria: Registration confirmation number and document on file matching the project address.

items.text: Verify warranties for elevators, fire alarm, and other life-safety equipment are collected.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty documents on file for 100% of life-safety equipment installed under contract.

items.text: Confirm appliance and fixture warranties are collected with model/serial numbers recorded.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty cards or documents matched to installed serial numbers with no unmatched equipment.

items.text: Verify specialty system warranties (building automation, security, low-voltage) are documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty documentation received for each specialty system per the contract equipment list.

items.text: Confirm extended service contracts bundled with equipment purchase are logged separate from the base warranty.
items.acceptance_criteria: Service contract terms, coverage period, and renewal date recorded distinct from manufacturer warranty terms.

items.text: Verify the compiled warranty binder/digital package is organized by system per the closeout requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Package organized to match the specification's closeout submittal structure (CSI divisions).

items.text: Confirm all warranties are transmitted to the owner with a signed transmittal log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Transmittal log signed by owner's representative confirming receipt of the complete warranty package.

items.text: Verify a warranty tracking calendar with expiration dates is provided to facility management.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calendar or spreadsheet listing every warranty expiration date delivered to the owner's facility team.

items.text: Confirm warranty claim points of contact and submission procedure are documented for the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written claim submission procedure, including required notice period, delivered with the warranty package.

items.text: Compile complete warranty index cross-referenced to the closeout submittal log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Index matches 100% of warranty items required by the contract closeout section.

items.text: Verify digital copies of all warranty documents are archived in the project record.
items.acceptance_criteria: Digital archive contains searchable copies of all warranty documents transmitted.

items.text: Project manager certifies warranty package completeness prior to final closeout submission.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed certification on file confirming package completeness.

items.text: Owner's representative acknowledges receipt of the complete warranty package.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed acknowledgment obtained at or before project turnover meeting.

templates.name: Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Manuals Checklist
templates.description: Verifies completeness and accuracy of operation and maintenance manuals, preventive maintenance documentation, and structured digital asset data (COBie) delivered to the owner's facility management team at closeout.
prerequisites: Commissioning report and final setpoints available
Equipment nameplate/serial data collected in the field
BIM execution plan or COBie requirement defined for the project

items.text: Verify O&M manuals are organized by CSI division/system consistent with the closeout specification.
items.acceptance_criteria: Table of contents matches the specified closeout organization with no unlisted sections.

items.text: Confirm both digital (searchable PDF) and, if required, hard-copy binder formats are delivered.
items.acceptance_criteria: Deliverables match contractually required format(s) with digital files text-searchable.

items.text: Verify manuals include a master equipment index cross-referenced to room/location numbers.
items.acceptance_criteria: Index lists 100% of major equipment with location tags matching as-built drawings.

items.text: Confirm version control and issue date are noted on the manual cover/title page.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cover page shows issue date and revision number consistent with the final closeout submission.

items.text: Verify equipment data sheets include manufacturer, model, and serial number matching installed equipment.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of major equipment data sheets match field nameplate data with no transcription errors.

items.text: Confirm capacity, performance, and rating data are included for each major piece of equipment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Rated capacity/performance data present for every equipment item requiring performance documentation.

items.text: Verify spare parts lists and recommended stock levels are included where applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spare parts list included for equipment with manufacturer-recommended spares.

items.text: Confirm supplier/vendor contact information is current and included for each equipment category.
items.acceptance_criteria: Vendor name, phone, and service contact listed for 100% of major equipment categories.

items.text: Verify preventive maintenance schedules are included for each major system with defined task frequency.
items.acceptance_criteria: PM schedule lists task, frequency, and responsible party for every major system per ASHRAE Guideline 4 structure.

items.text: Confirm maintenance tasks specify required tools, parts, and estimated labor time.
items.acceptance_criteria: Task instructions include tools/parts list and estimated duration for at least 90% of listed PM tasks.

items.text: Verify lubrication schedules and filter replacement intervals are documented per manufacturer recommendations.
items.acceptance_criteria: Lubrication/filter intervals match manufacturer O&M data with no missing HVAC or rotating equipment.

items.text: Confirm calibration requirements and intervals are documented for controls and instrumentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Calibration interval and procedure reference included for all life-safety and process instrumentation.

items.text: Verify step-by-step startup and shutdown procedures are included for each major system.
items.acceptance_criteria: Startup/shutdown sequence documented for 100% of HVAC, electrical, and fire protection systems requiring operator action.

items.text: Confirm normal operating setpoints and sequences of operation are documented and match commissioning results.
items.acceptance_criteria: Setpoints in manual match final commissioning report values with no unresolved discrepancies.

items.text: Verify seasonal changeover procedures are documented where applicable (heating/cooling changeover).
items.acceptance_criteria: Changeover procedure included and consistent with control sequence documentation.

items.text: Confirm troubleshooting guides are included for common alarm/fault conditions.
items.acceptance_criteria: Troubleshooting section addresses the most common alarm codes per manufacturer documentation.

items.text: Verify emergency shutdown procedures are documented for systems with life-safety implications.
items.acceptance_criteria: Emergency shutdown steps documented and posted/referenced for fire, electrical, and mechanical systems.

items.text: Confirm safety data sheets (SDS) are included for chemicals used in system operation/maintenance.
items.acceptance_criteria: SDS on file for 100% of chemicals identified in the maintenance procedures.

items.text: Verify lockout/tagout points are identified in the manual for each major piece of equipment.
items.acceptance_criteria: LOTO points documented for every piece of equipment requiring energy isolation during maintenance.

items.text: Confirm emergency contact list (fire, utility, equipment service) is current and included.
items.acceptance_criteria: Emergency contact list verified current within 30 days of manual delivery.

items.text: Verify COBie or equivalent structured data deliverable is complete for facility management system import.
items.acceptance_criteria: COBie spreadsheet/data set validated with no required fields blank per the project's BIM execution plan.

items.text: Confirm equipment asset data matches between COBie deliverable, O&M manuals, and as-built drawings.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cross-check confirms matching asset tags across all three data sources with no conflicts.

items.text: Verify digital handover package is compatible with owner's CMMS/CAFM system format.
items.acceptance_criteria: Data import test into owner's CMMS/CAFM completes without critical errors.

items.text: Confirm warranty and PM schedule data fields are populated in the digital handover data set.
items.acceptance_criteria: Warranty expiration and PM frequency fields populated for 100% of tagged assets.

items.text: Compile final O&M manual set (digital and hard copy as required) for transmittal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Complete set assembled matching the closeout specification requirements.

items.text: Verify transmittal log is signed confirming owner receipt of O&M manuals and digital data.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed transmittal log on file dated at time of delivery.

items.text: Commissioning agent or engineer of record reviews manuals for technical accuracy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Technical review sign-off obtained prior to final transmittal.

items.text: Owner's facility management representative acknowledges receipt and adequacy of O&M documentation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed acknowledgment obtained at or before turnover meeting.

templates.name: Project Turnover Checklist
templates.description: Confirms all documentation, regulatory approvals, financial closeout instruments, and physical handover items are complete before a project is formally turned over to the owner.
prerequisites: Punch list closed and Certificate of Substantial Completion executed
As-built drawings, O&M manuals, and warranties compiled
Final payment application prepared

items.text: Verify the full closeout submittal package is compiled per contract specification requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Package includes 100% of items listed in the specification's closeout submittal section.

items.text: Confirm as-built drawings, O&M manuals, and warranty documents are cross-referenced and included.
items.acceptance_criteria: All three document sets present and internally consistent with matching asset/equipment identifiers.

items.text: Verify closeout package table of contents matches the actual contents delivered.
items.acceptance_criteria: Table of contents accurately reflects every included document with no missing or extra items.

items.text: Confirm training records and video/session documentation are included for operable systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: Training sign-in sheets and session summaries on file for every system requiring owner training.

items.text: Verify certificate of occupancy or final use/completion certificate is obtained and on file.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certificate issued by the authority having jurisdiction prior to owner occupancy.

items.text: Confirm final fire, electrical, and building inspection approvals are documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection approvals on file for all disciplines requiring final AHJ sign-off.

items.text: Verify environmental/regulatory closeout items (SWPPP termination, hazmat clearance) are completed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Regulatory closure documentation on file for every environmental permit issued during construction.

items.text: Confirm elevator, boiler, and pressure vessel certifications are current and posted as required.
items.acceptance_criteria: Certificates posted where required by code and copies retained in the closeout file.

items.text: Verify conditional final lien waivers are collected from the contractor and all subcontractors.
items.acceptance_criteria: Conditional final waivers on file for 100% of parties who furnished labor/materials, prior to final payment issuance.

items.text: Confirm unconditional final lien waivers are collected upon receipt of final payment.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unconditional final waivers received from 100% of paid parties before closeout is certified complete.

items.text: Verify Contractor's Affidavit of Payment of Debts and Claims is executed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed and notarized affidavit on file confirming all debts and claims related to the project are paid.

items.text: Confirm Consent of Surety to Final Payment is obtained where a payment/performance bond is in place.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed consent of surety on file prior to release of final retention.

items.text: Verify final change order reconciliation and contract sum adjustment are documented.
items.acceptance_criteria: Final contract sum matches sum of original contract plus all executed change orders with zero unreconciled variance.

items.text: Confirm retention release is processed only after all lien waiver and affidavit conditions are met.
items.acceptance_criteria: Retention release payment issued only after 100% of required waivers/affidavits are on file.

items.text: Verify owner operations/maintenance staff have received hands-on training on major building systems.
items.acceptance_criteria: Training completed and sign-in sheet on file for each major system per the training plan.

items.text: Confirm building automation system (BAS) access, passwords, and administrative rights are transferred to the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Owner confirms functional administrative access to BAS prior to turnover meeting close.

items.text: Verify initial stock of consumables (filters, lamps, belts) is transferred per contract requirements.
items.acceptance_criteria: Quantity of transferred consumables matches the contract-specified attic stock list.

items.text: Confirm service contracts and maintenance agreements initiated during construction are transferred or terminated as directed by owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Written confirmation of transfer/termination status for each existing service contract.

items.text: Verify all keys are logged, labeled, and transferred to the owner with a signed key log.
items.acceptance_criteria: Key log signed by owner's representative accounting for 100% of issued keys.

items.text: Confirm access control/security system credentials are reset and reissued under owner administration.
items.acceptance_criteria: All construction-phase credentials deactivated and owner-administered credentials confirmed active.

items.text: Verify master key/grand master systems are documented with a keying schedule delivered to the owner.
items.acceptance_criteria: Keying schedule delivered matching the installed lock hardware system.

items.text: Confirm temporary construction locks/cores are removed and replaced with permanent hardware.
items.acceptance_criteria: No construction cores remain in place at turnover; permanent hardware verified functional.

items.text: Verify final cleaning of interior and exterior spaces meets contract cleanliness standard.
items.acceptance_criteria: Spaces free of construction debris, dust, labels, and protective film per contract cleaning spec.

items.text: Confirm temporary facilities, fencing, and construction signage are removed from the site.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of temporary construction facilities removed and site restored per contract.

items.text: Verify final site walk confirms no outstanding safety hazards remain for occupant use.
items.acceptance_criteria: No unresolved life-safety or trip/fall hazards observed during final walk.

items.text: Confirm punch list items affecting site condition are closed and verified prior to turnover.
items.acceptance_criteria: 100% of site-related punch items closed with re-inspection sign-off on file.

items.text: Compile the complete project turnover package including closeout documents, certificates, and financial releases.
items.acceptance_criteria: Turnover package complete with no outstanding required document at time of transmittal.

items.text: Verify formal turnover meeting is held with owner, project manager, and key trade representatives.
items.acceptance_criteria: Turnover meeting minutes documented and distributed within 5 business days.

items.text: Project manager certifies the project is fully closed out and ready for owner acceptance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed closeout certification on file prior to final transmittal.

items.text: Owner signs formal acceptance of project turnover and beneficial occupancy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Signed owner acceptance obtained at or immediately following the turnover meeting.
